For starters it is a seeded roll - don't let this deter you from trying! Order the sandwich with onions and cheese (of course). One can argue that it's not on a roll - which it's true - but wait 'till you take your 1st bite. You'll thank me later.

We have dined here a few times now and found that this rates somewhere between a 3 and 4 so I went with a 4.

The food is not too bad and the menu changes often. Why was I leaning towards a 3? Although the food is not bad, it is not a restaurant I would drive into Philly just to eat for dinner. As a local restaurant or pub where if you want a quick bite to eat or a drink or two and you are in the area, then this place is a great place to go. Some dishes I found lacked structure/texture or flavor and then others were very tasty. 

It is not a date night "fancy" place, but a very laid back, extremely casual location. 

I would still give it a try to see what you think as it is a well-known casual place to eat in the area.

This is my new favorite ice cream spot! I don't even want to tell you that because I don't want this place to get swamped! LOL! JK. You need to try their soft serve ice cream. In addition to the traditional vanilla and chocolate, they offer special flavors of the season (currently Pumpkin, Coffee, and Salted Caramel). The texture of the ice cream and the flavors are top notch.

They also offer a full dining option of foods such as hamburgers, fried foods, funnel cake fries, etc. that you can enjoy as Take-Out or Eat-In. 

Follow on Instagram and Facebook for their hours and soft serve flavors as they change throughout the season.

Cash Only. ATM on-site. Outdoor picnic seating available. Enjoy!

I was REALLY excited to try this place - however, it is not my favorite Ramen in the local area. It still delivers a 4 star as nothing was wrong/terrible with our meal - it's just Rai Rai Ramen in Mount Laurel is sooo much better. Positives: the restaurant is beautifully set up and a great menu of options. It is located in a strip mall with plenty of parking. I took the order as Take-Out.

1. The Pork Bao was quite tasty; however, the bun itself was somewhat dry inside and doughy. I prefer a pillow like texture (and lighter) for the buns.

2. My husband got the #6 Kyushu Spicy Tonkotsu Ramen. He ordered it HOT - the spiciest you could order it. While I thought it was spicy, he said his stomach did NOT pay for it later = it was NOT spicy enough for him. At Rai Rai Ramen - he can order his Ramen at a really spicy level and pay for it that night, lol.

3. I ordered the Tonkotsu Shouyu Ramen (Black Garlic). The flavor of the Black Garlic was tasty. Nothing special but see #4 and #6.

4. The BIGGEST downfall was that they added Nori to the Ramen. Honestly - this takes away from the deliciousness that the broth can deliver. It is too potent and overpowering for the dish. One thing I really like about Rai Rai Ramen is that they DON'T put Nori in the Ramen dishes.

5. Another for the price the portion sizes are not even comparable. I can finish my dish at Kyuramen. A regular size at Rai Rai Ramen for similar/same price requires me to cut it in half because it's a HUGE portion. The portion size to the Kyuramen is similiar to the Mini Ramen at Rai Rai Ramen.

6. Also the noodles are slightly thicker at Kyuramen than at Rai Rai Ramen, which I prefer a thinner noodle. 

7. Kyuramen has a combo dish where you can order (2) different Ramens at very small portions; however, they do not let you order it for take-out (Dine In Only) and have the Ramen choices preselected for you. This could have been a hit if we as consumers could choose our own combo of the 2.

8. The Pan Fried Gyoza Dumpling was steamed, not fried. The sauce served with it was AWESOME, but the dumpling itself was "eh." Nothing exciting.

Overall, I recommend still checking out Kyuramen; but to be honest Rai Rai Ramen in Mount Laurel is better. Why not make the comparison for yourself to try? Double Ramen week!

The lobster pizza was NOT worth the price - few lobster pieces that were sprinkled on top of a small $20 some dollar pizza. The food was just "okay" -nothing to rave about. Next time I will order more pub style food - burgers and fries - as they would probably be the best option.

This was our second visit to this location after not having a good experience the first time. I will say that the restaurant has redeemed itself and was very pleased with the service and the quality of the food.

We ordered multiple courses for a large party from appetizers to sushi. Everything tasted delicious and very fresh. 

Reservations are accepted on OpenTable, which I highly recommend especially for a Friday or Saturday evening. Expect a long wait if you do not have reservations.

There is Hibachi offered here as well but cannot speak to that as we have not tried it yet.

Parking is in a strip mall so there is plenty of parking options. Located in the Acme Shopping Center.

Rudest Restarant in Reno - I have gone to the Stone House an average of 2 times a month for over 3 years. It is a convenient location for me to meet clients for lunch. I have always enjoyed the good food and service. My last two visits there once in November and the other just a few days ago were THE WORST EXPERIENCE I HAVE EVER HAD AT A LUNCH DATE!!! The first began with them insisting I did not make a reservation - which I did as well as called the same morning to confirm - they made my business lunch guests wait 15 minutes - making me look like an unprofessional ass!!  They then had the nerve after just 40 minutes to tell us that they needed us to leave because they "squeezed us in without a reservation" which is not the case - while we were finishing our coffee!! I asked to look at the reservation book and there was my name plane as day written in for a party of 3 at noon - they "somehow did not see it". One mistake shame on you Stonehouse ----- So I go back last week looking forward to a nice leisurely lunch with a good friend - a party of two. I made a reservation again for 12:15 - I showed up at 12:05 and YES they had my reservation. I told them my friend was not here yet and I was early - but it was pretty empty so they seated me and I ordered some tea to wait for my friend. At 12:20 - the hostess comes by and asks if my friend is on her way because they don't in her words - "Seat partial parties" - I remind her that my reservation was for 12;15 and it was her choice to seat me - my friend was on her way. - 2 minutes later she comes by again to tell me I will have to order - if I want to stay seated - so I call my friend who is parking and place an order for both of us - its now 12:22 and I have ordered for a 12:15 reservation - not unreasonable.  We get our food at 12:40 - and finish around 1:10 - and order more tea.  This hostess comes by and starts to push another table next to ours and set it and asks if we are ready to leave as she has another party who needs this table and "besides we were late" !!! I tell her we have been here for less than an hour - we do not even have a check and she is being rather rude for a $50 check customer who has not even gotten our tea! She brings the check and tells me to pay it as she has a business to run.

I have never in all my years of dining been treated so rudely - and totally unprofessionally.  We were two attractive women and I have to say a large group of men sitting nearby - who I happen to know from business - told me they heard what had transpired and also will never go there again. There perception is that the CRONE for a hostess just did not like us because we were well dressed and poised and she on the other hand was disheveled and RUDE! - 

What she does not realize is that between us and the other group we calculated that we jointly spend at least $8000 a year in client entertainment there - so take a look at your bottom lime Stone House and if it goes down $8000 you will know why.

This is in the building Carrows used to be in. The building could use a little love.

We were warming greeted and seated very quickly.

Our waitress did not seem very attentive. She was kind and quick. We did ask for water twice and I think she may have forgotten. The busboy was kind, energetic, friendly. When he passed by we asked him for water, he responded with a cheerful "certainly" and brought us our water. His name was Fernando.

The restaurant was clean. Our food arrived quickly. My husband had the cheese omelet with hash browns. I had a senior special plate. It was biscuits and gravy with 2 pieces of bacon or 2 pieces of sausage. I had one of each and eggs. I got my gravy on the side. Was it the best biscuits and gravy I have ever had. No. But it was darn tasty. The eggs were scrambled and yummy. How do you go wrong with bacon or sausage. They were both good. For the cost and taste it rates a 4. 

Upon leaving Fernando brought my glasses which I had left at the table. Thanks Fernando! You rock!!!

Hopefully the owners give Fernando Kudos for all his effort and kindness.

Love this place. I have ordered takeout from this place several times during covid-19.

They have the most delicious tomato soup. I absolutely love it with their Jive Turkey Sandwich on gluten-free. It is such a wonderful and delicious combo. 

They have a large variety of bread and sandwiches. 

The employees are always kind. Can't wait to get back to when we can see each other's smiling face.

I really dislike having to write a negative review. 

This Red Robin is normally warm, friendly and inviting.  On this occasion it was none of those things.

We arrived around 3:30 p.m. There were two other tables besides ours. We asked for a few minuets. Our waitress went to the back of the restaurant and was sitting with two workers who were eating and talking. I tried to get her attention. Once I got her attention she went to the other two tables before coming to ours. She seemed annoyed. We placed our order. 

Our waitress dropped off our order. My hamburger smelled off and smelled bad. I managed to get my waitresses attention and she told me "What your smelling is the Broiler". No that is not what I am smelling. It was a burger I have gotten before. The meat smelled bad.  I asked her to send it back. She was annoyed but did so.

When she brought it to the kitchen I could hear laughter and some of the workers were making fun of me. I then asked to speak to the manager. He was annoyed and proceeded to tell me that he knew bad meat as that was his business. He then added that he had personally made my burger. I don't know what that was suppose to mean. I told him that it was bad business to laugh and speak negatively about a customer where they could hear you. He said he would have a talk with them. 

I got a new burger and it was fine. I ate the whole thing. But the manager and our waitress make me not want to go back for a really long time. I have never had this kind of treatment here before. Normally this is one of my favorite places to go.

Oh my goodness! This place has the most amazing food! My husband was out of town so I took my daughter, her boyfriend, and my son out to dinner. They suggested this restaurant. Boy, am I glad they did.

I had a Korean Iced Coffee that was out of this world delicious. So much so that I went home and ordered the little contraption and Korean Coffee beans to make Korean Coffee at home.

We all raved about our food. As a matter of fact, we raved about it for weeks. The food was so tasty and delicious I forgot to take pictures of it. I ordered General Chicken with a mild spice. It was so outstanding. I think it is the best I have ever had in Reno. We shared a couple of appetizers and left stuffed. 

The wait staff was on point and made sure we got more tea and water. There was so much food we had leftovers to take home. I found the wait staff to be cordial, accommodating, and kind. All the food was delivered hot and ready to eat. It is a little harder to tell if people are smiling behind the masks. 

I highly recommend this restaurant. It is one of my favorites now.

Located in Sparks Galleria shopping center is this quaint small mom and pop owned restaurant. The restaurant has maybe 10 or 11 tables. The staff is super kind and friendly. The food is always good. My husband likes the chicken Fajitas, my son loves the soft chicken tacos and I like the flautas.

Inside there is a small salsa and fixing bar. They have sliced radishes, limes, several varieties of salsa, onions and other items. Plus the first Wednesday of the month you get a 40% discount on food only. Be prepared to wait in line on the First Wednesday of the month. 

The food is flavorful the service is friendly and kind. What more could you ask for.

Recently my son got his teeth pulled and was not hungry until quite late. I stopped by and opened the door. They were mopping the floors. I asked if I was too late to place a to go order. The chef from the kitchen said it was ok. The woman who took my order was super sweet and rambled off my usual order. I can't believe she could remember me. They are super sweet and I am going to have to remember their names. Normally I write it down. Sometimes I forget. Everyone who works here is sweet. 

I said I was going to have to learn Spanish and they all beamed and said "Sure, we'll help you." How kind and sweet is that. I tell my kids that most people are genuinely kind and it's so true. I not only love the food and customer service but all the employee's and chef are OFF THE HOOK!!!

How nice to have a wonderful pizza place in town that has Gluten-Free, Keto, Paleo, and vegan options. If you haven't been yet, it is a build your own pizza which offers a ton of options in vegetables and cheeses which includes a vegan option, various meats, sauce options, and even a balsamic glaze.

Not only do they offer pizza, they also have desserts, salads, and sides. They also have beer, wine, and other drinks.

However, service is hit and miss. I was lucky enough to come in a couple of times and have Alex and Smith help me. The team on those nights seemed to bond well and were on point with customer service, friendliness, and knowledge. 

The pizza is good. Since you can have as many toppings as you want it would be nice if they allowed you to get double pepperoni on the app. 

I absolutely love that I can order and pay on the app on my phone and then go pick it up.

I absolutely love and adore boba. I had Green Apple with Popping with Green Apple Boba. It was so yummy and tasty. My daughter swears that it is the best boba in town. It is a really small kiosk-type business. I don't think I would have ever known it was there had she not brought me. 

My daughter and her boyfriend had a more traditional milk tea. 

My boba was so yummy and tasty just thinking about it makes me want to go back and get another one. YUM.

IF you haven't tried boba here yet I highly recommend that you give it a try.

After attending a Yelp event we got my kids a pizza to go. We purchased a custom pizza with BBQ sauce on wheat crust, with vegan cheese, chicken, spinach, artichokes,  onions and bacon. We also ordered the Caprese Appetizer and an extra cookie. 

The Caprese was the bomb. It is fresh mozzarella, tomato, basil, balsamic glaze, with pizza chips. I would definitely get this appetizer again. The balsamic glaze with sweet red peppers is amazing. My kids feel in love with the chocolate chip cookie. It is soft and chewy with lots of chocolate chunks. 

There is only one size of pizza which is more of the European personal size. At this amazing quick pizza chain you get to choose your crust (Wheat, white, or gluten free), choose your sauce, and choose your protein and vegetables. Toppings are not extra. Keep in mind if you over top your pizza will not cook through. Customer service is amazing!! The cost for the pizza is $8.95. 

Plus they also have a frequent Pie'er program that I recommend you join.

I had been craving the gluten free lemon bars they are so yummy.  The sign outside said under new management.

This bakery has a large variety of Gluten Free items breads, soups, cupcakes, cookies, lemon bars etc. They use to have the best GF lemon bars ever. I mean the kind you would drive clear across town to get in bad weather for even if they are pricey. 

I got 4 lemon bars one for each person in my family. I couldn't wait to try them. Upon arriving home I tried one of the lemon bars. The crust was stale. The lemon curd was not tasty and way, way to sweet. Freshness is important for pastries. This is not what I drove across town for. So sad I threw them all away. What a waste of time and money.

WHOO! HOO! I can't believe my favorite restaurant is finally in Sparks. After years of begging and pleading with the owners, they are finally here. I bet you can't tell how ecstatic I am? LOL

However, if you are vegan, vegetarian, health-conscious, organic, or special diet this restaurant will have you covered. Incidentally, they offer locally grown organic food and have partnerships with several local businesses such as Folk Kombucha, Lighthouse Coffee and Too Soul Tea Co. I love the interconnection of our business community. 

They offer a wide array and options on their menu. Not to mention they have raw desserts. Needless to say, the vegan bbq pork is so good there is no way you wouldn't be able to tell it is not pork. 

The great thing is you can order online and then stop by and pick up. I have already done this on more than several occasions. 

Therefore if you are at the Outlets at Legends I highly recommend that you try out this local's favorite. 

Incidentally, if you want a delectable dessert that will have you reeling out of your seat you really must try the Banana Split Liege Waffle. It will have you licking your plate clean and trying desperately to devour each tasty morsel no matter how small. 

Did I mention that the service here is beyond wonderful? Why not see for yourself?

Now that I've been here twice, once for breakfast and just recently for happy hour/dinner I feel compelled to share my thoughts. 

The first time I came for breakfast was for a fun yelp gathering put together by the lovely Danah D. 
Thank you Danah for helping me earn the cutest breakfast badge :) 

For starters on behalf of the chef we were treated to the smoked trout deviled eggs and shishito peppers. I love seafood but I'm not one to order trout so I was excited to try something new. It was beautifully presented and the eggs were a vibrant pink! I've never had a colored deviled egg but the taste was amazing!! It has smoked trout, pickled shallots, and olive relish. Great combo of flavors! Next was the shishito peppers. These are the best shishito's I've tried thus far! Who would think a simple side item like this would taste amazing. They are blistered and lightly seasoned with salt and i believe lemon juice as well. I can seriously eat these like popcorn! 

My breakfast entrèe of choice was the Huevos Rancheros. Another yummy dish! Served on a tostada shell, two eggs over easy, avocado, cotija cheese, beans and salsa. Mmmmm what more can I say! 

My latest visit was for a Birthday dinner. Me and my BFF both started with the Mac-N-Cheese. Holy mother of pearl this was amazing, delicious, heaven, and sinful. Served in a cute little skillet with bacon, cheese and a buttery bread crumb topping. Is your mouth drooling yet?? Order this I promise you won't be disappointed!! 

Main Entrées: The Rainbow Trout served with pan roasted spaetzel, crispy pork, citrus butter baby spinach, shaved fennel & crispy kale. At $25 this dish is well worth every penny!!! My friend ordered this dish and I couldn't stop helping myself to his plate lol. I'm definitely going back for this one! 

Next was the Sea Scallops: Served with slices of avocado, grapefruit, corn salsa and a chorizo vinaigrette. Who would have thought all these ingredients combined would work so well together! Another dish with tons of flavor. 

Tip: They take Axxess - Buy one get one Free meal, can't beat that!! I saved $25 using my card. 

The service and staff are great. Thank you Eric for being a very informative and attentive host through out our visit. 

Give this place a try if you're looking for fine dining.

So after my latest visit I feel compelled to update my review here. I've been to pizza mizza several times and the food has been pretty good. I usually order pizzas when I come here but this time I decided to try something different so I ordered the FIT Green Goddess chicken Panini. This comes with your choice of soup, salad, or French fries. 

My order was take out, and when I returned back to work I opened up the box only to find a very blackened and torched looking Panini! Are you kidding me? Who would serve such a thing!! Well I took a bite because I was hungry and also curious to see what it tasted like. It wasn't too bad but still this was more like a BLACKINI!!! 

Mind you the wrap is made from cauliflower so it wouldn't need to be cooked too long but in this case it was clearly overcooked! C'mon now.

My side item of choice was the potato leek soup; which thank goodness was pretty good! It was creamy, rich, and flavorful. The total cost for my soup and Panini came out to $12 bucks. If I'm paying $12 for my meal I expect it to be prepared with care and not just tossed in a box because it was to go and not think I would notice or care!

There was no way I could go back and complain since I only have a 30 minute lunch hour so I was stuck with it. Moral of the story if you plan on ordering take out here be sure to double check your food before you leave! 

I will continue to come here in hopes that this doesn't happen again because I'm curious to try the other sandwiches on the menu. Pizza Mizza cooks please get it together and don't let this happen again.

My last review of 2019 goes to Flor de Maiz because I had a great experience here on my first visit. But then again I wouldn't have expected anything less considering this restaurant is brought to us by Carlos Luna and the Los Agaves team. Also, if you've been to Santo Mezcal then you will see some familiar faces of the staff here bringing their welcoming hospitality, and great customer service! 

This new hot spot is located where the old El Torito used to be, with part of the building being split in half and shared with another new restaurant "Oku" sushi next door. It's still pretty spacious inside despite it being split in half. 

I specifically came here for happy hour after seeing Mark F.'s post showing their HH menu. They definitely have some great prices starting at $6 for margaritas. BUT! The hours for HH that you see on the menu pics are not effective right now due to the holidays. I was told that the hours will be changing, and that the menu posted was just for their opening. So expect to pay $13 and up for drinks on a non-happy hour day. I guess once we get past the New Year then we will see if they will have a set schedule that doesn't change.

Despite the mix up on the HH hours my experience here was a good one! Marcos was our waiter who is not only a very hard worker but he really goes above and beyond to make sure you are well taken care of. Thank you Marcos for always being so sweet and attentive!
 
I started with the Guadalajara margarita which was pretty good, but my favorite was the Picosa because it had a nice kick to it and was a little spicy. I would have been good with two drinks but to my surprise arrived the "Mitla" margarita thanks to my sweet yelp buddy Douglas M.! This was quite a spectacular presentation if you see my video it was a torch burning rosemary right in front of my eyes for that EXTRA sumthin sumthin. The Mitla was on the smokier side made with mezcal, jarabe natural, fresh OJ, lime juice and chipotle marmalade.

For appetizers we had the ceviche tropical which was very fresh and flavorful. The marinade had a light coconut flavor which complimented the shrimp and pineapple bits. It wasn't too sweet or heavy. The taco Oaxaca was another delicious app topped with one of their delicious moles. I highly recommend ordering that! The empanada de amarillito wasn't quite what I expected in an empanada, but it was a small corn tortilla folded with their marinated pork inside (see pic) the meat was a little on the salty side for me but had lots of flavor. The Quesadilla de Huitlacoche is another must order if you love mushrooms and cheese! These mushrooms are the Mexican truffle version which have a soft and velvety texture with hints of corn flavor that melt in your mouth. Sooo bomb!!! 

I definitely want to come back to try a full sized meal, and one of their mole dishes to see how it compares to Los Agaves in taste. 

Overall a very nice addition to our waterfront with a great bar and views! I really hope they continue to keep their happy hour prices reasonable in this expensive and competitive town of ours.

The OYE Jingle Bus Holiday lights tour of 2015 was the best ride of my life!! Danny was our driver and he was an awesome tour guide. Thank you Danny for taking us rowdy yelpers around town showing us all that our beautiful city has to offer during the Christmas season.

The bus was lit up with pretty Christmas lights and I loved how the seating arrangements were. It wasn't your basic school bus where all the seats are facing the driver. They had a few of those in the front but starting in the middle to back the seats were facing each other making for a comfy space to sit next to your friends.

The Christmas music played on the bus was awesome! Great selection of tunes to jam out to. I wish I would have asked Danny where the music was from but in any case it was a great mix.

Best part of the night was taking us to the Milpas roundabout and circling around like 6-7 times or so it seemed. There were no cars around and we just kept going and going around it like kids on a merry-go-round. It was definitely a blast and I would love to do it all over again!

Like Justin R. said in his review "You spin me right round baby right round"...lol loved it!! 

Thank you again Danny for being an awesome driver and keeping us all safe with your bus driving skills.

This restaurant is becoming my favorite place for breakfast! I can see why it's rated at 4.5 stars here on Yelp. My experience with the staff, service and food is worth my 5 stars. 

I brought my mom here for Mother's Day and my cousin also joined us. They had never dined here before and left very full and satisfied. Especially after the bottomless cups of coffee. The coffee is strong but good! 

I ordered the breakfast sandwich, which comes on sourdough, eggs, cheese, bacon and tomato. It also includes a side of rosemary seasoned potatoes. The sandwich was simple yet it was super delicious! The bread was buttery soft, toasty and the sandwich was like a grilled cheese but with eggs and bacon inside (sans tomatoes). I loved it! 

My mom had the French toast, with eggs and sausage. She loved her breakfast and said the sausage was really good too. I wanted to sample it but we were all hangry at the time lol. 

My cousin had the Belgian waffle, eggs and sausage. She was very pleased and satisfied with her breakfast as well. 

The customer service here is excellent! Not only are they friendly but they are constantly checking on you to make sure your drinks are full and if you need anything else. They managed to bring the sunshine to our day despite the gloomy weather. Thank you guys :) 

Inside dining is now open and the restaurant also offers outdoor dining. 

Overall this will be my go to place for breakfast, but I do want to try their lunch menu as well. The prices are very reasonable for what you get and cheaper than the downtown area.

As many times as I've been here it's about time I write a review! I've tried many items on the menu over the years and the one thing that I love about Fresco is how consistently fresh all the ingredients are. Especially when I order a salad the lettuce is never brown or wilted. My favorite has to be the Gorgonzola Walnut Salad. The candied walnuts make it extra special, the gorgonzola cheese is not too pungent, and the balsamic vinaigrette is perfectly made. You definitely must try this one!

This place is a bit more on the pricier side but they do offer some items on the menu that are budget friendly and they won't leave you hungry either. I usually go for their pizza slice specials ($9.95). The slice of pizza is a generous size and it comes with your choice of salad. The grilled shrimp & roasted tomato w/pesto sauce is topped with 3 huge juicy shrimps. When I first tried this I was thinking it would be topped with smaller sized shrimp but no complaints here as they were grilled perfectly and delicious. 

For the main dishes I've tried their chicken club sandwich, turkey burger, spicy chicken sandwich, grilled shrimp and salmon salad, and much more! All of which were delicious. Today I opted for the veggie burger on a brioche bun with brie cheese. The brie cheese was a little too salty so I would choose a different cheese next time, but the veggie burger was amazing! It's made from lentils, red pepper, celery, mushrooms, onions, garlic and other delicious healthy ingredients. Highly recommend you give this a try if you're looking for a healthier option and it won't leave you feeling bloated.

They are always busy during the noon lunch rush so if you're ever pressed for time then give them a call and order ahead of time. Indoor and Outdoor seating is provided for dine in.

Save room for dessert! There are so many delicious treats to choose from It's always a tough decision trying to figure out what to get but I highly recommend their ever so popular chocolate flourless cake. It's light, fluffy, and not overly sweet. They also offer gluten-free desserts. 

Overall Fresco has a broad menu and lots of yummy dishes to choose from. Give it a try if you are looking for a restaurant with a variety of options.

Great atmosphere all around! Located next to Best Western on Bath Street this restaurant is a must try. 

I came here on a Friday night with a party of 4 and it was pretty much a ghost town! I was surprised by that since this place has 4.5 star rating. Does it live up to the hype? Not sure after one visit but the food we ordered didn't disappoint. 

They have very reasonable prices and some great choices on the menu. Happy Hour is from 3-6pm

I wanted to order a margarita but our waitress explained something about the alcohol being fermented and it was only 20% alcohol. Just give me a regular margarita please. She made me second guess my choice so I just opted for a glass of wine instead. But my friend ordered the margarita and she let me take a sip. It tasted like a watered down lemonade but it was still kind of refreshing. 

The Food ~ I ordered the pan roasted salmon. It came with fennel pollen mashed potatoes, asparagus and carrots. It was a very generous serving and it was cooked just right. Tender and flakey. I loved the mashed potatoes. They were creamy and flavorful. 

Citrus Arugula Salad (not pictured) ~ Sliced grapefruit, smoked almonds, shaved grana Padano cheese, dressed with a lemon and olive oil dressing. Omg soooo yummy!!! A perfect salad if you like arugula. My friend ordered it and she shared it with us. Thank you Comadre!

Complimentary Rosemary garlic knots ~ I can eat these like popcorn! 

Crab cakes ~ I didn't get to try them but I managed to get a picture. They look good and pretty though right? 

BLT Sandwich ~ My friend said it was pretty good. The bacon was thick and crisp. 

They take the 2015 Axxess card and it's Buy one get one Free Entrée! Great deal as I split the cost of my $17 meal with my girlfriend and she ordered the same thing. So I paid about $10 after tax gotta love the Axxess card! 

Overall this restaurant is a place I look forward to trying again. Their breakfast menu looks great too. Check it out if you want to try something different!

Formerly Crush Tasting Room now goes by Uncorked Wine Tasting & Kitchen. Everything remains the same except for the name. 

I was lucky to try samples of food from Crush at Taste of The Town a few years ago & loved the pulled pork grilled cheese. So naturally I had to order it. This was made with goat cheese, and I do like goat cheese, but it was a bit much for me. I prefer a melted cheese but it was still tasty. 

The pulled pork nachos were delicious! The bbq sauce is on the sweet side so if you prefer something spicy over sweet then you may want to ask if they can spice it up. 

The Gorgonzola, fig, and bacon flatbread was amazing! Rich in taste from the creamy cheese, and salty sweet from the fig & bacon. Definitely a great combo of flavors! 

The baked polenta was excellent! Topped with sautéed wild mushrooms, red peppers, and caramelized onions. 

The self serve wine dispensers  offer 20 choices of local wines. You can try a tasting, half or full glass. Lots of fun! Or you can purchase a bottle and share with friends. We got lucky and purchased the last bottle of Tempranillo red wine from Grace + Vine located in Paso Robles. 

I believe Michael the owner tended to us and he was great! Thank you Michael for your hard work and service. Looking forward to going back to explore more wine and delicious food.

Wow I'm shocked I haven't written a review for Dargan's after coming here for years! Although I don't come frequently but when I do I always leave satisfied. 

There's two sections to this place which makes it nice for big parties. One area is the main restaurant and the other is the bar area which includes 3 pool tables and flat screen TV's. A nice chill area for happy hour. 

If you come on the weekend in the day time you will find the place to be pretty empty which isn't a bad thing. So if you're looking for a spot to eat and have a big group or not this will be perfect for you! 

The food here has always been good and each dish I've tried is flavorful. 

Dargan's Irish nachos are a must try! A generous serving to share. The housemade waffle chips are light and crunchy. Topped with corn beef, bacon, cheese, jalapeños and a side of sour cream. 

The spicy chicken skewers are also one of my favorite appetizers. There's really no heat to these but they are flavorful served with a delicious peanut sauce. The side of rice served with it has a coconut flavor to it which is extra yummy if u drizzle the peanut sauce over it. 

I recently tried the Farmer's market veggie flatbread  and was surprised how flavorful it was. I'm guessing the base sauce is roasted red bell pepper which I loved. This makes for a light delicious app.

Honestly you can't go wrong with any of the appetizers! 

The roasted tri-tip sandwich was special of the day and I must say it was pretty good! The bread it was served on was a green chile cheese roll. Topped with pico de gallo, cheddar cheese, and ranch avocado aioli. 

They make a great cosmopolitan and one will knock your socks off if you're a lightweight like me. 

Overall Dargan's is the spot if you're looking for a spacious casual friendly place to chill and have some great food and drinks.

After several visits and trying new dishes I'd say The Black Sheep is well deserving of an updated five star review! Afterall I love supporting local businesses.

Chef Ruben is not only passionate about his creative culinary skills, but he is also a down to earth humble guy who makes you feel right at home when dining here. I love how he explains each dish in detail prior to ordering and upon serving. The staff is just as great!

The best part about The Black Sheep is the food of course! Here are some of the more recent dishes I've tried and my take on them.

Roasted Bone Marrow Bruschetta - A must try! This fatty appetizer is full of buttery goodness and it will have you wanting more. You will need a moment of silence after eating this. The flavors combine so well together and the grainy mustard adds that extra special flavor.

Wild Boar Spare Ribs - These little meatsicles slide right off the bone once you pick it up! That's how tender the meat is. Our waiter said to be sure we top the meat with the Asian style red cabbage slaw that it comes with. He was right and I suggest you do the same.

Roasted Cauliflower "Nachos" - This colorful dish is all about crunch and texture. They really nailed the homemade tortilla chips. Light, crunchy, and not greasy at all. The whole combo of roasted cauliflower, crispy kale chips, sliced red jalapenos, cilantro, green onions, and queso fresco is not your typical nacho and that's what I loved about these. You can get your veggie intake and not feel guilty eating these.

Burrata - A pillowy soft Italian cheese made in East LA by an Italian man. If I could find him I would buy all the burrata I could afford! Yes, it's that good. Served on a fresh bed of mixed greens with a light vinegar dressing, this is a great starter.

Duck Confit - For those who have never tried duck it does have a similar taste to chicken so if you're curious about it I'd say go for it! This duck is not gamey at all and has great flavor. It was juicy, moist, and flavorful. I especially enjoyed the cipolini onions, carrots and roasted potatoes that accompany it. 

Tacos de papas - Made with purple Peruvian potatoes. This is a simple taco but delicious and the potatoes are really creamy. I love a good potato taco! 

Yucatán style pork belly taco - The pork belly is infused with habañero, jalapeño, and I think serrano chili's but it's not too spicy where it takes away from the delicious pork belly. Served on a yummy homemade corn tortilla. 

Mesquite grilled wagyu skirt steak taco - Ummm yes please! The meat was tender and melted in my mouth. Topped with a creamy avocado sauce this taco was jammin!! 

If you have any room for dessert and want something light then try the chocolate mousse! It's light, fluffy, not overly sweet and chocolate heaven. 

Ok my lengthy review has come to an end here lol but in a nutshell give this place a try!

This place deserves another star for their happy hour! I tend to forget about this place since it's located away from the usual places you tend to think of when it comes to happy hour. The service was great this time and our waiter was very attentive. 
For a party of 3 and 4 happy hour drinks later with 2 appetizers ordered, free chips & salsa, our bill came out to $32 bucks! You can't beat that price. It's always nice to sit on the patio outside, especially when the weather is warm, but if you happen to go during the evening on a cool night they do have outside heaters that keep you warm.

Give this place a try if you haven't already!

I regret not writing a review for this place years ago! But better late than never right? 

First and Foremost the Location and parking: I'm not going to lie but it's HORRIBLE!!! Think Trader Joe's parking but 10x worse!! Come with patience. 

Pro Tip: Place your order on-line if you're pressed for time! 

Bonus Tip: Come 10 minutes before the noon lunch rush and you're guaranteed to find parking and there's no line! 

They have two lines, one specifically for on-line orders and the other for walk-ins. 

Portions are HUGE whether it's a sandwich or salad expect to get your money's worth and then some! It's no wonder why every location here in town is continuously busy. Aside from that the food is delicious!! Everything I've had is yummy. My favorites are the Buffalo chicken Sammie, garden salad with tuna, Mexican chicken Caesar salad, and the Asian chicken salad. 

Discount Tip: They take the Axxess card! Buy one get one Free. It applies to a sandwich or salad. Free drink everytime thereafter. 

Even though the location/parking here sucks, it's well worth the trouble!

My 400th review goes to Cajun Kitchen! This review is long overdue and definitely worth mentioning. It is afterall one of our most popular spots in town for breakfast. 

I don't come here as often as I'd like, because the weekend is my preference to dine here, but that's when it gets really busy. Long lines and wait time, no thank you. I highly recommend coming here on a weekday if you can swing it. My son was craving beignets and their California benedict, and luckily it was on a weekday so I called in the order ahead of time. That would be the other option if you are coming here on the weekend and pressed for time. 

Outside dining is available in the parking lot, where a nice little parklet is set up. As of right now 6.15.21 indoor dining is also available with limited seating. 

The food was nicely prepared and still warm by the time I got home. I loved the beignets! I'm glad they didn't go heavy on the powdered sugar. They were lightly dusted and the warm strawberries n banana topping was excellent! 

My son also enjoyed his California Benedict and hash browns. As for me I didn't order anything on my latest visit here, but the meals I've had in the past have all been delicious. Looking forward to coming back sooner than later, now that I know their food to go is just as well prepared as dining at the restaurant.

I wanted to try Finney's a few times before writing my review and after my latest visit they really impressed me! So now I can rave about this cool hip Gastropub. 

The restaurant itself is located a block away from our beautiful beach and in the newly developed area close to the Funkzone. Definitely a tourist attraction! Our wait time was 15 min. and they provide a handy text message to inform you when your table is ready. Communal tables are available if you can find a spot. This place is really loud so be prepared if you are sensitive to noise, but they do have outdoor seating that might suit those who prefer it less rowdy. 

For drinks I've tried the spicy berry margarita during happy hour which was good but there was too much ice so I felt jipped after 4 sips and an empty cup for $9 bucks! The house margarita was my second choice on my first visit and well worth $5. The cucumber cooler is very refreshing. I really enjoyed it and luckily they were easy on the ice this time! 

As for food my son ordered the Impossible burger which is true to its name! This burger is a plant based burger and let me just say you wouldn't even know it wasn't beef! Hence the name Impossible. This burger was amazing and my son devoured it. The pictures speak for itself! 

The flatbread pizzas are delicious! If you are a mushroom lover like me then I highly recommend ordering the mushroom & truffle flatbread. The mushrooms are nice and buttery and the portion size is huge! It definitely can feed up to 3 people unless you have a big appetite. I've also had the Margherita flatbread which had the perfect amount of cheese. 

Overall Finney's is a much welcomed addition to Santa Barbara. I look forward to going back to try more delicious food!

Jeannine's bakery is one of my favorite places for breakfast when I feel like splurging. I've been coming here for years and always leave satisfied. 

This bakery is family owned and that's the experience you get when dining here. They get pretty busy so if you're planning to dine here for breakfast I recommend coming early. Weekends are busier than weekdays I've noticed.

My most recent order was the breakfast club sandwich and let me just tell you this was pretty amazing! The ingredients were fresh and they didn't skimp on the smoked applewood bacon. I ordered mine on sourdough but they have several choices of bread to choose from. I could only eat half since it was a good size portion. Plus the potatoes so this will definitely fill you up! 

The scones are a must try! Made fresh daily and they offer many choices such as raspberry, lemon, pumpkin pecan, blueberry, strawberries & cream plus more! These are light, fluffy, and melt in your mouth. 

I've also had their white chocolate strawberry cake. This by far takes the cake and deserves an award. No lie it's that good! Give it a try.

Cappuccinos and Lattes are made by Martin who really takes pride in what he does so be patient if you order this cuz you will be waiting longer than you think.

First, come here with patience as the service tends to be very slow! Our waitress was ok at first but then she disappeared on us and I had to flag another waitress down. Maybe ours went on break or something but it was very rude to not be tended to!  

Aside from the horrible service here if you're looking to try something different away from all the other Mexican cuisine hot spots in town then give this place a try. 

This place is mostly known for their huge seafood cocktails, ceviche, and micheladas. 

I highly recommend the ceviche! You can order it several ways. They offer shrimp, fish, octopus, or a combo. My favorite is the fish or shrimp! Ask for tostadas on the side so it doesn't get soggy sitting underneath the ceviche. Add some tapatio and lime and you'll be in heaven. 

I haven't tried the shrimp cocktail but my cousin raves about it. 

I wanted to order something different this time so I opted for the Chile Colorado. This dish was flavorful but the meat was too dry! It tasted like the pork had been sitting around for awhile. I couldn't even eat more than a few bites. I would have sent it back if we hadn't been left high and dry for so long without service! So I finally ordered the fish ceviche to go once our waitress came back from her break. 

Micheladas - They are delicious but a little too salty for my taste. They overdue it with the salted rim so if you're on a low sodium diet then ask for no salt on the rim! The color is darker than most places. But it is flavorful.

Money Saving Tip - Do Not purchase any bootleg movies or CDs here! You might see a guy walking around trying to sell them to you but save your money and pass on that! 

Overall this place has great food if you know what to order. Give it a shot at least one time!

I've been looking forward to trying Mesa Burger ever since I heard it was led by Iron Chef Cat Cora. If you're lucky enough she will also bring the food to your table. Pretty cool to see her in person after watching her on the Food Network for many years.  

The Location is where Mexican Fresh Taqueria use to be if anyone is familiar with that area. They really did a great job in re-designing the whole place! It has a very beachy rustic feel to it. I like the open airy feel and the outside patio.  

I must admit when I first took a glance at the menu my first reaction was wow they are a bit pricey! But I didn't let that stop me from checking it out. I can honestly say after my burger experience here my meal was well worth the $16 I paid. So don't let the price detour you from trying this place. Give it a chance!

I went on my lunch break with my co-worker and we were greeted right away while waiting in line. I wish I would have gotten the name of the guy who was very kind and offered us a menu to look at while waiting in line. The whole staff was amazing and very attentive on our visit. Thank you guys! Keep up the great work. 

I decided to order the Funk Zone burger ($13) which comes with regular fries, but you can sub that with sweet potato waffle fries or onion rings for ($1) more. I decided to try the herb truffle & parmesan fries for ($2) more. 

My burger was amazing (10 stars)!! It was served with juices dripping from the burger stacked high with applewood smoked bacon. The bacon was to die for! I'm not a huge tomato person but the roasted tomatoes served on this burger were delicious. I didn't know where to start, do I cut this burger in half or do I just dive right into it? I went for it and just bit into the burger as much as I could since it was huge! Talk about a burgasmic experience. Hands down the best gourmet burger in town!!

The herb truffle & parm fries were delicious as well. At first glance it looked like a very small portion of fries served but I couldn't even finish them since the burger filled me up. My co-worker also enjoyed her meal and raved about the regular fries. She was happy I told her about mesa burger and is now a fan. 

It was nice to check out mesa burger and I look forward to going back to try the other burgers on the menu.

I finally had a chance to check out Convivo to experience their happy hour and it really left me impressed! Of course I have to share my experience and rave about the great prices they offer here. 

Happy Hour is everyday Mon-Sun from 3-6 pm! The location is right across the street from East Beach and offers a nice inside bar area and outside patio area as well with views of our beautiful beach surrounded by palm trees. 

The happy hour menu offers $5 cocktails, wine, and beer. These are great prices! Especially for the location. On my latest visit I tried their spicy margarita which really isn't spicy but the rim is salted with a spicy chile salt. Maybe Tajin? In any case it was really good and didn't taste cheap at all.

Some of the other drinks offered on the menu are: 

- Pinot Noir (2015 Canyon Rd)
- Chardonnay (2015 Ballard Ln)
- Cab Sauvignon (2014 Ballard Ln)
- Brut Sparkling Rosé (Wycliff)
- Longhammer IPA, Redhook
- Lager, Dos XX
- Orange Pale Ale, Sierra Nevada 
- Lager, Amstel light 
- Convivo Spritzer 
- Sangria 

The food menu is just as great with $5 apps and $8 wood oven pizzas. So far I've tried the polpette (lamb meatballs) which are flavorful and delicious served with a hummus sauce. The Coxinhas (chicken & fontina croquettes) were amazeballs! These seem to be a popular item to order as I seen them on everyone's table. Highly recommend you try them. The spicy soppressata salami pizza was a full sized pizza for only $8! It does have a spicy kick to it but in a good way. The fennel sausage pizza looked really good as I was eyeballing the people sitting across from us devour it. I'll definitely order that one next time! 

A special shout out to Juan who was our server and did an excellent job tending to us. It's always good to have a nice attentive waiter with a sense of humor. 

This is definitely a place worth checking out if you haven't already!

Word to the wise inspect your food before you take that first bite! It wasn't until my last piece that I noticed hair in my food. When I brought it to Shantee's attention who was the cashier her response was "So you don't want to finish that last piece?" I really didn't appreciate that she was trying to be funny with me especially when I just paid $14 for my food! I told her would you eat it with that piece of hair? I just wanted to bring it to their attention so the cooks would know. I really hope management reads this because that was not how my complaint should have been handled!

Despite that one mishap I will say that the food here is pretty good and I have yet to have a bad meal. Prices range from $12 and up but the quality of food is flavorful and the burgers are really good! I've had the Lama Dog Burger which comes with, cheese stuffed Anaheim chile, brown sugar candied bacon, romaine, tomato, and "special" house sauce, served on a brioche bun ($14). The Duck Foie Gras Burger ($18) is also a must try! I never thought I'd like such a thing as duck but this burger is sweet and savory served with a fig port wine marmalade, manchego cheese, and pear. 

The pork belly quesadilla is what I ordered on my latest visit and found the dreaded piece of hair! Aside from that this quesadilla is packed with delicious pork belly that melts in your mouth. Pair that with a side of their parmesan truffle fries and you have a great snack to munch on while sipping on some beer or wine from Lama Dog.

Overall The Nook is a place to check out if you're spending a day in the Drunk Zone oops! I mean Funk Zone and have the drunchies! This isn't a fast food joint and you will not find a full meal under $10 here so come prepared to spend some dough.

Anyone that's been to Freebirds knows how generous the portions are. I haven't been here in awhile since it's in the heart of college town aka Isla Vista. It can be very busy during school hours, but luckily it was like a ghost town on the streets and only a few customers were here during Christmas break. 

There's a small parking lot on site, otherwise you can park on the street, but they are mostly 15 minute zones. 

I am obviously a nacho lover, so naturally I come here for the nachos! When ordering, you start with tortilla chips heated up with melted cheese. Then you have endless toppings to add, such as beans, rice, grilled veggies, meat, pico de gallo, guac, sour cream and much more. By the time you pile on the toppings, the nachos weigh about 10 pounds! The serving will feed about 2-3 people, unless you have a big appetite. 

I remember the nachos used to be $12, but now they are $20! Times sure have changed, but at least they haven't skimped on the portions here. The burritos are just as good and the size is very hefty. 

I'm glad I could get my nacho fix in here, but it's definitely something I treat myself to occasionally.

As a local I don't come here as often as I'd like simply because i know they get very busy, but today I decided to check them out with my son and treat myself to a Mothers Day lunch. To my surprise the lower level part of Brophys was pretty empty and we were able to seat ourselves right away. 

I believe the lower level part of Brophys is more of a pit stop for drinks, lunch, and appetizers. The menu is very simple and it's not the same as the one in their restaurant above. I don't know if that means you couldn't ask to look at a full menu if you were looking to order something that's not offered on it. In any case we were happy to be seated right away, the service was good and our food came out quick! 

Best clam chowder in town! So believe the hype about that. We ordered the calamari which is also served with french fries and coleslaw. I'm not too fond of coleslaw but I must say it wasn't too bad. Fish and chips were delicious!

Come for the pastries not the food! Unfortunately on my latest visit I was left very unimpressed with my breakfast.  Not only was it overpriced but it was skimpy and tasteless. 

I ordered the 1 2 3 which comes with a slice of French toast, 2 eggs, and 3 slices of bacon ($13). When it was brought out the bacon was missing! I quickly pointed it out to the server and she looked very puzzled, but proceeded to head into the kitchen to get it. When she brought it out they shorted me a slice. Yet again another fail. 

My cousin ordered the eggs benedict ($13). It came with dry overcooked bacon, fruit and a baguette. Absolutely nothing special about it! My picture says it all. Where's the hollandaise? 

The pastries is what you want to come here for! They have the best almond croissants in town. I have yet to try the other pastries but they are beautifully displayed and I'm sure well worth the purchase. 

Even though my breakfast was a let down I might come back to try their lunch menu. I have the Axxess card and it's a BOGO offer. I'm all about a good discount! 

Overall great pastries but save your money and get a full breakfast meal elsewhere. I promise you will get more for bang for your buck!

I've been here several times and always left satisfied. The staff is warm and friendly and they make sure everything served is to your liking. 

It's very small inside with limited seating but very cozy. They do have outside dining which is always nice on a sunny day. They are located in the paseo nuevo outdoor shopping mall. 

I brought my son here for the first time and he loved it! He ordered the plain udon noodle soup. This came with broccoli and red peppers. I tried a sample of it and the broth was really good! I'll definitely be back for the spicy udon. 

I ordered the tempura Cali roll which I haven't tried yet and it was fantastic! Crunchy, warm, and full of flavor. I loved the drizzle of sauces on the rolls. They were a perfect compliment to the sushi. 

I've also had the Mexican roll before and chicken teriyaki bento box. Both satisfying. 

To be honest prices are pretty steep and that's why I don't come here as often as I'd like. But it's always a treat when I can splurge! 

Give this place a try if your in the mood for sushi after a long day of shopping.

I've been wanting to try this place for the longest time and luckily a Groupon was being offered at a great price so I had to take advantage of it. It didn't even occur to me on my first visit that it was a federal holiday so I wasn't able to use the Groupon but it did give me another excuse to go back a second time.

Les Service: From reading the reviews here on Yelp it seems to be a hit or miss with the service. On my first visit we had no issues with the service and it was ok, but on our second visit the place was pretty busy on a Sunday afternoon. There were two waiters when we arrived and everything seemed to be ok, until the second waiter disappeared into the kitchen leaving one waitress to tend to about 20 people. There were some complaints and I could see why so just FYI you may or may not have a good experience here with the service!

Weekday Specials: Crepe with 3 ingredients, soup or salad for $10.95

Kid Friendly: Yes, there are always kids in here and they seem to enjoy it.

Les Restroom: Yes, they have a small closet sized restroom.

Les Crepes: My son ordered a dessert crepe the first time we came here and it had bananas, chocolate syrup, and vanilla ice cream. It was pretty yummy! On the second visit he ordered the Lyonnaise (turkey, tomatoes, mushrooms, and béchamel sauce); when I think of a crepe I think of a nice golden brown color but these crepes have a weird look to them. They are greyish in color and have a spongy look to them. Maybe this is what an authentic French crepe really looks like? Beats me! In any case my son still cleaned his plate so that tells you it's kid approved!

Les Sandwich: The Chamonix (Turkey, bacon, avocado, tomato, mayo) this sandwich is served on a fresh warm baguette. I really like this sandwich but the only thing it lacks is turkey. They really do skimp on that so my suggestion would be to ask for extra turkey and hopefully you won't be charged extra for it! This sandwich also comes with mixed greens, nothing special about it but you do get a squeeze bottle of their delicious balsamic vinaigrette to top it off. The dressing is delicious!! 

Escargot: My 10 year old son wanted to order these out of curiosity. They smelled  delicious when they arrived at our table (buttery-garlic). It's also served with slices of French bread to soak up the garlic butter sauce. Yet another kid friendly approved dish! 

Overall I would recommend to give this place a try for a unique dining experience in the French cuisine.

I wish I could rave about the food here but sadly there is not much to rave about. Sure there are a few things on the menu which might satisfy you but I honestly feel it is overpriced here for what you get. The one thing that always disappoints me yet I continue to try and try again are the cocktail drinks from the bar menu. I like to try a new drink every time and it never seems to please me. On this last visit I tried to the Spicy Guava Rita which was pretty flat in taste. It sounded good on the menu but it sure didn't leave me impressed and it sure didn't taste like a well crafted cocktail. I've had better! 

For food I decided to order the mixed seafood grill ($17) which comes with two sides. I opted for french fries and clam chowder. The clam chowder was creamy and rich in flavor which I've had here before and never been disappointed with it. When my main meal arrived it was served on a huge white plate with a side of french fries. My initial reaction when I had seen the skewer was pure disappointment. Just take a look at my picture and you will agree this meal was definitely not worth $17!!! Sure it's fresh seafood but the portion size was nothing but a joke. Even my son was laughing at the portion size. If anything this mixed seafood skewer should be on the appetizer menu!

I do recommend the creamy Lobster Bisque with puff pastry, but if you plan on eating this on your own then I suggest ordering a cup versus a bowl as it tends to be very rich and decadent. 

If you want to check out their happy hour I would say give it a go before coming here for lunch or dinner unless you have no budget and can afford to splurge on seafood. Happy hour is Mon.- Fri. from 4-8pm and Sunday from 5-10pm.

The next time I come here to dine it will only be when Groupon is offering a discount. They usually offer a $30 promotional value for $18 from what I recall and sometimes you can get it cheaper for around $14 after using a local discount code when it is being offered. So be sure to check out Groupon if you're thinking about dining here as it will save you some money!

Overall I'm sorry to say I will not return here to pay full price for a lunch or dinner meal when there are plenty of other seafood restaurants in town where I will get my money's worth.

Empty Bowls has proven to be one of the best Thai restaurants to dine at in the Public Market since day one. I've seen many restaurants come and go at the public market which is sad but I'm very happy that empty bowls is still going strong! 

The food here is always made fresh to order, and the customer service has been excellent. I usually take my order to go but on my last visit I brought my family here visiting from out of town and we decided to dine in. If you're lucky to get a seat at the bar you will be entertained by the chefs preparing and cooking their food. There's plenty of seating elsewhere in the public market if you can't get a seat at the bar.

My favorite is the Tom Yum noodles with chicken, but I also like the Hangover noodles as well. Both are spicy but you can request to have it cooked on the mild side if you can't handle the heat! I love spicy food but if it's too spicy I can't enjoy my meal while my mouth is on fire lol, so I prefer to order it without any spice. I usually doctor it up with their chili provided on the side so I can control the spice level.

I've had the pad thai here but it wasn't for me since it was a little too sweet. I guess that's what pad thai is supposed to be but it wasn't to my liking unfortunately.

I still need to explore more on the menu such as the Bangkok noodles, summer rolls, pot stickers, soups, and salads. This is definitely a place for delicious comfort food! Looking forward to visiting again soon.

Believe the hype about this place! I've been wanting to come here after reading my fellow yelper Jen N.'s review. I originally intended to try the Little Piggie sandwich but opted to try the Gyro instead since I love them and the last time I had one was summer of 2014 at the Greek Festival here in town. Does this Gyro compare? Heck yeah and then some!! I can totally see why everyone raves about it.

The pita bread was very fresh, soft and the right size to hold the tons of sliced lamb & beef they put inside. The tzatziki sauce is housemade and very delicious! You add the tomatoes, cucumber, onions and you have one bomb diggity gyro!!

The Service: From the moment I walked in the door I was greeted and continued to be greeted by every single employee that was working, now that's what you call great customer service! They even offered me a menu and also asked if I had any questions but I already knew what I came for.

The Menu: They have a great selection of Hot/Melty, Cold, Fancy Pants, and Custom sandwiches to choose from. Salads and Side items are also available.

Beverages: Soda, juice, water, and I think wine are available but I could be wrong and they might just sell wine here but they do have a small section to check out.

Credit/Debit: Yes, they take both.

Indoor/Outdoor Seating: They have a small area to eat indoors and patio seating outside.

If you haven't tried this place yet then I suggest you put it on your list of food places to try out! I promise you won't be disappointed.

This spot is my go to when I'm in the area. The nachos are delicious! I can tell the beans are homemade and they totally remind me of how my great grandmother used to make hers. 

On my latest visit I tried their flying burrito with charred steak. It was filled with rice, beans, cheese, and plenty of meat! Usually burritos lack meat but not this one. 

I've also had their chicken quesadilla but It wasn't as good. I was expecting the chicken to have that charred flavor but it was pretty bland to me. I would order the steak instead next time. 

The salsas are delicious! If you want a spicy salsa then be sure to ask for it. They only give you the milder ones unless you specifically ask for hotter salsa. 

There is limited seating inside and a few tables outside. 

Customer service here is quick and to the point. Overall a good spot to pick up some quick and delicious food!

Welcome back Corazon Cocina! I've missed you dearly. 

The food is just as amazing as I remember it to be and the presentation is just as beautiful. So glad you guys are keeping up with your unique style! Chef Ramon is a master at what he does.

All the tacos are served on a homemade corn tortilla. Not only are they delicious but they are the perfect size, thickness, and holds up very well when eating your taco. Never gets wimpy! 

Let's talk food! 

Here is what I ordered:

Chicken mole taco - The rich dark mole was slightly sweet, nutty and just a tad spicy. I added the peanuts from the salsa bar to give it that extra crunchy nutty flavor. Try it! 

Ensenada taco - Crispy beer battered cod served with cabbage, radish slices, and a mayo lime crema; which my son didn't want so it's not pictured. But he loved the fish tacos! I've had them before too and they are crunchy and yummy. 

Al Pastor taco - The meat was perfectly marinated and the pineapple pairs well giving it a nice sweet and salty taste. They don't skimp on the meat here! 

Quesadilla de Mercado - Not your average quesadilla and by far the best quesadilla I've ever had! Served on a blue corn tortilla with a nice thick slice of seared panela cheese and beautiful fresh market veggies. A true picture perfect masterpiece. The presentation was flawless! I shared half with my son and he was wowed by it too. 

Yes the food is on the pricey side but the quality, care, and effort put into making the food is well worth it to me and there is no other place in town that compares to Corazon! They truly are one of a kind and the food is made from the heart. 

I can't wait to go back and try more. Keep an eye out for the pulpo (octopus) taco when available! This will blow your socks off.

I will cut right to the chase! Do yourself a favor and DO NOT eat here!! 

I can only say thank you to the new waiter in training the night we ate here. He was very apologetic about the almost 2 hour wait for our food. I asked him if he could bring us some french fries or anything to tide us over and he did just that. He brought us a small order of nachos on the house. The tortilla chips tasted stale but we didn't care since we were starving to death! Yes we should have just left but we stuck it out. I will never eat at this place again! Pretty sad.

Mony's left me unimpressed the first time I came here having tried the tacos al pastor, asada, and chicken. Maybe it was a bad day but the meat was very dry. Even with toppings it still didn't work. 

After my latest visit I can honestly say they are one of the best Mexican spots to check out here in the 805! They were also featured on the Cooking Channels "Taco Trip" with chef Aaron Sanchez. Some of my fellow Yelpers were lucky to be filmed and made a cameo on the show too! Pretty awesome :) 

I finally had a chance to try the chicken mole combo. For $10.75 you get a generous portion! It comes with beans, rice, warm corn tortillas, and lots of chicken covered in their delicious mole. Totally reminds me of how my great-grandma use to make hers. I can't wait to try the mole enchiladas! 

The barbacoa is a must try! Whether it's in a taco, torta, or just get the barbacoa plate. Trust me you won't be disappointed. By far the best meat I've had!! They've nailed it here with how they marinate it and the seasoning is perfect. The meat is super tender and juicy. Yessss get this!! 

They have a great salsa bar with some unique choices. My faves are the creamy avocado, peanut, and salsa verde. They also have a pistachio salsa but I love the peanut one! 

Be sure to put this on your list of restaurants to check out if you're ever in the Funk Zone or just planning a day visit here. It will be worth your time.

Mandarin Palace has impressed me lately with their affordable lunch specials so naturally it deserves a good review! I honestly hadn't stepped foot in here for many years because it just didn't appeal to me anymore but thanks to my co-workers wanting to come here for lunch I've become hooked on it again.

The lunch menu prices are mostly $10, and for the amount of food you get when dining here it's totally worth it! I've called in my order and taken it to go but honestly if you dine-in you get way more food which includes their soup of the day, salad, crispy wonton chips, and hot tea upon request. 

The service here has always been good to us, and the food is served in a reasonable amount of time so you're not going to be rushing if you only have an hour lunch. It's never been so busy that you can't be seated right away. 

I've read mixed reviews on this place and depending on whether you're dining here for lunch or dinner I guess it varies, but my experience has been good overall so no complaints here! I'm no expert on Chinese food but this place serves up delicious food in my opinion.

Tri-Tip Sliders: Unfortunately the trip-tip sliders looked better than they tasted. The meat was cut too thick and made it difficult to eat without the slider falling apart. Some of it was kinda chewy and tough. I remember the meat use to be thinly sliced, don't know what happened! 

Parmesan & Truffle Fries: They had a generous amount of Parmesan. I couldn't really taste the truffle oil but I could definitely taste the garlic! Overall these were pretty good. 

Blackened Chicken Salad: The chicken was perfectly grilled and seasoned. This salad has a lot of crunch with the jicama added and it's a light refreshing salad to eat on a warm day. But it's not worth $14!

Tip: They take the Axxess card and it's Buy one Get one Free entree with 10% disc. thereafter 
 
Overall this is a great place to chill at down in the Funkzone. It's very laid back and relaxing. They have a unique variety of mixed drinks to choose from as well as beer and wine. 

They provide indoor/outdoor seating with a nice patio area located in the back. 

I give this place 4 stars even though I was disappointed in the sliders. The atmosphere and staff make up for it.

Come for the entrées not so much the appetizers!

It gets pretty loud inside and the seating is a bit cramped. If you're not into yelling at your company then I highly recommend grabbing a table on the front or back patio. 

Service wasn't the greatest this time. One waitress tending to about 15 people on the back patio. She did her best regardless! 

I've had a full meal here before but this time me and my friends just shared appetizers. I regret not ordering a burger or pizza! 

Sausage Bites ~ These were pretty good served with sautéed peppers. I'd order these again! 

Pretzel Bites ~ Served with cold cheese dip (suppose to be warm) and grainy mustard. The pretzels didn't taste very fresh and they were hard. No bueno 

Brussels Sprouts caramelized with bacon + an egg ~ They were not caramelized but more watery. The taste was bland even with the bacon added. I've had better! 

Mac n Cheese ~ Yes! Order this. Creamy and cheesey. 

Parmesan Fries ~ They were decent. Cheese was stuck together and kinda cold but the flavor wasn't bad.

My favorite meal is the Black and Bleu burger! I'm not a fan of bleu cheese but the taste is very mild and this burger was cooked perfectly! Great flavors mixed well together. 

The roasted pepper pizza is also yummy! 

Overall I would come back, but again for an entrée. Luckily they take Axxess card and you get two for one appetizers or beer! 

I would have given 4 stars if the service and appetizers were better. Hopefully they can can improve on that!

Creamistry has finally arrived in Santa Barbara and is one of the more unique ice cream places you will find in town. Why? Because they make your ice cream from scratch using liquid nitrogen. It's pretty fascinating to watch so break out your cell phone to capture the moment while you wait in line.

There are several options in choosing your base (signature premium, organic, vegan non-dairy coconut, or non-dairy sorbet). On my visit I decided to try the vegan non-dairy coconut as my base. This is what they use to make the ice cream. 

I ordered the Strawberry Bond which comes with fresh strawberries, cheesecake bites, and whipped cream (optional). If I had to do it all over again I wouldn't get the whipped cream since it was masking the flavor of the ice cream. I ordered vanilla but I still didn't get much flavor from it. The ice cream itself is very creamy and silky but I didn't like how it melted fast. 

The price of the strawberry bond came out to $10+ so this is not cheap ice cream! It's definitely not a place I would frequent often but on occasion when I have extra money to splurge this will be a nice treat. 

The "Official" grand opening will take place on July 7th. 

Customer service was great and I appreciate the manager coming around asking if everything tasted ok.  Overall this is a nice addition to State Street, and I do look forward to going back to try something else when I have extra money to burn.

Islands is a great addition to La Cumbre Plaza. I'm so glad we have another option to dine at in this area. Hopefully this chain restaurant will be a survivor and keep serving good food. 

The staff here was very welcoming and our waiter Matthew did a great job tending to us throughout our visit. The restaurant itself has been transformed into a beachy tropical vibe and the patio area looks great! 

For my order I couldn't decide between the Malibu burger which has applewood smoked bacon or the Hula burger with mushrooms. Thanks to my friend we decided to split the burgers and share that way we had the best of both worlds! 

The Hula burger was my fave! They didn't skimp on the shrooms and it was full of flavor, juicy and delicious. Get the wheat bun! 

The Malibu was served picture perfect but It was loaded with too much raw onion for me which i had to take out, but if i order this again I'd ask for grilled onions. I didn't realize it only had mustard and no mayo. I'm not a huge mustard fan but overall the burger was still good and I'm glad i could try it. The fries were just ok but they are bottomless so that's a plus! 

For drinks we had the Mai Tai and I have to say this was the best Mai Tai I've had thus far. It wasn't too strong as they tend to be and it wasn't overly sweet. It was made perfectly! I especially loved the crushed ice. They have Mai Tai Tuesday specials for $5 bucks! Regular price is close to $10 so take advantage of that special. 

Happy Hour on the weekday is 3pm-6:30pm an extra half hour  longer than Lure and starts again at 9pm to close. The outside patio area also includes happy hour prices. 

Overall I had a great experience here and only time will tell if the service will remain 5 Stars and the food served as fresh and delicious as it was on my first visit. Looking forward to my next visit to try more items on the menu.

It's the little things in life that make us happy right? Well this bakery does just that! After trying their cupcakes at a birthday event, I immediately wanted more. I love desserts, but if it's overly sweet then it's not for me. By far these cupcakes are the best that I've ever had! I've pretty much tried every flavor they offer and they are all equally delicious. The ingredients are top quality, and the amount of sweetness is just right. They are light, airy and melt in your mouth. I love that they offer the cupcakes in mini form or whole, so if you want to try all of them, then the mini cupcakes are perfect for sampling. They make these daily, so you don't need to order them unless you want a specific flavor or amount for a special event. 

After eating the cupcakes, I knew that I would order my son's birthday cake from this bakery. I placed my order online, which was very simple to do, but the hard part was choosing the flavor of cake, filling, and icing. Mind you, my son likes any cake so I knew whatever cake I ordered he would be happy with. I decided to order the 6-inch mocha cake with Bavarian cream filling, fresh strawberries and whipped cream icing. I was able to customize the cake online by choosing a decoration, color, and wording. Due to COVID times, and not being able to have large gatherings we had a safe celebration at home. Hence the reason for keeping the cake décor simple.  

The cake was perfect in every way! The whipped cream icing was not too sweet, the mocha cake was moist and flavorful, and the filling was creamy and light. This is the type of cake you could eat without your teeth hurting from the sugary sweetness of a typical store-bought cake. 

I will definitely be ordering from here again, and now that I've written this review I am craving their cupcakes ha ha.

I don't come here as often as I'd like simply because of the location. This place is located on a very busy intersection, and the parking lot sucks! Very limited spots and not to mention a tight squeeze. 

If you don't know the area then I recommend parking on the street but that's only if you're lucky to find a spot. Weekends are usually the best to get parking. 

Aside from that this place is a must try if you're craving authentic Mexican food! They offer burritos, tacos, sopes, alambres, etc...

My fave has to be the chicken Tinga sopes which is shredded marinated chicken and the gorditas! The sope and gorditas are both handmade with masa. What I love about them is the thickness is made just right and not too much. I can actually finish them without being overly stuffed. 

I've also had the chicken taquitos plate which was a good deal under $10! Very yummy and satisfying. 

The carne asada burrito was good but the amount of meat was lacking yet again! Another restaurant that skimps on the main feature. 

Overall this place is legit and I look forward to trying more items on the menu.

Finally we have a Pieology! After seeing all my fellow Yelpers posts since practically the beginning of 2016 it's no surprise the 805 is late in the game but better late than never! 

Pizza is one of my favorite foods and I love trying new places like this where you can customize your own to your liking with unlimited toppings. Price for an individual is $8.45 not too bad and it's 11.5 inches. Serving is enough for two people unless you have a big appetite.

They offer white, wheat, and gluten-free ($2 extra) pizza dough. 

My first visit here was a good experience despite the slow service but I won't complain too much since they just opened. The ladies that helped me were kind and made sure the topping amount I chose on my pizza was good by checking with me. I really liked that so thank you ladies! 

I decided to go with a pesto sauce, mozzarella cheese, chicken, a sprinkle of bacon, tomatoes, roasted red peppers, and kalamata olives. Very different from a traditional pizza but it was jammin!
