Our main dish is the blackened grouper, shrimp and scallops. The scallops is sea giant scallops. Since we close to home of scalloping, it is big and great. The shrimp come in five pieces. The grouper is good quantity. I like the Cajun blackened they use. The other dish is lobster roll. This roll I am not recommended. It has the imitation crab meat and lobster meat. I rather they use full lobster. 

Service is a bit slow. It also can be a lot more attentive. Other than that, it is great restaurant.

The nowait online is good to put your wait list before arrive to the restaurant. It definitely a good help to know when your table is ready. Even with nowait check in. They also loss our reservation. Fortunately they back check it when we were there and give us next available. 

The restaurant is busy because they are the most affordable in Hyde Park. Many teenagers who live nearby are hang out at this place. This restaurant look like old dinner. It has the sixty look. You almost can feel the swing dance party is happen any time. 

The food is average compare to many dinner. I guess that have so many customer due to their affordability. We have order the grilled grouper and Goody goody cheese burger pox. The burger is just average. The grouper is good size but they are pan grilled not flame grilled. The fry come with is soggy. This is not a good fry. I believe the fired oil was not change over time and make the French fry soggy. 

Service is not there. Our waiter was missing for good period of time for our close up. Not sure is worth for the visit. However, been there done there.

Green food. Healthy for begin of year. Eco provide concept of future. Eat more power grain, green nutrition, natural lean protein and recycled and biodegradable product. This is great concept. I have been here many time. This is the first review. 

We were here for their great bowl. They have mahi mahi with Asian Chili sauce. This bowl I have never have before. I think is their best product. It has rice. I believe is brown or purple rice. The grain, citrus, onion and more. The mahi mahi was grilled perfection. I like the way they have the sauce that match the dish. It is a great dish that I would recommend. 

I also like their juice. They said the building is use 50% reusable energy. Monday is the meatless bogo day. Atmosphere is good. Food come out a bit slow if you order required cook dish. I don't mind.

Fast food in restaurant setting. 

The restaurant is big with a lot of seating. When it was just open, it is almost like the attraction of the Brandon. It has nice deco in the interior. It still busy even now. Now is not like pack crazy. 

I am just wants to get the experience of it. We have the fried halibut, grilled tuna sandwich and chocolate cake. The halibut do not impress me. It is a small sandwich compare to Burger King or McDonald fish sandwich. The grilled tuna is excellent with taste. The chocolate cake that day is not moist but it has the softness and good mix of cake. 

Overall, they are average. They do have a lot help on kitchen. However, the food still take 10 minutes. Compare to many fast food, they are considered slow to deliver.

Newly open restaurant. Second day in business. Hip place with sushi bar. The surrounding has not fully open for business but this restaurant is ready. It is located at Causeway Blvd. it is easy to access from the I-75 exit SR 60 take Falkenburg South and right to Causeway and they are on the north side. 

The building is new and the so do all the interior is new too. The menu price is at medium range. We started Tako Yaki. It come with 5 pieces to share. Good coating and round as you seen in Japan street food. We also has six pieces of yellowtail scallions sushi. Good enough meat. The Chicken Karage is crispy. Good coating. May be a little salty may help. 

Our main course are the Kiwami Ramen - Tonkotsu Ramen. Good enough pieces of charshu. Very good porch egg with flavor. Their pork broth is at the light side. This is their style. I like the most is their Kiwami Torch. It is spicy king crab top with torch white tuna. Very flavorful. 

Food come out quick. Service is good. I give them an A for just open and paid attention to detail. It is about 4.5 stars restaurant. Since the quantity is is less for ramen and chicken Karage, it is 4 stars.

Review 499. Closing the 400 series review, I have chosen the Italian market since they are true 5 stars location in my book. It has been honor to write this review to be one of my best 400 series review. The Italian market become my joy to visit or pick the items before go to picnic. 

Lunch here certainly is a must if you visit old St. Pete downtown. This market not just makes you forget you are in America, it feel like shopping in Italy. Everything is so real and fresh. We have a chance to visit this market for a test drive and we fall in love immediately. 

Not only this market have hot sandwich, it have hot Italian sandwich. Most "Italian" sandwiches I have is cold. This hot Italian sandwich is the best seller in the sandwich menu. We have pick up couple slices of seared tuna and couple pieces of scallops. They help us heat up the scallops in oven and eat at their garden dining area. 

They have many tasting station. They even include wine and cheese room. Try some of the cheese there. Mamamia. They are good. Instead of you read about my review. You need to experience yourself.

This Evo serve the Soho neighborhood. It is healthy choice for the people. However the shop is kind of empty when we visited. Not sure this neighborhood is up to the healthy food. 

We got Mediterranean Lemon Chicken. This dish is a bit plain. The chicken is well cooked but lemon grilled is just average. I like their mahi mahi better. 

Food come out quick. Basically is warm. But I like to be hotter. Not much service. I always like their air fries. It is crispy.

English Tavern, Queen Guard, Lion, and Englishmen. You can find all this thing here. This is my second visit. I still love the ambiences. It feel like pub in England. I can bet you any premier league soccer game must be fill up. 

I am here for their special came ridge wings. Those are the great wing to have. It is bake, then grilled.  The marinated sauce is awesome. 10 wings for $13. Each wing is about $1.3. It is at the high side in price. But still love it.

I like this Mill location in compare to the one in St Pete. This place is a lot larger with plenty of parking. It is important to have parking at soho area. As a result it is major plus. The new space also have large bar area. We were there for the happy hours. It was our fourth stops. 

The happy hour menu is simple. But it is good enough to enjoy your time here. Our group order the Crispy Buffalo Brussels, Watermelon Bruschetta, and Swedish Meet Ball. I don't like the Brussels that much. May because it is Buffalo which involves sour vinegar. I like the Watermelon Bruschetta the most. It has good cheese with chop watermelon. The meat ball also good. 

I like my drink with Basic Beach Cocktails. It is refreshing. Our bar tender has to serve on table to cover the late colleague and leave us not much of attentive service.

It was great that I revisit the restaurant since we have a bad experience in the first time. A lot of things have been changed. We were here after late night movie. 

A lot of improvement has been made. Food come out a lot faster. The noodle was prepared correctly not glue together. I have order the devil spicy ramen. It is spicy not super spicy. The soup is still salty. The egg need a bit work - over cook. The noodle need some sesame oil to make flavor better. 

Overall is good. It is big improvement.

Yelping #1300. This one go to the local restaurant that has very good potential. 

Ebisu is new and up coming Sushi restaurant. 8/5 will be their anniversary. They have special for the night. The celebration included live band, special dish, freebies and discount. 

We arrived one day before their anniversary. We got here a little after 5 pm. We were the second group of the day. This place is popular after we have sit down. Many have followed. The menu did not has an spectacular wording to attract you. We have order the early bird special. The special is classic roll buy one get one half off. We have order the spicy tuna, negihama yellow tail, unakyu eel cucumber, Mexican fried shrimp avocado. This roll are fresh and well prepared. 

We also order the Salmon Oyako Don - salmon sashimi with salmon roe and rice. The salmon was very fatty and good. We also got the special of the day, the fatty tuna sashimi. Wow. What a good piece of tuna. Very rich and nice. 

The reason they are true 5 stars is because their quality of the fish is top grade in compare to many Japanese restaurant. It definitely worth the money.

The restaurant open for sit down during pandemic. But I see a lot of take out on the take out table. I also got take out. The restaurant has patio seating since they are at the corner of the building. 

We got the garlic pepper squid and Siam noodle. The garlic squid did cook the Thai hot that I was asking. It has good sauce. But the squid feel like previous frozen food and defrost and cook. The quality is not quite there. I also feel their wok technique is not there too. May be is off day. The Siam noodle is a bit better. However the noodle seem like not cook to high BTU burn edge. If the noodle done that way, I can do it at home. 

This is about 2.5 stars restaurant. The items they can improve is improve their overnight food frozen technique and longer wok time to get the high BTU effect. My order was on time to pick up and they are ready.

This restaurant don't even need to show the name at the restaurant location. The only sign on the front of the restaurant is PUB. You cannot imagine that was enough to attract a lot customers. The secret is the food was awesome and creative. Usually pub has less women customers. But this pub mostly women. That tell the food here is the main reason. 

If you come here I recommend you to look at the chalk board outside before you enter. These are the chef special. They change so often. These items are the best. We have the three pig piggy. It is sandwich either three different way of pork. Grilled pork belly, fried pork, and ham. It was delicious. The fried coated pork is crispy. The side of potatoes tots also crispy. 

Our second dish is the duck flatbread. It is another creative item. Who thought the grilled duck breast over the flatbread with mozzarella cheese and arugula. I like this dish. Only these season. It may not be next time. 

It was great to open my 2400 series review with these pub that many people love. My wife usually don't like pub and this is an exception.

We have brunch here during one of the Sunday. I like beach community restaurant because of the Pass A Grille beach. This restaurant is basically at the Main Street. The restaurant decorated modern contemporary. Decoration color mainly white. 

We have group of people. I got the eggnog waffle that top with strawberry and syrup. The waffle also come with the roasted walnut. This dish is decent. I also has the bowl of soup with southern clam chowder. Not much of clam. And the clam is tiny. My friend order the tuna melt. It was not melt at all. The cheese still at the room temp shape. Never melt. Then why call tuna melt. 

Service is a bit slow here. I would give them an average among the restaurant.

Caffeine is an Internet cafe. Many of the customers hang out there with computer. May be school homework to work as group.

The cafe is comfortable. It has a nice set up. They serve some interesting signature ice coffee. I got the Ice Caramel Delite. It is $4.5 for about 12 oz. for ice coffee that size is considered on the high side for the price. Most ice coffee serve in 16 oz due to ice was added at 70% of entire cup. With 12 oz. you will have less coffee in it. 5 big sip and all gone. 

The coffee is good taste. Especially the caramel in it at the bottom. It interesting to have that. The coffee is very concentrated which after the ice melt, I still like to drink on it.

This cafe is busy during the Friday lunch. I found a place at the bar since I am solo during lunch. The bar area is where they keep all the sauces. So I can pick any sauce I want for my sushi. I am here because of my yelp friend Mel said lunch here has deal and they are good.

Friday lunch is busy. I got their lunch special sashimi. It has 12 pieces slide. The tuna and salmon slice is thick pieces. The yellow tail is thinner but at lease they provide it with masago. The white fish I don't know. These slices lay on white radish. It is actually good deal for $12. It come with choice of side with miso soup or salad. 

The sushi chef is very fast paste. They can roll out the sushi is great speed. The have 4 people in the small space counter but able to work on the tight place. Talking space management, they have good one plus a lot servant.

Good restaurant. They have promising future. This restaurant is about 4.5 stars in my book. Not yet 5 stars. They have 5 dollar pho night. Service is good and attentive. We were here and find out many people waiting on the line try to get in. Very popular place. We were lucky to have two seat at the bar when two other just leaving. 

I read all my friend review. Many have visited them a year or two years ago. You can see the most drop of the star is due to service. During our visit, the service is perfect and you can see improvement. The reason they are four stars now is their regular price is a bit in the high side in compare to many Vietnamese restaurant. That is the main reason not round up to 5 stars. 

Food. The restaurant has good beef noodle soup. The sou is the best to my expectations in Bay Area. The papaya salad is one of the best. We also order the crispy duck and papaya tiger shrimp fresh roll. Their roll only come in one compare to many Vietnamese restaurant. But their roll is a lot bigger than other place to make up two quantities. 

My experience is good. I will visit them when they have five dollars deal.

Yelping 1700. Rare Specialty Food no. 44. 

Sweet Soul is new and coming special dessert shop that have variety of great item to offer in South Tampa. I am glad that make good use of that space. Have you heard about bee pollen, goji berry, hemp seed. This is the healthy food that serve in food conscious store. 

They have ACAI bowl, frozen yogurt. We were here for the frozen yogurt. Before we come, our friend already recommended this place. I am joining their train to recommend other to try their food. Their yogurt flavor is interesting. They have charcoal vanilla, chocolate, and some time mocha. I was never try charcoal vanilla. It is black color in very good way. I would recommend to go for the bowl instead of cup. Because the give 2 bases, 3 toppings, and one dusting. 

Guess what we have charcoal vanilla and. Chocolate swirl. The base is raspberry and dragon fruit. The toppings is bee pollen, ginger sugar, and mocha cookie. The dusting is agave sweet syrup. This combination is exquisite. The moment you taste it, you love it immediately.

Authentic Ethnic Food No. 48 Thai Cuisine.

The food is ver good and very street vendor like food. We got the steam pork dumplings, as an appetizer which is good. The dish I like the most is the drunken noodles. This dish you actually need them to make it spicy level they like to eat. Because the call drunken in spicy chili. The other dish I like is Pad See Ew. This dish they cook dark soy sauce. But I like they way they prepared the veggies in the noodle. 

We have ventured to try their Panang Curry. It is coconut milk curry and it is very good. The other dish we try is their special glass noodle with pork. I am said this is average dish. 

Since this is food truck, you can call earlier for your order. They are out door dining so wear proper cloth for the weather that day.

Chuy is new Tex Mex in the Wesley Chapel. They have the new building that design into their requested ambient. The interior decoration includes the Elvis 60 style set up. The space is beautiful. It is comfortable. 

One best thing about this place is the price and food quantity. This I no doubt the generous restaurant we have seen in Wesley Chapel. A lot of items have good value. 

For the taste is what they need to improve on. I feel they lack of taste. We got the steak fajitas. It come with 3 flour taco. It has guacamole, cheese, salsa, sour cream, rice, and caramel onion. The second dish is the combo special with taco and green enchilada. 

Service is average. Food come out to the table on time. I did not try the drink. We don't need to wait for the table when we get to the restaurant.

My revisit is much better. It still has kink on the tuna protein. May still need to make sure the tuna is good to serve. All other proteins are excellent. This restaurant is improving to better. Management is paying attention to the customers suggestion. 

We went through the as it has stated beyond this line is 8 minutes to eat. It is accurate to keep the line moving and limiting number of bowls per person. This is a successful operation on the line que to sit down. 

The bowl was improving from my last visit which I can see the bottom of the bowl. This time they fill up the bowl with food. The quantity has been met. 

I like the steak and the BBQ chicken. The glass noodle is the best if you choose the base. The add on is great too such as the guacamole and the plum tomato.

This restaurant has good authentic use of Indian spice along with fresh ingredients to prepare the food. This very sum up of this review. It is close to 4.5 stars for the way they have prepared the food. I like is very much. The reason they are 4 stars is the quantity they have served in the dinner time. Their portion is small for the dinner. But some people just eat a lot of rice with curry sauce. 

If I come to the buffet, I may have rate them 5 stars. We have the Fish Molee and the Beef Malabar Curry. The fish is Basa and fried first before the curry. Love the turmeric, green chili, ginger and coconut milk. This is a good dish to enjoy because the coconut curry is out of the wold. 

The beef malabar is good spice. We east the meat and take the sauce home. It is still good to enjoy with the rice. The spice is deep touch with nice medium spicy curry.

It was good to have a brewery so close to downtown and very close to waterworks park. You may think the parking is a problem but they have designated lot for the brewery across the street. Easy access. 

This is a locally craft beer. They do have some interesting beer. Including kumquat and orange crush. These are the local fruit that make good use in the local brewery. Good thinking to represent the local. Do you know we have kumquat festival in Dade City. 

Deja Moo Nitro has some exquisite taste for dark beer. The peanut butter Deja Moo is interesting. They have some beer I will try on next visit. They also has sour beer such as Sakura. There is a name of the beer call ginger mullet. Actually no ginger or mullet. 

The deco is contemporary. So good art work. Mostly high top chair. You can order your food in to enjoy your beer.

I like my time here. I would say this not a true 5 stars restaurant but very close to 4.5 stars. The place is cute. Two dining rooms setting. I was not going to have the high expectations. They have very good lunch special Monday to Friday. Approximately $9. Great deal. 

I did not go for the lunch special and go straight to one of their best dish. The cuisine is very similar to Black Forrest Germany cuisine when I have visited the Germany. I got the Schweinshax'n (pork Shank). It come with sauerkraut and bread dumplings. The sauerkraut was excellent. The dumplings is interesting that come as a cake pieces. 

The shank is braise and over roasted. They have lite seasoning outwardly. It is a big chunk. Great for hungry people. The pork sauce is great accompanied the bread dumplings and the pork shank. 

While I visited there, many have order the lunch special. Definitely a go to menu for lunch.

I like this seafood and bar restaurant because they have reasonable price their dish. The restaurant has good amount inside seating and more seat at outside. They do have TV when there is game time. Cuisine type is American and Cajun. 

We were having a chance to try their special of the day. The sautéed mussels for $8. This diss come with good number of PEI mussels. It is sautéed in garlic tomato. Very nice sauce to go with bread for dipping. 

We also order the pop boy with fried oyster. It come with fried. The pop boy is big. It has 8 giant oyster. Good size. Seafood we have try is fresh. The beer is $2.5. Good buy. 

Our experience is good with the services. The food also comes out right on time. It was not busy on 11:30 am in the morning. Not wait for the table. Food has good quality.

I walk in this place try to compare with the one in Brandon. Surprisingly they were not busy at Friday night. I remember the Brandon location take about 4 months to slow down from crazy line to normal busy line. This place is not very busy at all as they told me on the phone when I call to check. The dog house is still there if you want to have the picture. 

We have coupon for a free fried. I have order the half slab baby back a la carts and fried halibut. The baby back is below average. The temperature is warm and is not right. It is dinner standard compare to many wood grilled place. The halibut is definitely disappointed. The fast food fish sandwich place can do better on the crispy coating than this place. The accompanying lettuce is soggy. All food temperature is not good other the fried is right.  The food delivery is way behind schedule. Too slow at a slow day. 

Am I going to return. No, done from my check list. Not even the coupon can bring me back.

Rare Ethic Food 8

This is a 4.5 stars restaurant. Since Yelp do not has half star. They are 5 stars. I was wanted to come to this place for a long time. It was too far from New Tampa. I have heard good thing about this place from many of my yelp's friends. 

The Korean cuisine here have some strong items are their best selling. We have Kimbap as appetizer. It is rice roll with meat, fish cake, sausage, veggie and more. It is good to start item.

We also has the bacon wrap scallop. This is the reason they have half star less. They have the bay scallop instead of sea scallop. 

We have lunch special with Beef Galbi. This is their best seller. The short rib was cook perfectly. The selection on the rib is very soft and tender. Good balance of seasoning. 

Overall service is very good. I would come back for their lunch with reasonable price.

Taco. Yes they do serve that. They also has the mixed in bowl. I would said the mixed in is not the the Mexican anymore. It is more into fusion. It is first new concept for the Mexican cuisine. 

I have order the bowl instead go to their taco. Actually I am not a fan of bowl here. The surrounding area already have many bowl systems restaurants. I got the two proteins with fried chicken and fried shrimp. I have guacamole rice and noodles as the base. The veggies are the Brussels sprouts and grilled broccoli. The topping is pineapple and cucumber cilantro. 

The restaurant did attract a lot young crowd. The bowl is just average for the quantity. I can see the bottom of the bowl. So it is not cheap either with the quantity they have. Good for quick lunch. Other than that, no wow factor.

Rare Ethnic Food #73. Ethiopian Cuisine. 

Queen of Sheba is the best African restaurant you can find in Tampa Bay. Love it. The mixture of the spice and taste is very harmonious good. Expect waiting for the food because is popular. The owner is very friendly. Treat you like her family.

We got the sampler to share and add a lamb tip. The sampler has three meats and three veggies. The three meats including two chicken and one beef. We add Queen Lamb Tip. All the meat is cook with different flavor. I like all of them. The lamb is good. I also like the veggies. Very good use of spice in each veggies to create the dish. Love the creativity of the veggies. You also can ask the share plate to be all veggies. 

The best way to eat it is by hand. Use the injera to pick up the food. My cheated with requested folk and knife. Which is not normally done.

I think it is a solid four stars restaurant. Why I have three because the food did not sit well in my stomach. Other than that. They are solid 4 stars. 

Engine No 9 is visible restaurant on the MLK. They have many famous burger type including the one with crawfish tail. I did not go for their strongholds. I got their entree item with Sriracha Salmon. This dish well presented. They have good pieces of salmon steak with skin. The salmon is seared. Top with bacon and onion rings. The bed is broccoli slaw with Thai chili sauce. It is very good. The presentation of the food is top the chart. 

The service is excellent and attentive. The price for the food is reasonable. The atmosphere is bar type. I would like to try their crawfish burger next time.

Very decent ramen place. The interior was nicely decorated to fit the customers comfort. The order started at the front door just like Japan Ramen restaurant. Buy your ramen at the machine and they will bring it out for you.

I like the decorations with the Japanese cartoon. One of the cartoons is if you bring your grandmother to the ramen place, there is a chance she will make the ramen cross stitch. Imagine that ramen sweater :). 

We have order the tonkutsu ramen. It come with two pieces of pork belly, two half of porch egg, bamboo shoots and mushrooms. I like the pork belly pan fried to crispy before adding to the ramen. Soup is good. I think if they use a bit pork bone to make the soup thicker is nicer. 

Overall our experience is pleasant. Love to come back to visit to try other item in the menu.

Chef Li open for takeout during pandemic. I happen to drove pass by and decided to give them a try since they got high mark from Christina review. The is close to sit down but available on take out. 

We order the grilled beef on the stick. I think this is the best value and best dish. They come in order of 4 or 8. It is go well with the red wine. The chef special shrimp and scallops, bird nest are are almost the same sauce. Except one serve over the fried bowl tortilla. It look pretty. The schezchuan tofu is a great dish. I got the small portion. The beef chow fun is tasty to have. I would recommend this dish also. 

Chef Li is basically a take out store Chinese food. The level of cooking is above than the average takeout place. Food and dishes is affordable.

About 4.5 stars. Not yet true 5stars. Love the smiling face of store owner. The waitress may need some training. Our order was corrected by the owner of the restaurant while the waitress took the inconsistent order. This is local popular place to be. Many come here to dine in. If not the take out is a lot and busy. 

We started with yellow tail roll. It is simple and good. The best is the special of the day. They have high grade yellow and salmon crudo. The dish have 4 slice of yellowtail and 4 slice of salmon. It top with different masago and bed with seaweed salad. It was delicious. 

We also has the tempura udon. The tempura was big by it own with fried shrimp. The udon also good. The food experience win us there. I would suggest look for the special at the wall. That will be your best choice.

Yelping No. 2000!!!

Rare Ethnic Food # 50. Russian and Ukrainian cuisine. 

This little restaurant just opens no long ago. I already like it very much. It is one of the kind in Tampa Bay Area. You have to experience it for it wonderful cuisine. The restaurant locates near USF which make sense for many Russian students study there. The day we have visited, not many customers. It need great word of mouth to spread a good news. 

The menu is simple and delicious. The display in the restaurant is nice with Russian doll. They have the bakery good next to the counter. The only thing I would complain is the chair is too tight. 

What is meaning of "Babushka". It mean triangular folded kerchief for head or it also mean grandmother. Many Russian doll has kerchief over it is part of long tradition. It also can mean your grandma kitchen. Take your pick. 

Our first dish we have order is the Borscht. This is a famous soup with meat, sautéed veggies and beet root. The beet make the entire soup red color. The soup is great during winter. It top with the rosemary. The second dish is Blinchiki. This is a tradition wheat crepe wrap the meat inside. Very unique in many way. 

Our third dish is the Russian dumplings. They have three different fillings inside the dumplings. The Lamb, Beef and Pork. We mixed the pork and beef with the soup base. I like the most is the pork. I would suggest order with soup options. The fourth dish is the Syrniki. This is a pancake made from cheese and wrap with meat options. I like this one too. 

Our fifth and final dish is the Kotlety. It is three minced meat croquettes with a side. We have chose Russian brown rice

Overall our experience have exceed our expectations. It was marvelous meal we have at the dinner. It deserves a 5 stars attention. I would said you may need to change your taste bud when you come to this place. Many items is less sodium. But the taste still there. Russian like to use the sour cream. But I don't.

This is the second Moonlight in the Pinellas Park. They open less than a month. The have the buy one get the second drink for 50% off until end of August. Not much time left for the promotion. 

The new Moonlight is about the same size of the first one. They several seating area. Only two people working on the drink. You may have to wait if the line in front of you have large order. They also serve finger food and simple meal plate for hot food. 

I got two smoothies with boba. The smoothies is $4.5 each and added boba is $0.59. Event with 50% off, I have to paid $8. I got the lavender and the taro smoothies with honey boba. The drinks are very nicely made. The boba amount is good quantity not the huge quantity. May be $0.59 for added on is a bit steep.

If you come drink is good. If you come for food, this may not a good choice. World of beer surprise me that they serve food. However, the food come out of the kitchen is too slow. Menu do not have good choices. 

I got one of the special mojito. But I feel the cocktail is too light on the alcohol percentage. The drink feel like soft drink. Unless you go with their draft beer or bottle beer. Other than that, I not recommend their cocktails. 

We order three tacos for snacks, it take 30 minutes to come out. I think this area need big improvement. The shrimp taco save them one stars. If not it is 2.5 stars.

This is a truly five star restaurant. They deserve to be Yelp top 100 list. I think they should be top10. The restaurant is small. If you come in weekend, please reserve before you go. We were doing the spontaneous restaurant hopping. We were lucky to have the last two seats of the restaurant. 

When you walk into the restaurant, you will feel the festival atmosphere of Octoberfest.  The accordion music make it nice and pleasant. He play the familiar tune. I wish the whole restaurant can hold hand like we are in Munich and sing along with the beer on one side. The waitress is very beautiful and very nice. Love the super service here. They are from Munich. 

This restaurant serves the Bavarian region food of Germany and very similar to the food that we have visit in Black Forrest of Germany.  We have the Veal Schnitzel with mushroom sauce. It is delicious!!!! It come with two side. We have the handmade noodle Spaetzle and the hot potato salad. The potato salad has some ham crump to go with it. Hmmmmmm. Are you hungry now? Go enjoy a dish a meal here. I also have the import beer - Paulaner Octoberfest. It is good beer.

I like this bay looking restaurant. It is on the water. They have plenty of waiter and waitress. The time we have visited were Sunday lunch time at 11:00 am. It is a bit cold seat at the outside next to water for December. This is our first restaurant for progressive lunch. 

I got the grilled grouper sandwich with pretzels bun. The side we have the coconut rice. It was great. The grouper is fresh. They do give good pieces of grouper. We also has the lobster roll with sweet potatoes. The sweet potatoes were crunchy. The lobster is chunky and has less mayonnaise which show more lobster meat in the rolls. I like this way better. 

Our service is good. Food come out quick. We were able to finish our meal and paid less than 50 minutes.

I like the new establishment of Zukku. The new restaurant set up is beautiful with high ceilings with beautiful wall decoration. The chair also decorative and fit the entire restaurant interior. This is something they were not able to do at Armateurwork. I have to give them an A in the interior. 

They welcome us with expandable hot tower. It is a good show to begin the meal. We started with the Centipede roll. It is a spicy tuna top with hamachi. It look delicious but I think their spicy tuna need some work. May be mixed in the sesame oil and quail egg to mixed in will better. 

I do like grilled hamachi collard. It has good large pieces. The dressing is good and complemented the collard. We also has one chicken and one steak Yakitori. Those have good flavor. The bake mussels is the one I recommend and the have good topping and baked seasoning. 

I would said they expanded the appetizers very well. Service is good. It is about 4.5 stars. Not yet 5 stars.

About 4.5 stars restaurant. Close to 5. I like the food here. This restaurant really have a charm in Tampa Bay Area. A long history that survived for that long should have they secret of success. They do have one of the best court yards and party room. 

They cuisine is Mexico St Miguel region food. I got the Enchiladas Miguel. This dish top with St Miguel Enchiladas sauce is really good. Not sure where they mixed this sauce. But is really good. The grilled beef is great beef and good marinated in the Enchiladas. I would definitely recommend this dish at lunch. 

My wife have the Chile Relleno. This dish is interesting. It is Poblano Pepper fill with spicy pork. Basically you have to open up the pepper to see the spicy pork inside. Great presentation. 

For the appetizers we have the ceviche. Mexican ceviche is different than most Latin ceviche. It is shrimp and scallops toss with avocado, olives, cilantro with their homemade cocktails sauce. It does not use lime. Very interesting. 

Service just good. May be need more attentive. My waiter is too busy on other table. Sign of area need improvement.

Liang is an old restaurant in New Tampa. I have been here several time but was not give them a review. The restaurant is popular by American Chinese Food. I mean better than normal take out but not authentic enough to call traditional Chinese food. Most dish is more into sweet side. 

We have their lunch special orang chicken and black pepper beef. The orang chicken is their best dish. Good orange peel flavor. The accompanying can have a choice white rice, brown rice or fried rice. Their fried rice is a better choice. It also come with a choice of soup and we got the egg drop. The pepper beef is just like most take out Chinese food. Good beef. 

One thing for sure they did it correctly is their packaging. It is air tight and not spilling out. Good container system. The restaurant is about 3.75 stars. It can survive for long time certainty has it client tail.

If you are hungry and have less than $10 in your pockets, you may want to consider this place. The place is small, but it has street food written all over it. We came here for a memorial crawl. It is definitely a good stop for our stop. 

We order the signature crazy Burrito. It has steak, seasoning pork, chorizo, rice, bean, guacamole. The size is crazy big. I mean really big. I love the taste. It is definitely a must have for the visit. I also got the fish and shrimp taco. Both of them is delicious. It come with many tail of shrimp. 

Food come out quick enough. The order can be made on the table. We enjoy our time there. It has some Mexican hats lay around if you want a picture. The store is small. But is big enough for a group of eight of us.

There are a lot of reviews for this restaurant. We were here because of popularity. Pappy started since 2008 and get a lot of attention Nationally. Food Network has rank them number 1 in US. 

They are using Apple wood smoke with dry rub ribs. This rib cook for long time and you can see the rib meat fall off the bone. We got full slab with with sweet potatoes fry and the ear of corn. The sweet potatoes fry is crispy and good flavor. The rib is fantastic. Although is is most popular but not need to kill over it. 

The restaurant move the line quick by taking order and the seating after order. The entrance is strange from the back. The service is good considering this is busy restaurant. They are not the best to my opinion but still very good in St. Louis.

For food vendors in the heights market, they have a line during lunch time. The popularity bring good business to them. The food is good in compare to all vendors in the market. I know their breakfast sandwich is popular. Many people get that item. 

I just want to try their top item. The Palomilla Steak. It is most expensive item in the menu. The steak is good. But base on my previous stay in Miami for 11 years, this dish need work. That do not measure my taste buds. The steak needs to be thinner and more flavor. Need some burn taste too. The side item is better. Other than that. All is good.

This restaurant is tiny. If you decide to come here for lunch, may need to come early for two reasons. Limited seat and wait time. The chef cook each dish on the wok separately. I like this delicate service for each dish. As a result, it take time if someone is ahead of you. May be take out is the best choice. 

I got the drunken noodle. This dish was stir fry in high BTU wok. Slight edge burn which the correct way to cook this dish. It come with egg chicken, broccoli and bell pepper. It was delicious. The only thing I would said not spicy enough since I have ask for Thai hot. 

Dish is affordable. Not much of service because the entire restaurant is run by two people. Very limited seat. Less than 20 seats.

We were here for a Groupon deal dinner. We have $40 deal with four people. If you have Groupon, you need to show the waiter early. He will explain what you can do which is not in the fine print. If you have two people deal meaning two Main dishes while 4 people is 4 main dishes. That way you don't just spend only $40 on app and two dish. This is important if you have Groupon and not disagree at the end. 

This restaurant have very good Indian spice curry. There are some curry I never have try it before. We have lamb curry. The curry is red in compare to many restaurant is yellow curry. The lamb is Braise for some time and is folk tender. The second dish is the Chicken Do Pyaza. This is another curry with onion, ginger and garlic. I cannot make out what kind of Indian base spice. The third dish is the Garlic Tandoori Shrimp. I think the meat is not bouncy enough may be due to grilled in the oven for long time. This dish is too sour which I think it will be better without the lemon. The fourth dish is the chicken tikka. This roasted marinated chicken. I couldn't tell how much different than chicken tandoori. 

Overall is good. Not really wow. But definitely good curry. I wish their grilled item is less lemon and allow taste of the marinated spice. It was good experience. If you order the tandoori dish, please be prepared to wear clothing easy to wash. Because the grilled smoke will stick to your clothes.

One of the treasures in St. Louis at The Loop Neighborhood is this Chinese restaurant. It is great to visit them if you are in St. Louis. They have boba tea and hand pull noodle. My wife like their hand pull noodle. I also like the boba or smoothie. I like the mung bean smoothie.

We begin the handmade wonton in chili oil. This dish dumplings is great. Love the chili oil and the wonton skin. Our second dish is their special beet dry handmade pan-fried lamb and cilantro dumplings. Just the name you already know this dish is special. I have not seen anyone serve this dish before. Because of the beet, the dumplings look red. Very interesting. 

Our last dish is the Pepper Chitterlings. Great wok technique with soften chitterlings. Great dish to go with rice. I enjoy every bit. The service is great. The food come out quick. You can see the chef hand pull the noodle and make the dumplings.

I like Mama Soul Food. It is definitely southern soul. It has been this location for long time. They are planning another location in Brandon. I was surprised the restaurant is full. It has good selection of traditional dish, BBQ, and something out of the box. 

We started with catfish nuggets. It is fresh and delicious. I recommend you get this appetizer. The catfish nuggets was in good quantity. For the entree, we got the baked turkey wings. This is something new that we try. The wings were bake to very soft like jello type. Very good technique. We also have the hog maws dinner. The maw is refer to pig stomach. They prepare and clean it well. The braise sauce was great. It definitely has it unique way of cooking it. The side come with it also very good, especially the candy yum has the fragrance of smell. 

Service is attentive, some come to have pickup. Parking is not the best but I got the side street parking.

This is classic restaurant in Tampa when my wife told me. They reason they classify as classic is they been in Tampa Bay for a long time. They main reason they survive for so long is due to their regular customers. There is a reason why people keep coming back. The reason are quantity of food and affordable to many. 

We have chop BBQ pork sandwich. I this this is their best seller because the chop pork and house sauce make this dish savory. We also has two meat combo. This dish I consider is a value dish. We got baby back rib and chicken. It come with 4 bone rib and quarter chicken in good price. I like they provide the BBQ sauce in warm condition which not sit on the table and condensed. This may be their selling point for the regular who coming back.

It is your burger spot. If you need good massive burger, here is the place. If you have less than $7 in your pocket, this is the place. If you want a good grilled burger with sizzling outward, this is the place. 

You will be surprised the best of the burger is not burger. It is the grilled grouper sandwich. The grouper is slightly grilled with sweet smoky flavor sauce. There are big pieces of grouper. It is worth the money for the sandwich and is less than $7. Great price. The burger has come with bacon. You can double triple the bacon. It is good hearty food. 

There are not many table there if you decide to eat there. Many of the customers have their food to go. There are a lot people waiting for their food since their pricing is better than the fast food join. Many local has ordered from there. Don't forget their donuts burger.

This is the place they open up after they close the Water Avenue store. It has a lot improvement from old place. Parking getting better. Food control also getting better. Sitting is better, more room for customers. But one thing is they are competed with established local taco restaurant. They have huge menu allow them to have more choices than other. Hopefully will bring more customers. 

I got the grilled grouper quesadilla. The grouper is blackened and grilled but I did not feel the flavor of blackened. It may need to be heavier spice. The quesadilla is average. My wife have the Carnitas burrito which is much better than my order. The carnitas was well marinated. They also pack a lot into the burrito with meat. It make the hungry people enjoy the meal. 

Overall our experience is good. Improvement has been made.

Shula has good quality burger due to selection of the premium meat. If you want to leave your name in the restaurant, you can accept the 48 oz 48 minutes challenge. It is huge. They do pack the left over if you cannot finish. 

We got the Swiss Mushroom Burger. I like the Swiss cheese than American cheese. It more chewy. The mushroom are developed from fresh mushroom with thick slice. Great when cheese melt on top. The burger is nice with entire package. We got meal and fried come with it. We also got the chocolate shake. I believe on Tuesday, the shake is only a dollar addition from meal plans. It great to have it. 

Service is great. Restaurant has TV that I can watch the games while I am eating.

It is about 3.5 stars restaurant. Since no half stars 4 stars is given. 

This restaurant is very far from New Tampa. If I have to make a trip to here, I probably will not. Since I am on a assignment to the area, I decided to knock the book mark I have. 

I have order the wood planks salmon. Is is grilled salmon with some spice on it. If they know how to make the edge crispy will be good. The side are chopped Brussels Sprouts and mash sweet potatoes. I don't like the the stir fry Brussels Sprouts that much. I prefer it to cut in half and grilled in extra virgin olive oil. Because stir fry with chopped up Brussels sprouts taste like stir fry cabbage which did not bring out the goodness of this type of veggies. The sweet potatoes is good. 

Service is attentive but need a bit more attention to the customers since it is lunch time. Usually lunch crowd need fast service with everything including close up of the bill and get back to work.

I have been to many 4 river smoke house. I also been to their original smoke house that was replace with newer building in the Fairbanks Ave, Winter Park. No many can said that. I like several thing they have served. Santa Maria Tri Tip and Brisket is the two I like the most. Not to mention their bacon wrap jalapeno chees fill is my favorite too. 

The South Tampa store is my first visit. I have only try their classic brisket and burn end sandwich. We walk at 5:45 pm Tuesday and there was no line. By the time we finish our sandwich, long line was there. I have ask my brisket moist and it definitely is the best piece. I love the brisket with a little fat and tender moist. My wife burn end taste like beef jerky. I think this recipes need some improvement. 

The setting and dining hall is a sense of community dining. They have the hand washing station next to the soft drink station which make easy for the patron who finish the food and wash the hand. Great addition. This location is better than the Carrolwood store in term of grill technique.

It is good German cuisine restaurant. Considering this area is a popular restaurant. During this time, it is just like October fest. Many love to sit outside like beer garden. In the good weather, you may need to come early if you want to sit outside. The restaurant serve German food and gyro. Interesting. The chef can handle two types of food. 

We got the Jagerschnitzel. It is breaded pounded pork gravy with mushroom and bacon. The side is potatoes salad. This dish is good when you are hungry. Love the coating flavor on the pork. We also get the Doener Bowl. It is shave lamb with rice and one special sauce. This dish we added a knockwurst with sauerkraut and falafel, the wurst is good and brown finish outwardly. Falafel also tasty. 

Overall the food is good. Good thing we arrived before the big crowd. They only has one waitress. With their business they may need two. Many come here for the beer.

Great farm market to visit. It is clean and organized. This market is at US 92 best thing can happen to the people who pass by. It is definitely the choice for a good stop for dessert. This is the reason why we are here mostly. They have serve the tangerine soft serve. It is one of the kind. It also serve the shake. I didn't get it because it is 5 % milk. I cannot take that. I wish they have 2% or less milk. Unfortunately they don't have those options. They also got dole whip. I think if they can tone down the sour a bit will be better. 

Other than the dessert, they have all kinds produce. If you get produce here will be very fresh because they are just in the farm area. Definitely good for daily grocery. 

Social distancing is observing here. Will plan for people who sho here. Mask is just the county order.

It's about 4.5 stars restaurant. This restaurant located in Community cannel dock. All seat is outdoor. The restaurant allow dog to accompany their owner in the restaurant. This convenience attract a lot of dog owner bring your dog to the restaurant. It is dog friendly restaurant.

We brought our dog and my family to enjoy the view and food. Since the restaurant is very close to the water, they has a fresh seafood that you can choose. We got the blackened grouper, fried oyster, burger, and fish taco. They did the blacken very well with the flavor that I like. The coating of the fried oysters was very nice. The oysters are also  bigger size compared to many oyster we have eaten. 

The restaurant provide a bowl of water for the dog. The only thing that they can improve on is to make the shade and umbrella a little bigger.

Lakeside tea was at my book mark for long time. I have previous visited this place and not write a review. My wife has visited this place for lunch. I only visited this place for drink. The inside has good space for sit down and chat. That is the reason they are tea place.

I have the strawberry matcha with milk. It three colors drink look fantastic. I also has boba in it. The drink is thick and rich in flavor. I would consider is a good tea. This review do not include the food they have. May be next review. 

The tea will require some time to make. Especially three ingredients. I like that they make the matcha tea from powder and use the small broom to mixed it before into the cup. It is thick in caffeine.

I like this fast food and beer concept. This open air concept is something new and interesting. The do have a garage type area for seating. At least this area has roof over it. This is a place to hang out for late night. 

The place has a lot different types of games on the ground. It is great to see that in the amenities of the restaurant. You can try different games and they are great. It is almost like cruise ship games area. 

The food selection is great. I would said Asian fusion yet can be Mexican or American cuisine. We got the chicken wings. This wing is almost like fried and bake. The coating is Malaysian Chili Paste. This paste is very similar to shrimp paste. Then top with fried garlic. Perfect touch. We also got grouper tostada. It interesting to have it. Not much memorable like the wing. 

Overall we like the concept with beer. A great hang out place. One thing to improve is tone down the speaker volume in the garage seating area. I understand they need to be loud for the people hear over the open area but not at the confine area.

This is about 4.5 stars restaurant. Iron Oak has good skill BBQ. Especially the smoke technique. I like their BBQ. This is a BBQ sport bar. You love to have the local breweries beer here. 

We started with the devil eggs. This devil egg come in three pieces with bacon on top. My entree is the Porker. This is a half pound beef patty with pull pork and crispy bacon on top. BACON!!!! It stack up with fried onions and claw slaw on top. Try to fit it into your mouth. 

The best is their smoked chicken wings. These wing is smoked till the skin are crispy. They sell by weight. They have good seasoning. Each wing is about $1.20. I would recommend this dish. 

The service is great. Very attentive. The price is at medium to high side. It has open air seating with TV.

They took an old Honduras restaurant space that was here before. They have the outside and little inside sitting. The inside AC area is only hold 10 people. But their outside sitting do have the bar area open for party. I did not go the bar AC area. 

We got the Lechon Plate and the Pollo Asado Plate. This two plate has meat. Definitely like the lechon. It was well pack to the box for two go. It come with rice and bean, sweet plantain and red chili. I like lechon. Not sure they serve the skin. If they do, I will ask them to include it. The pollo on the other hand is just ok. 

With that said. The wait is about 10 minutes at 3:30 pm. I wonder what will be the wait during lunch. However, they have take out call in availability, this will cut down the wait. The price and quantity is measured up. I would go for lechon.

This newly open restaurant is serving Japanese street food. Basically the name of the restaurant is alcohol house. Many come here not just have good beer and cocktails, they enjoy the time here. 

We start with seafood sunomono. The seafood is assorted. It has imitation crab stick, octopus, and shrimp. I think this dish is over price. For the amount of food is little, too much of cucumber. The chicken gizzards skew was nice. It is the food to go with sake. We also has the yellowtail collar. This collar is good not the best but good enough. 

We also has the tonkutsu ramen. The ramen most value is having a good soup base which they got it. The charshu is good also. The veggies they have is just the bamboo shoot. I wish they have more stuff to attract the customers. Service is good and attentive. They did give out the surprise gift at the end to loot back the customers.

Great restaurant in St. Louis. If you looking for local dry rub BBQ, this is the place. It is located at famous St. Louis The Loop neighborhood. Very close to Washington University. 

The restaurant labeled themselves as Bourbon, Beer and BBQ. Definitely try the bourbon and BBQ. They have many selection on bourbon. I went for the local favorite. The Bird Dog. Great sense of smell. 

For the BBQ. We have the Bestie Combo. It allows to choose 4 different meat. We got the rib, brisket, wings and pull pork. The rib is half slab. Dry rub seasoning with meat fall off the bone. The wing is the best. Don't misses it. Great slow smoke wings. Brisket and pull pork also well receipted. The combo come with two side and a mushroom shape bread call cheddar popover. Very interesting. 

Our time here was great. Pricing is definitely better than Tampa. It is must visit restaurant.

The restaurant move to new place. It is a little smaller than the old place. I think the food may be take a step back. Not quite impressed. Not sure much to said. I wish they could be better. They are 3.5 stars in my book.

If you want something prepared when you just order, this is the place. Many ingredients is original. Food are cook fresh on the spot. This restaurant is about 4.5 stars not yet 5 stars. 

This is a cute German restaurant. I like the decoration. You will notice the front is German like different from all other store front. We got the schnitzel. Since we did the progressive lunch. We only order this dish. For the price you paid, it is will worth the food. It come with two pieces of schnitzel. Top with mushroom sauce on top. The crust coating was crispy. I think mAy need a seasoning coating. Other than that. They are good. 

The service is excellent. You got the up close personal service. They also serve the German beer to wash the food down. It is good restaurant to try.

In compare to all Ichicoro, this location has the least choice. At least they are more comfortable to dine here. The limited menu may be due the their smaller size of kitchen. Among the restaurants in the food court, I like their system better because they will text you to pick up your food while you walk around the compound. 

I have Shoyu ramen. The base is good. The ingredients is great. The only thing is the grill pork need some more time to cook to fight off the toughness of the meat. It is not easy to bite. I like their fried garlic and onion. It make the soup tasty. The egg is good. But I like it more liquid instead partially harden. Unfortunately they don't have the tonkutsu base. 

The noodle is separated correctly. It not bad to have a bowl of soup in cold weather. Price is bit high for smaller portions than the other two restaurants in their chain.

French restaurant before the beach at Fort Desoto. If you come at Sunday Brunch, please make reservations, they are fully booked most of the time. I have been here twice. I think I can give them a fair review. Their restaurant is at exclusive area and need toll if you from I-275. 

My friend and me visited them during job assignment near the beach. We got daily special Hachis Parmentier. This is a special dish in French cook with ground beef and potato. The second dish La Vosgienne. This is a French crepe wrap with Prosciutto ham and top with sunny side up egg. It is brunch item. It quite good. I like it to be savory. I like this dish the most. It is a local favorite Italian food. It is definitely one of the kind Italian food near Wesley Chapel. Very delicious and authentic. Family own and only store. 

With that said. Let get inside the food. We started with the garlic knots. It has eight of them. It has garlic butter sauce. I would suggest take two of the knots out and look into bottom of the plate for garlic. That is the best part of these knots. You will need to dig to the garlic itself. 

Our entrees is Cioppino. This is a seafood dish. This dish enough to feed minimum three may four. It is seafood combination with pasta in red tomato sauce. The dish is homemade Linguine with baby clam, mussels, shrimp and top with fried calamari. It is like appetizers on top of the meal. I would the shrimp is not bouncy fresh but good hard meat. I believe this is the area they can be easily improved. As a result they are not really solid 4 stars. Since they give a lot of food. It remains 4 stars.

Haus coffee has a fair price in coffee business. I alway think most of the coffee or tea place are overpriced. But Haus is fair on the coffee price. 

The coffee house also has the pastry, breakfast, or sandwich in mixed. Those item do attract more customers to enjoy. Their corner store has outdoor seating if you bring a pet. 

I was going to get one of the coffee but today they have the pumpkin spice special chai tea. I ask for a cold ice large cup. The chai have good taste. It is rare to get pumpkin spice. But we are close to holloween which has potentially offer this special.

It is just ok for the BBQ. This place is kind of new at Brandon area. The store front was decorated with Christmas item when I was visiting there. The draw some new paint on the windows showing the Santa clauses and Mrs Clause. 

We got the sampler platter. It got Saint Louis rib, pull pork, brisket, quarter chicken and two sides. The chicken meat is too powdery. The pull pork is too dry. Only the brisket measure up to the standard. The rib is average. May be is off day for them. It is not up to par.

His bakery cafe and sandwich store is local favorite. We were in the area and try something for my book mark. The interesting item will be the the Tomato pie. But we did not go for it. 

We have the carrot cake. The cake is moist and good. I would said they have good dessert. It includes the banana cream pie, red velvet cake and more. There are some good sandwiches post by other including the Cuban sandwich. May be you want to try it. 

Overall is I good. I would call it average.

I have visited this place many times when I come to Sundial. This time I have order a turkey burger from the grill. It has pepper jack cheese, guacamole, aioli, pickle. This burger is $12. And do not come with side. Consider this is high side for the price. For the location and gourmet, the price is just for the median rating. Good burger not great. But you paid for the organic and experience. 

I would said, I would not paid for daily eating here. Just once a while is fine.

Rare Ethnic Food 52. Ethiopian cuisine 

It is close to 4.5 stars for my experience today. I kind agree some food need to tone up the spicy taste. However the spice and ingredients are there. With that said. Let me get into the experience. 

Mitmita is actually meaning one of the Ethiopian Spice. It can be mixed and make many dish. I like the restaurant reflecting their true calling. The culture of food is use a piece of injera to pick up a bit of entree by hand and eat it. That is how it done to enjoy the different cuisine. 

We have a group there can try different dishes. Injera is a crepe type sheet for pick up the food. The best dish is the Ye-doro Wat. This is a chicken dish with Ethiopian Ber-bere sauce. The sauce has so many ingredients. It is flavorful. We also order the  Kat Wat the chop beef with Ethiopian bbq sauce, Kitfo the lean beef is with the Mitmita sauce, Gored Gored the raw tenderloin beef with amaze sauce. Those are good dishes. 

Afterward we have Ethiopian coffee with ceremony incense to celebrate special occasions. It was a great celebration. On the appetizers, we have the chicken, veggies, and beef sambusa. Very tasty. We have good time there.

My first visit is five stars and my second visit is 4 stars. They should be around 4.5 stars. Not a try 5 stars restaurant. They restaurant seating capacity is a little to less. They do have back door outside seating area and front outdoor seating area. This is a chain restaurant originated from California. It combine many cuisine street food and on display in single restaurants. 

Who thought changing the shape of the churro and add topping bring may like customers. We have chocolate sprinkles churro. It was interesting. I like the popcorn chicken. The five spice coating is really nice. We got our entree as garlic noodle shaken beef. The beef is really shaken for the first time visit. Bit repetitive second time visit they over cook it. The fillet mignon pho is more torn down from Vietnamese version. But still good. Pad see ew is good but it in Thai standard. Overall food is good. 

The fruity booty slush is highly recommended. The other drink pink flamingo is good too. Overall service is good.

I have book mark Honu for some time. Honu is Hawaiian Green Sea Turtle which is remarkable creature. They have plenty of the decoration about this type of turtle at their wall. Those are cute turtle picture on display. 

We were there New Year eve and they are the only few still have space for 6:30 sitting. We were plan to eat there and go to the New Year show. We start with the Musubi - sautéed spam in seaweed and rice. Very interesting. The second dish is the special of the day with salmon poke and thin piece rice cake. This is interesting dish too. We have the stack - slow cook pork on sushi rice top with claw slaw. The rice is not my liking. The pork are sweet. The final dish Mauna Kea Keck II - slow cook beef on the spinach with twin scoop of rice. The beef is average. The rice definite needs improvement. 

Overall the service is very good. The dishes presentation are well design. However the food seasoning and taste is not there. I like the live music and dollar champagne for good New Year celebration.

The historical building remodel to Italian Restaurant. This Sicilian restaurant is the one I like in the Columbia Restaurant Group. It has the best menu and thought on the food. The restaurant follows the pandemic protocol. They ask the customers to wear mask if they are not seated. 

We seat at the bar section with limited number of seat because the wait for table required 45 minutes. The customers who don't have a seat near the bar are reminded to wear the mask. Only the seated customers allow to order. 

Before our meal is here, they serve the pre meal bread with good seasoning. I like those. My wife got the the Polpo Alla Griglia. It is sliced grilled octopus salad. The salad is ok. I got the Sea Bass Grigliata. It is Mediterranean grilled sea bass. They sea bass is big and grilled to good flavor. The accompanying eggplant capanota was very good. We like our food. 

With high price item come greater expectations. The restaurant is about better than average. I would suggest you call ahead. Because they are really busy. The car parking is free in front of the restaurant between 21 and 22 street.

Review # 2100
Authentic cuisine # 55. Fusion Venezuelan Cuisine 

We have been here fist time but they close early. It is difficult to visit this restaurant during weekday and you are 30 miles away. Finally we have a chance to visit. The restaurant space is small. So either you have the take out or visit them at odd hour like 2 pm after lunch hour. Because they always jam pack. 

Our first course is the 11 chick bowl. Great flavors. However I like the second dish with chick # 8 the Paisa. This arepa has fried egg, marinated beef, plantain, chorizo, avocado. Best combination. I like marinated beef inside. Great meal. Our last dish is sweet corn arepa with sautéed shrimp. The shrimp size is big and worth the money. 

We got the cappuccino top cinnamon powder. Great thick drinks. The rating is 5 due to great pricing, great food, and tasty.

New method of the ice cream making. Icesmile catch my attention immediately after Mark review. I told my wife that we are going to try something new that night. If you want the fresh made ice cream, go no further. 

Icesmile just open less than a week when we visit. The procedure is choose you flavor then the three toppings. We have chosen tropical storm - mango, peach  pineapple flavor. Our toppings are lychee, blueberry and kiwi. It start with the vanilla liquid with the chop up fruits. The start to mixed on top of the ice frozen metal top. You can see the liquid start getting thicker in the process. The final is to spread over the plate in thin layer. They scooped it up in the roll format. Toppings then to be added. 

The taste is good. Not too sweet. Since they just opened, they are still make some decorations when we visit. They are more expensive than the regular ice cream scoop since they are make fresh from the beginning. It is worth to watch the ice cream form. 

There are some suggestions that the store can improve. More toppings selection included tapioca or jelly. Some snack items, may be free wifi. May be included drink item. Water for customers.

At southern county, we were able to find a clean, modern look, and contemporary interior decoration for Vietnamese cuisine. Due to Covid-19, the restaurant charge extra dollars for cleaning and serving. Restaurant has big wide area dining hall. Table set six feet apart. 

We start with with grilled pork spring roll. The pork is not the slice grilled pork. It is ground pork like sausage wrap with vermicelli noodle. It serve with the house sauce. But I think the table special house hot sauce is much better to go with the spring roll. 

Our entree is Spicy Hue Style beef noodle soup. This soup base is the best in Bay Area. The dish come with typical raw veggies for Vietnamese noodle. Beef brisket, slice beef, fish cake and more. It is recommended to go with this dish if you like a bit spicy. 

Service just average.

I like old Channelside better because of more buildings. The ideal with open space is good but the ship container really did not display the beauty of the place. I like the open view with seating and view for the bay water. Some how they have least to offer. It just look cheap with current look. I like the bathroom and security everywhere. 

It is great for family with open space but we miss the courtyard. It is try to be hip but not totally hip. Something is missing. Food selection like street food and we have a few spot in Bay Area which compete off. Not sure change for good but definitely not better. May be great for new year eve fireworks. But just one day out of 365 days.

If you have a dairy problem and love ice cream, you will love this place. It is dairy free ice cream place. It is also the vegan ice cream place. It is a mystery to see what in it and what kind of flavor they serve. We were here walk by and decided to explore. Love the concept with dairy free. I was wondering how it taste without dairy. 

We got the matcha latte and the divine chocolate. It proof itself without dairy ingredients, the taste still can be achieved. The matcha latte has good taste with coconut flakes in it. It is delicious. The divine chocolate has good chocolate taste with rich in flavor. Both scoop are delicious. No taste try. But definitely worth the ice cream in every flavor.

It is a bout 3.5 stars. Definitely a credit for quantity of food and quality of food. The food may just need to tone down the salt level on meat seasoning. Especially the carne Asada. 

We got the carne Asada for the entree. Mexican is a bit different than Columbian. Their meat a bit thicker. The seasoning is on the salty side. The pre fried bean is good and soft. But I like their rice better. My wife have the Enchiladas de pollo. I like the chili sauce. Deep dark red chili sauce is the best. I will recommend this dish. 

The restaurant is nice inside and outside seating. It is great place for snack especially Tuesday taco. Buy three get one free. I saw many customers is USF student. It is good place to hang out. I like their salsa to begin with chips.

Very popular local restaurant. Saturday they have pack house when I pick up my food on takeout at 3 pm. Usually that time don't have too many people. Obviously this is a local favorite.

I have order the Bandeja Paisa. This is Columbia favorite combination dish. It has carne Asada, chicharron, sausage, egg. It is well round of meat. Love it. The pork belly was fried to crispy. Food is in good portions. The other dish we have ordered is Sobrebariga a La Plancha. It supposed to be the grilled top flank steak. But when I open at home is grilled pork lion. It is still taste good. 

The entry come with complimentary dessert as a flan. It is delicious too. Other mixed up the order, the food is still good. Definitely worth a visit. If you order takeout, call ahead because they are busy.

Better Byrd is unique restaurant and part of the Fresh Kitchen group. I think their menu is interesting in a way to enjoy variety of the food. The menu selection from dessert, sandwiches, bowls, to taco and wings. It more interesting than the mother Fresh Kitchen which is boring after 4 or 5 visit. 

We got the fried Byrd. This sandwich includes Peruvian slaw, fried buttermilk chicken with cluck sauce. The chicken is crispy. The sauce is great. The entire assembly is harmony. We also hot the charcoal soft serve with peanut jam, coconut flakes, and banana slice. The charcoal soft serve is the best we have. Food is great here especially you look for snack. They also has pork bun which match Asian flavor. 

Overall we like it. But in winter raining day, the inside seating is impossible due low temperature AC unit. Too cold to seat inside.

This old restaurant in Brandon has some character. I have visited this restaurant twice. One before COVID-19 and one during the epidemic. During the lock down of Bay Area, they have the roasted prime rib buy one get one free. Such a good deal. 

My writing of this review is before the pandemic. We arrive here before 6 pm. The place already pack due to early bird special. We got two seats at the bar area so we don't need to wait for 45 minutes. The restaurant average age is high. Many white hair customers. They definitely like this place. 

We got the grilled chicken and the grilled prime rib. The chicken is ok. But the prime rib is excellent. Early bird special make this a good deal. I highly recommend to come at early bird. The accompanying clam chowder is too creamy. Not much o

It is huge improvement when there is staff members help you to get the right order. A beeper was given when your food is ready to pick. At least they no longer let the customers to figure out the food on the counter. 

We were here for the taco week to celebrate the administrative day. Most of my guest got two tacos and a drink with about $10. I got the grilled fish and grilled shrimp. It is tasty for the two tacos I have selected. I like the grilled shrimp better. It has some blackened seasoning on it. 

I got the margarita for my combination deal. The margarita start light then feel the alcohol effects later. We enjoy our time there.

It is a cute restaurant serving lunch and breakfast. Parking can be challenging if there is studio sessions next door. Even at regular weekends, the parking is full. They do have outdoor seating area if you bring the pet. 

There is must try drink in restaurant. The horchata iced coffee is a must have. I like it for cooling summer hot day. We got two different flans. The salted caramel and the butterscotch flan. Both flans are delicious. We also got the Timba with guava dipping. The Timba is the fried cheese - Queso Blanco. This fried cheese and great to have. 

The restaurant have many sandwiches. We were here after lunch for dessert. Food ordering was easy.

We were so happy to revisit the ramen place I like. I was look forward to try the seafood ramen and crispy duck ramen. The seat was easy and quick since they are not busy. Our food come out right time without too much of waiting. The food are presentable. All this are good. 

Two minutes into the food we immediately find the noodle is not right. Some of the noodle are glued together. Seem like 5 Strings becomes one string. My wife noodle is very gooey. This is not acceptable. I think my noodle was sit for a while and my wife noodle was not processed correctly. In Asia, the noodle need to be broil and put in the cold water to cool off and the same time wash away the extra flour that attached to avoid gooey. This is the basic. I think their chef has not pay attention to our bowl and skip step. That cause the entire noodle are not good at all. If this happens in Asia, they will not be acceptable. 

I think with each bowl we paid $16 a piece. It is not to any standard and not to the art of ramen. Not worth the money. Inconsistency does cause this restaurant to be changed my opinion of number one ramen in the Bay Area to I am not sure to revisit again. I have drove 38 mile just because I have the best experience on the first encounter. Now, I am not sure their future.

This restaurant was open just before the stay home order during pandemic. I was thinking very much to visit and finally they open for take out. We need to support our local business during this time. Especially good food. Michi is the first ramen near my area (new Tampa). 

We got the miso and Tonkutsu black garlic ramen. You can have two other choices such as regular or spicy oil and paste. The soup base is great. The porch egg is well prepared. The charshu pork are thick enough and well braise. 

We also got the pork bun and ikamaru grilled squid. The charshu pork bun is a bit pricy. Bun is good not the best in Tampa bay but close enough. The ikamaru probably is the best I have. The squid is a bit small in compare to many place. 

This is about 4.25 stars in my book. But I like to support our local ramen and I round up to 5 stars.

Whiskey Cake was our first stop on the progressive happy hour gathering. The restaurant have good menu on the happy for food and drink. We like food they serve. A good solid 4 restaurant. 

We started with Wagyu State Fair Corn Dog. The is corn dog you might want to slowly bite to prevent the juice inside spread all over you clothing. I like the corn dog come as 5 pieces to share. The next dish is the short rib poutine. This is beautiful decorated dish. The short rib meat is in it with sunny side up egg on top. It is big to share. The next dish is the duckitos. This a spring roll type duck confit. It is ok dish. My friend got dip and spread trio. Come with three different dip. I think it is ok dish too. 

The service is just ok. To get attention of the waiter is a bit challenging. They need to improve on it. I did get a the great escape on the cocktail. I actually like this cocktail. Pineapple fuse with rum. Nice touch.

This all you can eat sushi place is a lot better than the one they have in Carrollwood. Tastes, ingredients preparation, mix of rice are better. I would said lunch has the best value here. 

We arrive on the early and seating is not a problem at week end. Through out the meal time, we still can see some seating is available on lunch. 

We have order the spicy tuna, rainbow, saki, Mexican rolls. The sushi includes escolar, surf clam, salmon. We also order some items from habachi and stir fried. 

The roll I like is the Fuji roll. It has spicy tuna and top with salmon and drizzle with eel sauce. The steak and shrimp hibachi is my favorite on the cook side. I also like the appetizer as Gyoza and the dessert with fried banana with chocolate dip. 

Overall the service is great. The food is attractive. The serving speed is acceptable.

It is about 4.5 star. I like the choices of grains and assemble bowl. It is a restaurant known how to simplify the assembly line and items. It is easy to manage. However, I would like to have more protein choices. 

The food here is delicious. The sauce is unique. However, they probably need to be adjusted generally liking and different from other. We got the salmon as our protein. The salmon was well cook with skins attached. Not many know how to cook salmon with skin. They probably one of the restaurant know how to cook it. The grain choice as base is nice. 

One thing for sure to get repeat customers need to have variety. To get the customers interest and come back.

Very good burger place. It is very close to 4.5 stars. It has many choices. There are may choices of Black Angus burger. They have good list of burger. 

The restaurant outside seating make it convenience for the dog owners in downtown area. Especially this restaurant is close to Curtis Hixon dog park. I got the glass of beer with burger. Good local beer. For the burger, I got the Franklin Street burger. This burger come with Kaiser Roll bun. I like the bun. The burger has angus beef patty, pull pork, smoke brisket, and bacon. Very complicated combination. By it work and very tasty. Excellent burger. 

Service is good. The turn on light on the outside side so we don't eat at the dark. I also like the skinny fries. Very good fried.

Kay's Kitchen has new place. I use to go to their old place which only order from the window. The current location has improved a lot. The improvement are as below. They has seating area for the customers if they decide to dine in. At old location many customers order and eat at the car. Second, the food preparation time cut to half. Old kitchen need a long wait if customers in front of you. 

We track down their new restaurant location and finally we have a visit. Before you visit, you need know a few thing. First they cook the food when you order. They are not like other fast food fried the chicken and sit on the rack until customers order it. As a result the food is fresh and delicious. So, you need some patience to wait for them to cook your food. But you can order ahead by phone to cut down your wait time. Second, if you dine in, you need to wear non expensive clothing, because the food smell will stick on you. No leather accessories because it will stick at the leather and difficult to remove.
