If you want to use a credit or debit cards, there is a minimum amount to purchase. Evidently they can do cakes on special order. I would recommend this to anyone in need of a treat, and I will be back.

Come here for three things: Frites, Mussels and Beer. If you have an inclination you might not want any of the above, then skip the Brugge. It is also worth noting, that there are fewer seating options for those under 21, so if you're coming with a family, definitely call ahead for wait times. 

Back to the food: The tables have frite holes; that's how serious they are about fried potatoes. They have 12 preparations of PEI mussels; that's how serious they are about moules. And, right now, they have a beer called Reindeer Games. I can't resist loving a beer named after a holiday animal and described as having hints of cinnamon. It was a delicious brew. They also have 12 sauces for fry dipping. Again, they are serious about frites. Alas, I ordered a brussels sprouts crepe with a side salad and felt a little dumb about the choice. It was ok, but the mussel-eaters looked more delighted, and I ended up stealing a fair share of fries. I am not a mussel lover, but I could have gone with the Steak Frites, which looked pretty good. But again, this is really a spot for three things: Frites, Mussels and Beer!

Food was very plain, no seasoning or taste.  The first cashier was great . She went to get change from the bigger Chinese lady and I guess she didn't want to give it to her. So the bigger  lady decided to slide my damm change on the counter in a tray towards me.Never once said thank you or nothing...so myself  and the nicer  cashier looked at her like what's the damm problem... I will NOT BE going back. I only went cause it was listed On NOLA as a great place to eat....I'll pass! Customer service sucks or they don't like BLACK people. Either way this was my FIRST and  LAST TIME.

I stopped by Medina Mediterranean Grill while staying nearby for business. I found it through Yelp and it was a quick walk away from my hotel. Upon entering I was warmly greeted and asked if I needed any help with the menu. I went for the felafel as it seems a good food by which to measure a Mediterranean grill. I quickly ordered and waited a few minutes before my order was ready to go. They are taking dine in customers as well at this point.

I found the felafel very moist and flavorful. Rich and creamy sauce with the fresh veggies you'll enjoy. I added a little heat to my felafel as I like spice which for me made the dish even better.

Inside is clean, the service is friendly and I wouldn't hesitate to return in the future if I'm in the area.

A friend  brought bagels to work from Truckee Bagel Co. one day and the sesame bagel I had was so tasty. I didn't even have to toast it or add smear to it to enjoy it. I checked out their menu online and the following Saturday decided to make a pit stop to the shop to try something else from their menu. They offer both breakfast and lunch bagel sandwiches. I came for breakfast and ordered a Sunrise bagel sandwich w/bacon for the hubby and a BST - bacon, sprouts, tomato bagel with chive smear for myself. We both enjoyed our bagels. The bagel had the right amount of chew to them and the sprouts and tomato on my BST was nice and fresh. The service is ok, what you would expect from counter service. The bagel sandwiches are made to order, so be prepared to wait a few minutes for your order. This is a small bagel shop that can get pretty busy so come early to avoid the crowds.

New Favorite place in the UNIVERSE, Seriously. I have heard great things about this place for a while from Carlos. Finally, we got a chance to try it. We really had no idea whatsoever what to expect. We never had this kind of food.
The pupusas, never tried anything like it, I guess the only thing I could compare it to would be the Puerto rican arepas with cheese, not the Columbian ones(Those are just white pieces of non flavor).
The pupusas were so tasty, I guess like a corn flour like taste with your choice of meats and cheese, and beans if you want. My husband and I ended up eating 2 each, and ordered a carne asada with rice and plantains. The pupusas were a perfect meal or snack, seriously that good. 
I need to bring other people here, my friends from Chicago, who have never tried this food. If you have not been here, this is a must go. It's small, and they have videos of central America so you can get to know what the area is like. Definitely a place that I would love to go back to in a heartbeat.

I think Pisces Sushi should be renamed Dunedin Dream after the sushi roll I'm going to try on my next visit. And yes I'll definitely have a next visit.

This time around I tried the Aloha Broha and my oh my it was so good and different.  I was a bit worried my hubby wouldn't find anything he liked bc the menu is mostly fish and sushi, but alas he was happy. He had the steak skewers(Montezuma Spears) and the pork buns. I didn't get a chance to taste the skewers but he loved them, and I took a bite of the buns and they were great.

To go with my Aloha Broha roll I ordered a mango mojito without the jalapeño. It was alright but I've had better but that's A-OK!

My server was great! He was super helpful and patient and always made sure we had everything we needed.

We enjoyed sitting outside with our pup. The left outside area facing the entrance is the dog friendly side. They also have the outside seating on the right side as well as inside.

I'm happy I found a new place to love on in Dunedin. That's why Dunedin Dream is a perfect nickname for Pisces Sushi and Global bistro!

Goody Goody was no biggie biggie! I wanted to check this out because I had met an older couple who raved about the back in the day Goody Goody, and how the new one is excellent, and just as they remembered it! Thought maybe it was a nostalgic thing for them, and that's cool I can relate with other places like that. 

So I have decided to first mention the best part. If you decide to read the rest of the not so good stuff, that's up to u.

Come here strictly for the pie. Yes, the pie! They have banana cream, butterscotch, cookies and cream, chocolate cream, and coconut cream pie. 

Coconut cream pie was oh so perfect! It was just the amount of sweetness and I think there was flambé marshmallow fluff on top, I don't know. Nonetheless, the sole next purpose I'll be back when I'm back is for their pie!

__________________________________________________

We came and our first impression was that the hostess stand was very welcoming. There were three of them that we encountered. The odd thing was that I initially wanted either inside or outside, but afterwards I told them outside because it was colder inside than outside. If I wanted outside, I should have gotten it, but that didn't happen. I might have liked this experience a little better. Inside, besides the temperature, it is extremely loud. It was to the point I couldn't talk or think. There are speakers everywhere. 

The service was forever, like forever. It took a short bit of time to get seated with the No Wait app. Service after getting seated is AWFUL! Food, where do u come from, Egypt or the Orient?

The restaurant should be renamed No Biggie Biggie! I tried the cheeseburger POX. It was bland. Is there a such term as less than basic? It was that. Flimsy bread, tiny burger patty, cheese u could barely see. The POX sauce is like sloppy joe sauce from a bulk item bought at Sam's Club or Costco! The fries were unbearably salty and even tasted that way when you dip it in that POX sauce or ketchup. I had chili which lacked much flavor. Even the bottle of hot sauce I used didn't do much for it. They also need some type of crackers to go with the chili. 

In anyway possible this review needed to get better. See told ya u might have just been happy reading the top part of the review ;-)!

Portillo's, what happened here? Your service was off. Why were the girls at the check out blank staring at me when I ordered , and I didn't know who to tell my order to, and the one who got told to take my ordered seemed quite clueless. She was talking to me while someone was talking on the speaker. I have no idea what u said and stop trying to fix your hair while people are trying to give their order, seriously. 

I ordered a chopped salad, Italian beef dipped not sopping soggy wet, full slab dinner, and two pieces of cake. I also said several times that I wanted the Italian beef dipped. Who wants soggy Italian beef sandwich.? Bleh not good.  

Good thing the ribs were great. I missed those ribs. On Mondays, they have their ribs special which I'll be back for, but not at this location.

It wasn't busy at the time we went. Our food came out surprisingly fast, but my order wasn't great. Good thing, my hubby's ribs were, or I probably wouldn't be back.

Yum. Love this cool eclectic spot. It's located in a brand spanking new building right next to Canopy Road Cafe and the new Strandhill Public. 

This is the go to place for sushi and ramen. I ordered the Tan Tan Men ramen. It has a very deep flavor from the sesame paste. I don't think I've ever had sesame paste before. It's texture was like peanut butter. There was so much flavor and it definitely was different than what I have ever had. My hubby had the Kiwami Ramen which is quite popular. He enjoyed it. I also had the summer breathe roll which had no rice and had mango. It called my name.

We enjoyed Kiwami and would definitely be back in a heartbeat when the ramen and sushi are calling our name. I'm sure we will be back for the winter without a doubt!

I'm happy to report that my fur baby Mocha Coconut loved his pupcake. He couldn't stop eating it after his initial lick. It was going going gone. check out the video of him.

I had my lemon blueberry cupcake and it was okay. Yes just okay. It honestly was just quite dry like desert dry not dessert dry. Not that great. The flavor of the lemon was only bc of the frosting. I think it should also be in the cake.  I was excited to try it and may give it another chance bc my pup loved his, but we will just have to see.  I honestly don't think I favored the flavor selection all too much either so ehh. Yep just ok.

I first visited The Mill several years ago in St Pete when meeting up with my amazing sweet friend Samantha D. And her hubby Zach. We sat outside & had brunch. It's been so long, I couldn't remember what I had and how it was inside.

Last night my hubby & I decided to go to The Mill for dinner in Tampa. It's their new location, and my hubby said Charley Belcher visited it and raved on the detail of the restaurant and the food and drinks. I knew it would be a good choice and it was a great choice.

My first impression of it was wow, they designed this restaurant and it looks amazing. The details are extraordinary and I haven't seen anything like it in Tampa in a long time. It's like an art museum and restaurant in one. You just gotta check it out for yourself.

Moving on to the drinks, I stuck with water right now but the cactus pear mimosa, the tahona, el duderino, the fun under the sun, & the go fig-ure sound SO GOOD to me!!!

For an app, we started with the watermelon bruschetta. I had this in St. Pete, and I didn't remember it but I sure will now. It's sooo good and refreshing. The flavors were above and beyond good!

Our entrees were the seared diver scallops for me and the pork tomahawk for my hubby. We both loved ours, but honestly at first the curried cauliflower purée was intense. When u mix it with the lemon tzatiki it was soo good. I also loved it with more lemon on it!  My husband loved his pork tomahawk to the point where he didn't let me try it. It does have a huge bone with it being a tomahawk.
The street corn with it was so good I had to order another one

Our server was great! We asked a lot of questions, and our server was patient and very helpful.

This is my new favorite restaurant in Tampa. There's so many different menu options I want to try. It's also dog friendly. It's definitely an experience in itself. Loved it through and through!!!!

This is my favorite MD Oriental Market. I have been to the other locations in Tampa & Brandon. This use to be a Sweet Bay/Winn Dixie so it is very spacious and organized. There's a lot of options here as well as a good size take and go warm food area, bakery, meat and seafood area and freezer section. They also have the other items in the middle for home and for non fridge items.

I like the produce section here and always have to pick up my favorite baby Bok Choy. 

MD Oriental Market is the biggest Asian market in the area. There are bigger ones in Orlando. This one is pretty good for the area.

A brand new restaurant just opened a few months ago in Clearwater Beach serving steak and seafood. Oh yeah, for sure, all about checking it out. They even had a perfect shaded outside patio, a bar, and is very pet friendly.

We were greeted by a friendly hostess over the phone and in person. We had an exceptionally awesome waitress Stacy.  After checking out the menu, we decided upon an entree of scallops and side of asparagus, and a short rib dinner with gravy, along with a side of artichoke and au gratin potatoes.  

Don't judge a book by its cover, right?! We promise you, we are open. 

When we received our plates, they just looked...ok.  For the price tag, I honestly do think some presentation is important. More importantly, taste of course. First try of the scallops - no flavor whatsoever. Second try of it was the same thing. They said it was a grapefruit citrus type sauce. It was as if it was simply squeezed on with no care or preciseness. It didn't give a any special flavor or anything.

On the flipside, the short rib was tooooooooo salty. Most likely because the poor short rib was drowned and gravy, and couldn't get out! The au gratin potatoes tasted like boxed potatoes, the ones you get from the grocery store that I love when I am making it at home because they are convenient, but not the ones I love when I'm out to eat, and what seems to be an upper scale restaurant.

So, with all my might, I wanted to love this new pet friendly restaurant with wonderful service, but nope. It is a no-go for both of us.

Delicious, delightful, and dreamy can easily describe my new favorite dining experience. 

Delicious equals shrimp and grits with andouille sausage, southern sweet potato pancake, mimosas, and southern chicken hash. There is no order of favorites at this place. Everything is oh so good!!

Delightful is the service and the atmosphere. Server was attentive, cheery, helpful, and sweet. Thanks Toni for dealing with our loud crazy selves running from the bee who loves mimosas and sweet potato pancakes. Also inside and out, this restaurant has a nice, clean, modern feel, and is dog friendly outside with huge umbrellas for shade.

Dreamy best defines Johnny Grits because I will and am dreaming of my next visit here. I am not one to come back to places since there are so many to choose from, but this place is certainly on my best of the best.

They serve breakfast, lunch, and dinner. They are close to the beach, dog friendly, very organized, and their food is delicious. It is also a laid back place that has homemade red and white sangrias which stare at me, and I will drink next time. This is my new fave dining experience.

I brought my outta town guests here to have a cool laid back lunch. It turned out to be a turn off more than anything!

We ordered a shrimp Po boy and oyster Po boy and split them. We also ordered sweet potato fries and onion rings which were extra. No side included with each sandwich. We also ordered a cheeseburger with barely any cheese. All were not good and all tasted like the same grease that it was wading in. There was no other flavor. The Po boys came with lots of mayo and cheese. No other flavor could make it stand out whatsoever. The burger had cheese you couldn't see.

At the end, they brought beignets. They were the best of them all but by that time we were turned off by our lunch.

Flies swarmed only us. Why was that? Was that from the kitchen perhaps. I have no idea!

I was hoping this would be a great experience for all of us. We went straight to get ice cream to get rid of the taste of reused grease.

I've always wanted to go here, and I'm glad we finally made it. I was in the mood for seafood and drinks, with a water-view. The thing is we had to make sure we got parking not too far away. Which it was perfect this time.

We ordered calamari, mussels, corn, and drinks. It really was very tasty. Everything was a perfect experience and the view was priceless. I didn't want to leave.

I want to come back for breakfast. Their breakfast looks very good. I'll definitely be back for sure and I'd recommend it to anyone!

I'm not on the band wagon with this oh so basic Mexican food. I feel like this menu just flashes back to the 90's with basic plain tacos, enchilada, and fajitas. Chicken, beef, and pork are your options and if u have flavor you rely on the salsa or the ranch. 

I ordered the Elvis Memorial Enchilada combo with the taco and different enchilada, and it was so huge that I had it for leftovers. Leftovers often taste better to me since the flavors have time to marinate but it was not a big deal. My hubby ordered a steak burrito and really, it is nothing to write home about.

The regular size frozen margarita was small than what I've been accustomed to as well.

I can't see anything insightful or extraordinary about this menu. Perhaps it is the nostalgia for those who have grown accustomed to Chuy's restaurants elsewhere nationally.

They advertise bring a picture frame of your dog for a free app. They also posted to send a picture ahead of time on their fb, and they will post it. They sent me a postcard for the free app and said my furbaby was posted. Nope that wasn't the case. They stated they didn't post all the pics to make room for cinco de mayo. That was a disappointment. 

This restaurant in my opinion is not waiting for. If you are by the outlet mall, any of those places make you wait. I won't be back. I can make
Much better food than what they gave me.

Hope you have saved your appetite from your meal at Datz to walk next door to Dough. After all, in my world, dessert is the most important.

Dessert consists of various cupcakes like the salty caramel cupcake, to various donuts such as a fruit loop donut, to gelato like black cherry whiskey, or my favorite lemon lavender basil. Or smokey popcorn(weird, but yes) 

Are you parched from the Florida heat? Pick a coffee or a tea, or a shake, or a boozy alcohol filled shake. Satisfy your sweet tooth here.

On your birthday, get a free cupcake. Check in on Yelp and get a free gelato.  That's how I got my gelato. I picked the lemon lavender basil, and my hubby got the cookies and cream.

This place is pretty, super feminine, and comfy. Reminds me of Victoria Secret decorations. There's a table or two outside in the back if you have your precious furry doggy family member with you.

I love this new coffee spot! It is super cute and cozy!  I'm so happy that my second visit I had the time to just chill here, & take everything all in!  It is a perfect spot!

I had a iced chai latte and a quiche! I loved them both very much! The iced chai latte was different than what I have tasted elsewhere and it was great! The quiche as simple as it sounded had so much flavor.

I have tried their gluten free chocolate donut which was yum and their iced latte with cocoa. All were amazing.

Finally a local coffee/donut shop that is delicious and comfy! I will be back!

Wow!!! I can't believe the Detroit pizza here!! It is seriously amazing!!! It's been a while that I have found a pizza I love. The Nona Slice Detroit pizza is completely different than my two other faves. It is as amazing in a different sort of way especially with it being a completely different style of pizza. The crusty edges are to die for, the cheese is soft and gooey and u also get the yummy crusty cheeses on the edges. The sauce on top is perfectly flavorful. I didn't even have to ask for extra. The Death by Pepperoni is three different pepperoni's. Let's just say small, medium, and large. So much flavor, so much goodness! 

My server was very cool and helpful and suggested the Death by Pepperoni pizza. She also told me about the pizza with the spicy honey. How different. I tried the honey. It's for sure spicy. If you like spicy, try it.  They also have New York Pizza and Olde World Style. You can also pick your own toppings and own style.

Also Tuesdays are Detroit Style Slices!!!!! 


U must must must go to Nona Slice Pizza for their Detroit Pizza. I'll be back for sure!!!!

Definitely not a 5 star, or a 1 Star, so I'll go right at a 3.  Finally came back here, and it was better. Not my fave, but still alright. I had the Gordita. Basically a puffy fried corn tortilla that was generously packed with shredded beef, guacamole, beans, tomatoes, lettuce. It came with a good amount of rice and beans. It was on the lunch menu so you will see it's under $8. I would not go here all the time and it actually has been years, but it was ok.

It's been quite a while since we have been here.

It's a fun Key West atmosphere and if you have tourists, this may be the place.  They have expanded their outside seating since Covid and they do definitely space people out.

They quote a while for seating, but it's not bad at all. They quoted about 20-30 min and it was about 10-15 minutes max for inside. Their new outside area is quite big on the other side and they quoted an hour, but knowing that it's a safe estimate, id definitely suggest sitting outside when it's not too hot out. Like at night time. It looks nice.

Food selection is ok. It's a tropical vibe but really just the basics with fish and shell fish. For the non fish seafood eaters, your choice will prob be pasta or ribs. 

I ordered the Bimini fish with crab and shrimp. My husband ordered the chicken Alfredo. With my meal a guava mojito. It was ok. We ate our plates fully, but no big deal. I thought my fish was over priced.  I do think they should make their plating more appealing. Especially for a tropical themed Key West restaurant. Colorful plates make it more appetizing. Service no biggie. Not amazing or out of this world service. A bit hard to locate him at times

Chicken with sweet plantains is so good and I liked the char broil taste. We ordered the family special which is a whole chicken, sweet plantains, and 4 rolls.

The rolls are cold and hard. The extra large side, corn souffle was totally overcooked, perhaps too much time in the microwave. Meh.

Chicken with plantains alone yum. The sides and other options, NOT!

I literally just came back from Chicago, and Portillos is everywhere. So glad I don't have to part, and we now have the second location in Tampa. What a dream come true, and a little piece of home is closer to my Florida home closer than ever.

I've been lucky enough to go twice so far. I first had the Italian beef with hot peppers on the side along with tamale. Next time I'll get the sweet peppers instead of hot ones. They were a killer for me. 

My hubby had a bacon cheeseburger & cheese fries. So so good. You must get cheese fries, and not just regular fries. 

This second time around I got the chopped salad with chicken. The house dressing is the best. I got feta cheese instead of gorgonzola cheese. I also got onion rings.

He got the beef and cheese crossaint and cheese fries. I want the beef and cheese crossaint next time!!

Out of service inside and through the drive through, my favorite was through drive through. Everyone was very helpful and engaging and cheery. They are trying to get all their codes and abbreviations straight and are doing a good job.

One person working simply stood out inside the Portillos. She was super energetic getting excited for each customer and handing out everyone's happy treat chocolate cake to everyone.

So happy Chi-town is coming closer to Tampa. I moved away, but it's always close to my heart, and now even closer to my tummy!

WEPA!! It's an expression and it means awesome! Yep that was our Easter meal!

We patiently waited for them to open on Sunday. They opened an hour later at 1pm!  We were not disappointed.

Passion Fruit Sangria and a crab empanada started my Puerto Rican food heaven!' Yum!! So good.  My hubby had the beef empanada which he liked!

For entrees, I ordered shrimp with the coconut sauce and he ordered a steak with chimichurri. It looked perfect and tasted that way too.

Our server was awesome, cheery, and friendly!!!

Definitely an excellent place for Puerto Rican food.

The inside is smaller with about 6-8 tables depending on how big the groups are. There is also outside tables. It's dog friendly here!!

This is right next door to 3
daughters brewery. We parked in the parking lot which was nice and convenient and free, no parking ticket!!!

I really enjoyed Wooden Ladle. First thing when you walk in, it's like you come to a counter with two iPads. I didn't know you order from there, & that's okay. There's someone to assist you, he was quite helpful. 

I ordered the Pho - Men which is basically ramen soup with beef. My hubby ordered the Abura soba(ramen with no broth, and not spicy. I'm happy to say I liked my option better than his. I enjoyed it a lot. I see some reviews talk about it being bland or not salty enough, but it was perfect for me.

I was satisfied with the help I received when ordering and I ask a lot of questions. You can also request substitutions or changes.

I really liked the long tables and the cool little Asian comic strips on the wall. The booths were funky because they had suspender like accents on them.

Nonetheless, we enjoyed our experience here very much, and so happy we tried it!

This newer breakfast spot is perfectly called Speggtaculer, & that it is! 

From the outside it does look like an older building. From the inside, it's open, bright, spacious, and welcoming as are the service and our server!

The menu will grab you alone, and will help you make decisions with vibrant pictures like crazy.

I ordered the seafood Benedict which came with loads of spinach, crab meat, and I had feta cheese instead of bleu cheese. You can choose the ciabatta, English muffin, or crepe. I had a crepe under it. It was topped with lots of hollandaise sauce that was very good.

Hubby had a meat skillet with several types of meat, tons of hash browns, sunny side egg(his choice), & hollandaise sauce. That kicked it up a notch!

There are tons of fresh fruit options. I actually got a bowl of fruit instead of hash browns. The waffles and crepes and pancakes, etc look like OMG!!!!

I wish Speggtaculer was closer! It would be my regular breakfast spot!

Zukku San is Amazing. So glad to have it in the area. The restaurant is super cute and modern. The menu is really appetizing and diverse. The service is excellent. They definitely did their due diligence with making sure we are safe during Covid.

I loved how they brought warm napkins for us in a cute little presentation, pouring the warm water and seeing them expand. Check out my video. 

I ordered the scallop skewers and the shrimp volcano and my husband ordered the steak udon. They were so flavorful and a very good size serving. We were super happy with that.

They have a fun drink menu too. I definitely want to try it.

There are there sitting areas. The booth cubby holes are my fave. The middle area open table seating and they space u out very well. Lastly on the wall booths with dividers between them.

Check this place out. It's across the street from the outlet mall!! It's perfect!!

I was just saying I can't believe Liang's has been around forever. Well as far as I know at least a decade! 

They never disappoint. I've tried their crab Rangoon, beef chow fun, walnut chicken, basil chicken and I finally tried their Liang's beef and their Thai red curry basil shrimp. Everything is all so good and I go home with leftovers that are even better the next day! 

Service is good and I like the ambiance. It's not too loud, it's just perfect!! 

Another nice handy feature is they have a drive in and they have outside seating. This is right next door to Home Depot and across the street from the movie theater. It's also close to I75.

I thought I updated Happy Fish more recently, but I guess not. Happy Fish was my very first experience with Peruvian food! Now I am hooked on Peruvian food & usually visit a Peruvian restaurant wherever I go.

With that, I think Happy Fish is ok. It's good for a starter and getting to know Peruvian food in its traditional way. But I do feel that Happy Fish is not as flavorful and does not showcase the amazing taste palate of Peruvian food as other places I have been to.

This time around, my hubby ordered the tallarin verde which is green pesto noodles and steak with a potato cut in half.  I ordered the tallarin saltado con mariscos. This is lo mein noodles cooked like Lomo Saltado stir fry but instead of beef it is is seafood.'I just don't think the noodles were the best with the sauce. The sauce is too watery for it.

Lomo Saltado is better and I like pescado a lo macho.

We also had the yuca huaincaina which is fried yuca with huaincaina(yellow sauce) it is also ok, but the sauce is also watery.  

I've had better. But their service is great. It is best to make a reservation because they are only seating six tables at a time for ideal social distancing.  Their menu is also on a link on the table. You just hover your phone on it for the menu.

Hemingway's is sooooooo good!!! I love the option of sitting by their bar and ordering right there. It is more personable than ordering from the window.. We were able to snag a couple spots and we simply said we will have what their having(the ones sitting next to us)

I shared the Cuban salchipapa yucca fries with my hubby. It was a good size bowl with lots and lots of flavor. If you are going to get anything, make sure you pick that. It does have shredded pork and chicharrones. Next time I'll say no to the chicharrones. If you do not eat pork they will substitute it for a different meat.

Can't wait to try other options here!

Fresh kitchen is a small Florida chain in Tampa,St. Pete, Sarasota, Orlando, & a couple locations in S. FL.  I'd been turned by them for a short while. They are the usual pick your base, veggie, protein, topping, sauce bowl places. This time I did like it.

We went to On The Fly Hall in St. Pete. This is a small food hall with Sweet Soul(Acai bowls, Better Byrd (chicken), Fresh Kitchen, and Taco Dirty. It's all about bowls here under the same owner Ciccio. 

I ordered a kiddie bowl which is one base - Cauli mash - one veggie - green beans - one protein - steak and picked two sauces - holy kale and balsamic vinaigrette. I liked everything about this bowl and I felt like it was simple and guilt free. I don't usually like their veggies - they can be hard or spicy and I never remember what sauces I like so I can refer here and recall the sauces I like.

There's a good number of bowl options here so I am happy to go here with others so they can pick what they like, and not spend too much money so a lot more affordable.

They have inside and outside seating on both sides and a good size parking lot.

I can't believe it's been a few months that I have been here. I feel like it was just yesterday. That's how vivid and tasty my dinner was here!

Initially I really wasn't feeling this place. It's very crowded here and service can take a bit of time.... But there's a good reason why, the Greek food here is amazing and I swear the tastiest and best I have had. I've been to a number of restaurants at the Sponge Docks and none this memorable.  

My hubby and I ordered the saganaki(flaming cheese) charbroiled octopus, and chicken Mykonos. This also comes with the Greek lemon soup and a simple apple honey dessert that is so good. Everything was cooked to perfection.

Our meal was extraordinary and this is my most favorite restaurant at the Sponge Docks. You gotta try it and be Patient if you wait a while. I hate waiting but this is worth it!

I'm actually dreaming of this place already. I was just there a few hours ago. 

Last week, they started their lunch menu. Immediately, I knew I wanted to go as soon as possible w it being a new offered menu, & it being a more compatible price point for me.

I made a reservation of 10 people right away which was a breeze. I left a voice mail and Ulele called me back. Initally I wanted the tables outside (they are dog friendly),  but it got cooler out. I called later in the week to change it with ease.

Getting checked in and seated was easy. Even though half of the table was not there yet, it was not a problem. I specially requested an area that was not as loud and had a great view. I got just that. They even made it a point for us to sit next to the Tampa Mayor Buckhorn which was nice.

Our server Jorge was on point in all ways. He knew how to make good insightful suggestions of plates, describe them to us. He made sure we had everything we needed and more. He made sure we were comfortable w the temperature since the side doors were open. He was even making sure our pictures he took of us were perfect.

Our food was awesome. We ordered some plates to share and entrees to eat on our own. We had charbroiled oysters, chicken lollipops, okra, peppers, jalapeño corn bread.

For plates we ordered lobster rolls, gouda grouper, top sirloin, chili, crab mac and cheese. Everything was amazing. 

We also tried a combo of asparagus and green beans. Asparagus were better, so Jorge gave us more.

I tried a pretty grapefruit grenadine alcoholic drink, & it was good, but a bit strong for me. Others had their local beers.

We did have dessert. Their guava pie w a side of toasted coconut ice cream was out of this world.

All in all, the A+ service and food, amazing atmosphere, & great company make this restaurant an amazing new Tampa icon. I look forward to coming here again in the future. I would definitely without a doubt recommend this restaurant to anyone.

Fun cool little place for ice cream! The ice cream flavors have funky names to them that are quite eye catching. I had the mint want cookies in a waffle cone that was out of this world. I just wish it was bright green but that's ok. I still liked it. The benches that you sit on are artistic as are the art on the walls are artsy too.

There are a few benches inside and like only two or three tables outside. The entrance is one way in and one way out, so if you turn too early, you will end up parking on the street instead of the parking lot.

Deviled Pig was okay to me. It did not seem out of the ordinary, or memorable.

I opted for the pulled pork and the brisket. Sauce is on the side and you can choose whatever sauce that you prefer. I liked the pulled pork better.

My hubby had the chicken. He felt that the rub was a tad bit spicy but i felt like it had more flavor. At first it was okay, but i noticed it was quite moist and not dry so that is good.

I would like to try the deviled pig since that is in fact their name but i can simply see that as a shared app and by the time you have your entree, that would be quite a lot.

There are a few tables inside and a bar seating across the window with bar stools. It's more of an outside place, but really only has 5 picnic tables outside, but the street is quite busy so that's your beautiful view..

I am happy to have tried it, but I won't be back again.  It's worth a try if you are a BBQ lover to see what you think.

I have never been to Texas Cattle Company until August for my hubby's birthday and yesterday for mine. Anyone who hasn't been here is missing a great food experience.

I have had their filet, lobster tail, and their birthday 27 ounce t-bone. My fave are the t-bone and lobster tail. The steak is so good, has great seasoning, super juicy, and their is a nice distinctive smokey flavor. I don't usually like smoky but it is so good and no steak sauce is needed whatsoever.

The sides are so good too. I have had the Texas fries (big potato wedges) and mashed potatoes and salad. A side and salad are included as well as their OMG bread rolls that you will not be able to stop eating.

Our favorite server was Lisa. She was upbeat, helpful, and had a fun personality. Our last server was just okay, and unfortunately Lisa was not working when we went back.

The atmosphere is mostly pretty dark, but the area where the bar is located is pretty cool with booths that have antique bed stands.

We will definitely be back there. This was my fave birthday dining experience in Florida.

I was pleasantly surprised by this restaurant. From the outside, it is not much. But from the inside, it's banging up a storm. It's busy, but not in that horribly loud cafeteria way. It's not bad at all coming from someone who is sensitive of crowded loud restaurants.  The atmosphere is like a 50's & 60's place with a menu of a momma and papa's restaurant and the prices are very reasonable!

I wasn't sure what to get at 10 am on a Saturday. Breakfast of course was calling my name, but also some of the Greek specialities on the menu as well.

So either eggs Benedict or chicken souvlaki were calling my attention and this time eggs Benedict won.

The plates are huge here like HUGE and tasty too! The eggs Benedict with side of home fries were great as well as my side of grits with cheese.

My hubby ordered an omelet which I never usually order at restaurants because I can make them at home. It was very good and stood out!

It's a great touch with the manager comes around, not once, but several times to check up on you.

I will definitely come back for the chicken souvlaki and Greek salad!  This place is totally a hit!

Honestly overrated!! Cool, not warm mushy coconut rice, shredded beef, chihuahua cheese, and what seemed to be microwaved frozen plantains. Not impressed whatsoever and the place to pick the food seemed like it was extremely disorganized with containers every where. I couldn't see what was what at all, I just read from the menu.
I can easily say one of the worse bowls I have had. There was really not many places on this stretch of Central, so I could see why it was so busy with people on Halloween. I got in line before the rush.

I need to seriously update this review! It's been way too long. I'm so happy that this place is still around. It was always a fave. 

It didn't let us either. It's still so darn good. The meat is still so flavorful and the texture is perfect. I got the cachapa which is like a corn pancake with cheese and the skewers are shrimp and steak, and chorizo comes with it. The chimmichurri with it is so darn good.

Hubby had the llanera arepa with with chicken, steak, chorizo, avocado, and cheese. It is awesome too but my cachapa with skewers was the better of the two. I love salty and sweet!!!

Another awesome option here is the patacon sclyper. They use a sweet plantain for that sweet savory heaven and u can pick the meat.

For app, I just can't not get the tequenos - cheese sticks. Always addicted to them.

Wash it down with a passion fruit smoothie!!!

That is heaven right there!!!! 

This place is small. Packed to the rim on the weekend. Today was perfect for us! Not busy. Just a few handful of tables inside and two outside.

Go here and be happy and enjoy!!!

3.5 - My chicken paitan ramen was A-OK. It did hit the spot since it was a chilly for a Floridian kind of afternoon. I am pissed that it was the higher of the priced ramen and I didn't get the damn egg. I know right, an egg, what's the big deal. I feel like that's the cherry on top when it comes to ramen.  It still was good and flavorful. 

The chicken initially was interesting, but it did have more flavor. I would definitely come back and get a diff ramen with the egg included. I know there was other additional inclusions in this ramen that weren't in others, but that is def my favorite part lol! To each is own right?!

This restaurant is amazing-mazing-mazing! Can't beat Colombian and Peruvian food here! This is an ultimate fusion if I can say so myself. Check out the picture of the sweet arepa burger and just don't think of anything else. Just get it. And my Peruvian ceviche, I love it. I dream for it and sing out loud when I have it! It's amazing. The restaurant space is huge. A billion times bigger than their last space. I love it. I love everything about this restaurant! Can't wait to go back!

I had been following their FB for a while. They have videos of their food, and if you haven't been here before it's so helpful to see.

Their calzone caught my attention. It was mountainous on the fb video and in person. 
I ordered the pick three toppings for $17. It already comes with mozzarella, the three toppings I chose were mushroom, meatball, and ricotta. This calzone is definitely the best in the area. The dough had flavor and it just wasn't dough. There was lots of the ingredients inside and we got a huge side of red sauce that was so flavorful.  Everything complimented this calzone. 

So happy we finally tried it. I agree with their Yelp ratings. So glad we tried this place for the first time. I was a bit nervous because we can be picky about pizzas or calzones plus always nervous that it's more dough than anything. 

That was not the case!

Also the person over the phone was super nice and helpful so bonus Happy points!!

If u think that Chicago Pizza is ALL deep dish, u r wrong! This is real Chicago thin crust pizza cut in squares and those four perfect small triangles in the corner. If you know Chicago Thin Crust Pizza, like for example Aurelio's thin crust pizza is to die for. 

This thin crust is the real deal and it has the corn meal like texture on the bottom. It's so nice and crispy. We even asked for extra crispy so the cheese has a lil char on top. I love sauce too so I would get extra sauce on the side. Which I had their bbq sauce on the side even though this is the standard red. It's so good too.

Our server Jeanette was very nice and helpful and this is a great new location for Paul's. We have been to their Clearwater location. This one is quite lit up and spacious. So best of both worlds one on each side. St. Pete and Clearwater! 

I will want to try their other Chicago legends - deep dish pizza, Italian beef, and chopped salad!!!

I was super happy with my shaken beef with garlic noodles. I did ask for no onion but they didn't give me any veggies whatsoever. I missed that but that's ok. I thought it would just be a bunch of noodles it was so flavorful.

My husband was happy with his pad Thai with beef. I was surprised it automatically included tofu. I ate the tofu but it was a bit hard for me.

I want to try their drinks and churros next time.

It's so good here and so cute!

I love The Honu. It's the perfect Hawaiian vibe and one can't not be happy here. They have amazing food and drinks and once you step in the door once you are their automatic friend and family! 

We have been here a few times and even came when they first opened. They have events, music and luau's which are a blast. I can't wait for the next one next year for their five anniversary.

Since It's been a while that we have been here, I know it was a perfect night to check out their new tiki bar. It's so beautiful and perfect! It is a must see when you are in Dunedin or close by like in Clearwater Beach or St. Pete, etc. 

I had the Ocean Breeze which comes with vodka straight from Hawaii and it was perfect for me with guava, mango, passion fruit and lime. My hubby had a pina colada.

We were able to catch up with the amazing owners, and we had the best server. They are so sweet, always welcoming, & and super upbeat. They even let me know that we are on their slide show inside.

They are also super pet friendly. Mocha Coconut loves this place especially the awesome dog menu and the whipped cream yum!!! 

As you can see, this place is definitely a paradise!

This building is beautiful inside & out, but other than that & the garlic bread, it's nothing mind blowing and extraordinary.

I ordered the chicken marsala and I thought it didn't have much of flavor. It did have the mushrooms and some sauce served with four wedge potatoes. It wasn't horrible. Just not memorable whatsoever.

I brought it home and put it in the air fryer. I don't get why it was breaded but just soggy. What really is the point of soggy breading. No thank you.

Glad I didn't go at dinner when it's more expensive.

They have a rooftop bar too. It would be fun to hang out at night when it's not too hot. One side has a garden view. The other side is a terrific train tracks view and parking view. 

Glad I checked it out and peaked my interest, but eh no biggie. My fave Italian food is Esposito's in Carrollwood. 

One last thing, service was just ok. Talk about boring and bland. Yeah him too! Show some enthusiasm or pretend your happy to be there dude! 

The best part of my whole experience was meeting up with a friend!!

11 Chicks is Amazing. I love love love arepas and cachapas. My fave are cachapas because of the soft and sweet corn texture. I ordered the paisa which is all the fixings except the meat. I had shrimp instead.  My hubby ordered the paisa with all the meat! This is flavorful in all directions I swear!

There are only 5 small tables inside and about two outside. This kind of restaurant reminds me of something I'd find in Key West, quaint, local fresh eats. The price is affordable and the service and flavor of the food is excellent. So happy I was able to try it. They close pretty early on Saturdays so make sure you try it as soon as you can for lunch. It's so worth it!

The Salty Crab is part of a group of Crabby Bill's restaurants which are in the area so I knew of it from the other restaurants in the area. 

I ordered a shrimp boil(I didn't take a pic, but served in a clear plastic bag with u peel shrimp, sausage, corn, and potato. You can choose cajun or scampi. I chose cajun which had a small kick but not spicy which is fine. It was pretty good. I wanted the crab boil but I am horrible at cracking crab legs.

My husband ordered the steak bowl which to me looked like a lot of rice and not too much meat but he said it was alright and did like it. 

Our server was nice, but you can tell he was quite busy even bartending.  

We went earlier so it was not packed yet for dinner but I can tell the hostess even with the tables still so open wanted to pack people in tables like sardines. I didn't understand when it was not so busy trying to get people's tables so close. 

This restaurant was good and served its purpose but I don't think I would be back.

It is dog friendly and if you end up getting a parking spot in front, it is a good choice. Jimmy Hula's is a couple doors down and is also another option too. Along with ice cream afterwards next door.

P.S. the live music is kinda mehhhhh!

People!! Make sure u clear a whole bunch of time in your appointment book. The wait on a Sunday afternoon was almost an hour and a half from walking in the door to getting my ice cream in hand. My end of line wasn't at the door at the time so those people had to have waited longer. 

Yes, it's brand new and there's nothing like it yet elsewise, so there's the justification of the hype.

At least I talked to everyone waiting in line around me, & we were all in the same boat! 

It was really good when I finally got my order. It was #11 Kaka crunchy with Nutella and cereal ice cream and my toppings were kit kat, m and m, and fresh strawberry. My sauces were strawberry and caramel.

I'm glad I tried it and the price was okay, but still... that wait?! Wow!

2 Legit! The Mexican food here is for real! & yes you can your Spanish here!  Dos sopes por favor. Carnitas y carne. So two orders of sopes one with marinated pork and one with beef. I liked the pork better but my hubby liked his steak better. It didn't have a marinade, just plain. It was so so good and it came in an order of three so it was pretty big and the price wasn't bad either.

I love the Mexican places that have the markets attached. This is it. It has a surprisingly a good size seating area and guess what? It was packed.

If you are looking for some real Mexican food in Clearwater, make sure to check this place out! 

And the horchata and agua frescas are huge too!

Phenomenal through and through!!!! I simply loved this place.  

I called in initially to check about reserving a table & to find out more about their Osso Bucco. They answered my questions and were so super helpful.

Once we arrived we decided we would like to sit outside because they have a perfect wrap-around porch area and the evening temp was to die for!  We were seated right away in a great spot with no issues with social distancing.

Our server Todd came by for our drinks.  Once we decided on orders, we picked out the fried green tomatoes, osso bucco, and scallops with 5 pepper jelly. Everything about our meal was memorable!  So much flavor and definitely very insightful delectable dishes.

Everyone who came by was amazing and Todd, our server was super fun with an infectious laugh! He let us know that his brother is the chef, & the business is family owned.

So happy I finally got to try H'ours Creole Smokehouse. We would definitely be back and love that their menu changes quite often.  Great variety of different types of food with a great mesh of flavor! 

They are also dog friendly!

Easily this experience was a meh for me. We ordered two bowls here and some donuts. It seems this place is more for the bread fried chicken sandwiches which we were really not in the mood for. Our bowls were quite simplistic and did not show any depth of flavor. A kid can whip the bowls up in a second. So easily non inspiring without a doubt.

The donuts afterward took the yucky flavor out of my mouth afterward. I had tasted my hubby's bowl with the mustard type BBQ sauce eww! So the donuts helped it a lot.

I like the area where it's situated bc inside and out is a pretty cool set up. If I were to come back, I'd order from Fresh Kitchen because I love their bowls and maybe, maybe come back for donuts.

Life changing at Astro Ice cream is the Guava & Cheese Ice Cream. 

Armature Works is a place for local Tampa eats and drinks, and Guava and cheese is Tampa!  I'd bring out-of-towners here just for It! 

They do have ice cream selections that are quite different than other places. For example, creme brûlée, rice crispy chocolate, plant city strawberry short cake, toasted coconut with rum, mango margarita sorbet.  Those r just a few off the top of my head. 

They have cones, cups, brownies and cookies for bases, and bulk ice cream, and tons of toppings, but Guava and cheese ice cream is what u must try here! 


Some tips from my experience here is Coconut ice cream with rum overpowers the Guava and cheese and mango margarita sorbet can be strong but with a brownie bowl, it simmers the flavor down! And it is refreshing. 

So don't forget to try the Guava and cheese ice cream and let me know what u think;-) it's the best of the best!

I really enjoyed Flan Factory! I love the vibe and it reminded us of a little Cuban cafe in Key West that we would walk to from where we stayed. We compare all the Cuban shops to it because it was that memorable.

I ordered the horchata iced coffee though It was too sweet. I even put more water in it to dilute the sweetness.  Next time I'd like to sweeten it myself.  My favorite dish when we were there was the timba - the fried cheese with guava. Oh that was amazing. You definitely have to order that.

We ordered two different sandwiches so we can try them both. The Elena, which is the monte cristo served with guava and the midnight special which is their Cuban sandwich in the sweet bread.  Our favorite was actually the midnight sandwich. Both were good, but next time I'd ask for extra crispy on both sides. I had leftovers of my sandwich and took it home and put it in the air fryer. I love the crispness from it. I can seriously dream of that sandwich and I'm honestly not always a sandwich person. These were great and filled to the rim, not just bread! 

Lastly, we ordered two flan. I mean hello, when at Flan Factory must order flan. They are small like the size of your palm. That's a good size after our lunch meal. We ordered the Nutella flan & the guava flan. They definitely were quite creamy. They don't have the intense Nutella and Guava flavor. They have more of the flan egg flavor. I do like to have more of the flavor profile. I'd maybe get more guava on the side with guava flan next time. But seriously there are so many flavors of flan. I couldn't order the same flavor.  Other options were horchata coffee, rum, orange, coconut, to name a few. 

Flan Factory has inside and outside seating, so dog friendly in the outside patio. It got busy on a Sunday, but the tables were nicely spaced apart. You order your food when you walk in and they bring it to your table. 

I would come back for sure when I'm in the area and get the timba, split a sandwich, & have an iced cafe con leche.

I think this place is a must stop if you are interested in great, not too expensive Tampa Eats! It's definitely not something you will find everywhere!

Hmm, I've been here 3 times, but three times too many. It's the only ramen place around here. They make sure it is super cold inside, and then you order ramen. They have a handful of ramen options, 3 rice bowl options, and some apps and salad. 

They only have one seafood option for ramen which is the curry seafood ramen. On the menu online they say the shoyu ramen has an option with shrimp and fish cakes, but when you see the menu in person, that's not even an option.

I think my curry seafood ramen is not served consistently from looking at the two pictures.  There's more crab meat and an egg in the first pic rather than the second one which doesn't have an egg and has a single skinny leg of crab meat. 

The server is overzealous. She comes back every three to five minutes and doesn't know what social distancing is. 

I'm really done with this place. I usually come here on a Friday, and I don't want to eat meat and would rather have seafood. But if curry seafood ramen is the only option, it's definitely not a favorite and not appealing.

This place is often empty when I come in so why do they want to put me in the booth right next to the other people. 

Yeah, I disagree with the high average review here, and I can safely say that I did give it three chances, and that's too many for me. 

Peace out Michi! I'm not being bitchy! Just being me!!( aka Real & Honest ) .

So excited that Uncle Maddio's is in the area. There are options for the whole family including traditional, whole wheat, and gluten free crusts for small, medium, and large custom made pizzas and foldwiches, as well as salads.

Toppings are fresh and there are an abundance of toppings. They also have a chart of what is gluten free as well as vegan which is good for those that do not eaten some things.

The service is great, friendly, and helpful, as well as the owners.

Grand opening weekend is now and there is still time to try their pizza for free or $1. It's a great and I'm excited to come back!

P.s. Sign up for their emails for deals and a free birthday pizza!

My hubby and I were surprisingly impressed by Mod Pizza. We love pizza but we are pretty particular. A lot of places shy away from flavor and are scarce in cheese and sauce and flavor in the crust. Mod pizza is not shy about it and we were extremely happy. I'm impressed how they paid much attention to detail. I've gone to a similar restaurant with the same concept and their lack of detail drove me away. Not Mod Pizza. Great Job to them.

I ordered their pizza with pumpkin, Canadian bacon, and added other items like roasted red pepper and pineapple with balsamic glaze on top. It had mozz cheese on top. Sounds different right. It's called the Kevin but I changed it up a bit. So so good!

My hubby had pretty much a bbq chicken pizza and enjoyed it a lot with pineapple.

You can customize it and have as many topics as you would like.

They also serve salads, salad on top of the pizza crust as well.

Great option that is not going to break your bank located next to the outlet mall. Many places around the outlet mall are overpriced just bc of the location. This is not.

They also have outside patio seating for those ideal sitting outside kind of days along with it being dog friendly.

Thanks to my coworkers I was able to try Amici's twice. 

I've tried a sausage pizza, white pizza, chicken wings, garlic knots, and potato ball. My favorites were the potato ball and the garlic knots by far. I'd definitely order those first.

I can't speak for pizza. Being from Chicago pizza is different. I've seen pics of Sicilian pizza which have sparked my attention. Maybe next time I will try it.

Amici's has been around for a while and now they have a new building. I've visited it before but my first impression was that it was extremely loud. So if I were to order on my own, I would take it to go.

Finally Sweet Buns is in town. I've been to the one in Gainesville a few times and it was always a must stop! My first experience of these sweet and savory buns was in Atlanta at Sweet Hut. It's the same set up but probably has a little bit more variety.

The buns are nice and soft inside. My favorites are the ones with the filling inside. It keeps it more flavorful. The egg tart was good as well as the lemon one with lemon filling. The peach filled bun was good but needs more peaches. The ones with no filling are not as flavorful but they are soft. But just simply reminds me of plain bread. 

The chocolate mousse cake is light and there are some other beautiful desserts I'd like to try in the future as well as their wonton egg noodle soup. The location in Gainesville I don't believe had the hot dishes so that's nice to see.

The location is great. Bobacup is close by as well as a Pho place in the same plaza.

Go get your buns on!!

What a perfect Friday night date night at this Cuban restaurant newbie! They have been open for 2 months and I must say nothing less than extraordinary!

They have three dining sections plus the outside patio. When you walk in to the left, I'm thinking that's like a big party room. Not sure if you can rent that out. The middle area is my favorite. Fewer tables with booths on the wall and the bar in front and music to the left. The room on the right has more dining space.

The music, atmosphere, service, food, and people were amazing!  I started with a mojito! This mojito was the best I have had in forever. I ordered the special whole snapper and my hubby ordered the churrasco steak!  Yummmm!!!

Jose, our server took good care of us, and everyone along the way that worked there was super welcoming! 

We will be back for sure! So many options, great atmosphere, music, food, drinks, service! A++++

I first came to Brickhouse Tavern last year for my birthday! For your birthday month they give you a free burger.

This time around I came back for my hubby's birthday. We ordered a Bison Burger and Duck Wings! Out of the two, the duck wings were our fave! It is definitely popular, and I'm glad people recommended it. Our bison burger was just okay this time.

Our server was nice and helpful and we liked sitting at the couch tables next to the fireplace. Very cozy. Even though there was sports everywhere on the tv's, it was a perfect volume and not too loud.

Umami Sushi wowed me from start to finish. I was quite impressed what they had done with the place knowing I had been there when it was a Chinese restaurant. It was literally like night and day! Great job on the ambiance.

Our serving was a sweetie and very patient. My hubby and I had questions galore. She was great and very helpful and always had a smile on her face.

We started with Fried Calamari. They weren't the standard teeny tiny fried ones you usually see. They were almost the size of onion rings and the breading was somewhat like panko. it was very crunchy, Not greasy whatsoever and the sweet chili sauce complimented it very well!

I ordered a pink lady roll. It was so so good with steamed lobster, mango, and spicy tuna. It wasn't spicy to me. Just had a perfect flavor. It was 8 good sizes pieces with not too much rice. It also had a fun little flashing light and palm leaf for decoration.

My hubby has the chicken yaki udon noodles which had a decent amount of chicken and some veggies. He liked it a lot.

The cherry on top was the tempura cheesecake. Oh that was so good and different than any other cheesecake that we had because of the tempura shell and the creamy soft cheesecake in the middle.

This Japanese/sushi place will be a new favorite. Everything inside and out are truly amazing! I wish them tons of success and happy people loving their food.

This is the second time I've been here, and probably the last. I'm simply not a fan.

The first time we came here I ordered the salmon risotto. The flavor profile is just spicy. I thought I could deal with it but I couldn't. My husband had the bbq chicken with Mac and cheese and mashed potatoes. 

This last time I had the mediteranean shrimp salad. The dressing is lemon tahini and again it has a kick and the flavor is not my liking. I ate the shrimp and the fried artichokes and dipped it in bbq sauce. I tried the poppy seed dressing which is a brown base not white and it's not good either.  We also ordered Cuban egg rolls and the Swiss mustard dip is overpowering.

The desserts look best out of anything. I just had a double chocolate sprinkle cookie. 

In regards to our service, our server was very absent and even when we needed to pay the bill and leave to get somewhere before a certain time. He seemed to cater most to the bigger table but the three small tables were clearly forgotten. 

The menu here seems like a decent selection but when looking at it closer, it's easy to say I won't be back. What did look more interesting to me would probably be the fish dip with pita and the lobster fritters.

Wow! This place has over 550 reviews! That's a lot for this area. Finally we tried it out!

The outside courtyard area is the best spot! It is not dog friendly there, but that's ok. They have side walk spots that are! Yes that is important to me, and that is ok!

I started off with a passion fruit house margarita. They had two other flavors besides the usual standard house margarita. $6 for house, with flavor $2 more. You can up charge for double tequila! My drink was amazing!!!! I loved it!

I also ordered the seafood mofongo and a duck taco!!!  I loved both of them big time. They were both sweet and savory which is me! The seafood mofongo also has a mofongo with pork and sweet plantains so it is definitely different. All the flavors stood out great! 

I love everything about this place, and will definitely be back to try the brunch!

Mmm Lobster roll!  I finally had one here, and I throughly enjoyed it. I wanted to eat it fast because it was so good, but I wanted to eat it slow so it wouldn't go away. It was filled to the rim with lobster. I would be happy just eating it with the lettuce instead of the bread. It was a good tasty amount. I got it cold, barely barely mayo. I don't like mayo. Melony got it warm with butter. I was very happy with mine just the way it was.

I had lobster bisque soup. You can have it also with fries, or clam chowder. It was ok, a thick reddish orange soup. I'd probably want it with a salad instead, if I could.

Our server Tina was great! She was cheerful and helpful! Definitely a people person who gave great suggestions to my hubby since he doesn't eat seafood. He had the burger. She also said the philly steak and wings were her fave.

This location looks older. That's fine. You won't even notice it when you are eating their lobster roll!

First impression of Bubba's was with my call ahead experience. The person on the phone was very nice. Once I came in, the host stand was in huge disarray. It wasn't even the busy time compared to how it looked  when I was leaving! There were about 3-4 people standing there, but they weren't really acknowledging the customers. 

The next big thing is there are tons of tv's. At least 30-40 tvs with different channels. The atmosphere is dark, loud, and sports bar like.

Once I looked at the menu again, nothing really  stood out. It's bar food plus they have their pizza, burgers, beer and apps, salads, and entrees.

For drinks they had a big drink menu. I picked a $4 sangria margarita. It was pretty good! They did bring me the regular big size which was their mistake. I didn't pay extra for it.

Food-wise, we didn't want burger or pizzas and observed they are on special on Mondays and Tuesdays!

I picked the Stromboli to share. It was alright and I actually liked the ranch sauce on the side better than the marinara. This was not a huge Stromboli at all, but it was fine.

Our server was ok. I don't think I would come back bc nothing really caught my attention.

I will definitely stick with Texas Roadhouse whIch  is across from them and has been long-standing and always dependable!

This is the 2nd time we have been here, but the first time it had been a few years ago.

Out of all of the Peruvian restaurants I have been to in the area, this is my favorite. The food is tasty. The service is perfect, The atmosphere Is beautiful. It is dog friendly, and the sangria is perfect.  This restaurant is good for both casual dining and special occasions.  That may sound weird, but I feel like it's all around perfect.

We ordered the tequenas  & yuquitas for an appetizer which is cheese and yuca. It comes with two dipping sauces. With yelp app, it ends up being free because you get $10 off when you check in.

We ordered lomo saltado and the special grilled swordfish. Both were very good, as well as plated nicely.  We lastly ordered tiramisu. That was good too.

All around, a perfect place in Carrollwood, a little bit off the beaten path. It is worth a drive for this wonderful place.

I can't say I was impressed with this place at all. I feel like it's just upscale wanna be mexican't. The best part of our lunch was the chips. Seriously, yes whatever the seasoning was along with the salsa, that was a hit.

I ordered the ceviche. I had originally ordered the Korean tacos, but they were out. The ceviche was alright. It did grow on me. I honestly couldn't understand their choice of chips that went with it. They were broken up yuca chips. They definitely would never hold the ceviche. I can't even say it complimented it well. It didn't. I ate the ceviche as if it was a chunky soup. I know sounds weird.

I tried the Brooklyn taco, but again what grossed me out the most was the pork belly.  Lastly the wet burrito, it was alright, but nothing mind boggling. My hubby said it was mostly rice too.  Lastly my passion fruit margarita was a flop. Definitely not the best of flavors. I sucked it up though and drank it all.  

I didn't say anything about my not so great margarita. It probably would have confused my server. She was a ding dong. You can tell she was new like probably never was a server. I was patient though. I know the place is new. It was lunch too. Not busy like dinner. She was good at talking about her broken nail only. That was about it.

Excellent Vietnamese food! What I love about this place is that they have menu options that are not found every where including whelk, lobster, and oysters. I love that they have an individual seafood menu.

This time around I ordered the shaken beef for my hubby. The nice thing is you can choose whether you want fried rice or white rice. Their fried rice is excellent.  Fried rice is easy to make, but this one definitely stands out. This whole dish was awesome beyond belief!

I ordered the clay pot fish. I'm confused though. I didn't know if it automatically was suppose to include pork belly or just one or the other. Mine was only fish. It was so good. The sauce reminded me of the shaken beef but fish. It included three filets and the bones weren't bad. I really loved this dish and had no leftovers. It was that good.

I washed it down with a mango fruit boba tea! Perfection was everything we had here as well as our great service.

It wasn't crowded so we were comfortable. Everyone was also wearing masks and social distanced! We went for late lunch on a Saturday and by the time we finished it was just us.

Another Broken Egg Café has a nice expansive list of breakfast options. These are not just the basic eggs and bacon, sausage, and plain pancakes.  There are definitely more, and they reflect their New Orleans style themed breakfast quite perfectly.

Their City Grits is a must. Wow, those were quite creamy and flavorful with cheese, bacon, and green onions. It was one of the last items I ordered and I'm glad I tasted it because it turned out to be my fave. 

One of their other rock star breakfast items was their lemon blueberry pancakes with goat cheese. What a hit!!  My hubby and I really loved that pancake and it was nice and fluffy. I actually had to make my own this morning for breakfast because I loved it that much! 

I also had their lobster and brie omelet. This honestly was not a fave for me. It just was not for me. The texture and the taste left me feeling bleh, but the excellent food mentioned above made up for it. The crunchy cube shaped potato hash browns were good, but a bit salty for me.  

 Beignets are quite popular in New Orleans, so of course they are a menu item here. They are served with orange marmalade. These were alright to me, yes just alright. Quite crunchy on the outside which I like, but I was looking for some softness in the middle. The orange marmalade was painfully sweet for me.

I washed all this down with some cappuccino and orange juice. Those were wonderful!

All in all I love the options here. I would definitely want to try their shrimp and grits, and the guy at the table next to me was loving his crawfish omelet to no end.  It left him speechless!

In terms of our service, most of everyone was exceptional.  Our male server though, he honestly was not the greatest, but the other servers were very nice and helpful to make up for that.  That didn't change my decision of liking this place. I really do.

I need Another Broken Egg Café to come to Wesley Chapel. I will be there with flying colors.

This is our second time at Pacific Thai Cuisine so that means we definitely like it. There's so many Thai places nearby in Oldsmar, Clearwater, Dunedin, & Palm Harbor. This restaurant still maintains its great average reviews for a great reason.

We come here and they are very friendly and welcoming. They are very helpful and consistent. And their food is huge and flavorful.

We r hooked on the same things because we know we like it here. That is the pad Thai which is great with all meats. The sauce is good. It has quite a bit of meat and sprouts and egg and it's not just plain noodles.

I get the crispy duck with pineapple and lychee and love the combination. It's such a huge serving and is so good with white rice.

We get the summer rolls and spring rolls for apps and all is just great!!! 

Definitely a great Thai option. Tables are nice and private. Everyone has masks on and that makes me feel better too!

I really liked everything I tried here including the Hawaiian roll, BBQ Salmon Roll, Volcano Roll, eel avocado roll to name a few.  My fave were the age tofu and the Hawaiian roll. I loved the mango sauce. The sesame balls were the best cherry on top.

Everyone that came around were super nicely, friendly, & helpful!  At first our food came out fast. It soon got busy, and I'm pretty sure our waitress forgot our next order. Without a doubt, I'm sure. Good thing we were okay from our first items we picked out, but still. We waited and waited while everyone got their food. Couples next to us dined after us and were done soon before us, and we were still waiting.

So the moral of the story of this place is don't come if you are on a rush. It may take a bit, or order all at once.

Also don't forget the sesame balls! It will make it allbetter :-)

Wow!! Pho Loc Tho has outdone themself!! I am so picky nowadays with food! I love Vietnamese food but I am always looking for something different than the rest. This is them.

I have been following their Facebook, and I've always wanted to try their seafood and mussels. I found myself in the area finally and I made a to-go order of their fresh rolls, steam bun, and their mussels.

Everything was excellent!!!!!!!  I'd give them 10+ stars if I could. Those mussels, wow that flavor, the size of them, the quality and quantity was excellent.  I loved the fresh rolls. I love fresh rolls but really they are all not created equal. These were great. The steam bun was huge and just so light and flavorful.

The transaction with calling my order in, and picking it up was easy as pie.

I would love to come back here for their crabs and seafood boil!!! 

Definitely give them a try if you haven't already!!!!!

I can't believe I've never been here before. Thanks to my friend Alyssa who just ordered from here the day before, I followed in her footsteps and had to get that strawberry velvet! We also ordered the chocolate hazelnut mousse cake which was a bit rich and cappuccinos to warm us up and make us happy in the evening.

Service was alright. Got in at the right time before the long line. It's kind of a disarray, but It was understandable. There's a few bar seats looking out the window, but mostly outside seating.

It's a a cute little bakery that also serves coffee, tea, and hot chocolate and has breads, cakes, macarons.

Check them out! It's a nice spot in downtown St. Pete on Beach Drive. Prices are not too bad considering the area either. 

We were happy!!

Love Love Love Mekenita Cantina!!! Loved them since they were in Lutz(North of Tampa) back in the day when I first moved to Florida.  Now that they are in Seminole Heights, this was only the second time I visited this location.

This location is awesome, stylish, cool, and dog friendly! The servers here are great and super helpful.

This last time we went, we did apps that were phenomenal. Plantain nachos with chicken was always our favorite staple, but the southwest egg rolls, and ahi tuna tacos made it even more over the top amazing.

When I have friends from out of town who want margaritas and Mexican, I'll take them here.

This is not just the ordinary Mexican food. It is way more than that.  The flavors are outstanding and so much diverse flavor.

Love love love this place!!!

Asiatic Street Food was excellent! Our server answered all of our questions and was very personable with us. 

I ordered a Thai Ice Tea first and it was so good and so pretty! Afterwards I ordered the Curry Noodles and my hubby ordered chicken and noodles.  They were called Kai Soi and Phat Kua Kai. They were perfect for us. My meal was a lot bigger than his. I was happy I had leftovers because they were even better the next day. I'm not sure why his dish was like a third of mine, so keep that in mind when you order it. It may not really be the case but I felt the sizes were quite a difference.


The ambiance is clean, lots of dark wood and bamboo. It is definitely a place that we will come back to, and try other options. 

I actually just saw a coupon for buy one get one free appetizer or drink. It's in the TBT!

I also learned their other location is Thai Thani so if u don't find what you are looking for on this menu, I'm sure they have it on the Thai Thani menu, or just ask!

Crabby Bill's had been on Clearwater Beach for at least 15 years since my first visit. They decided to rip it down and build it back up to a more modern style.

It's spectacular how you have views upon views of beautiful Clearwater Beach. It's a modern look that is similar in my opinion to the Hooters on Clearwater Beach with them having built up this time to take advantage of that view. 3 levels to choose from here. Ground level outside with umbrellas. Second level inside with A/C for the locals who can't stand the humidity, and third level outside with bay and beach views. You choose what you want, and they r dog friendly!

Choosing the second floor, we basked in the A/C and you can choose a window spot too.

I chose to drink the Signature Cruzan Crab Trap bucket, basically  their tropical mix drink, like a rum punch. Very good, but quite a bit of ice. I thought the drink would be bigger, but it's not.

We went for light bites this time. Conch fritters and crabbyfeller oysters. Both were just ok. Conch fritters weren't worth the price for the serving and the oysters were doused in the spinach crab dip. I was like, that pour little oyster is drowning.

I did see some buckets of heaven(seafood) to no end. Seafood boils, crab legs, corn on the cob, potatoes, lobster. I want all that and then some next time, but we weren't too hungry this time around. 

I'm sure we will be back and will review it even more!

P.S. Good luck with parking. You will need it;-), but that's typical Clearwater Beach! Who doesn't love Clearwater Beach though!?

This is definitely a fun little refreshing treat. I love the gelati since it is a combination of italian ice amd soft serve. I have tried several flavors. Cookie butter reminded me of cookie butter flavor at trader joes. I have also tried several others such as passion fruit, cookies and cream, and strawberry to name a few.

On this trip, I has the salted caramel, pina colada, and strawberry with vanilla soft serve. It was so so good. It was even better since it was free with my hubby's birthday coupon.

We will definitely be back. I like this location better than the one in S. Tampa. It has a nicer bigger covered but outside area.

Quality has gone down a lot. I use to love it here. This last visit was not good at all. We picked up a lot of goodies as always. A lot of stuff was gone but picked up some pastries, Pan de Bono, stuffed potato balls, deviled crab. I think the pan de Bono was the best out of them but the majority was bland and/or dry. 

We came to look at the cakes but I'm glad we didn't get one and they didn't really stand out to us either. I'm done with this place for a while.

I like it, I like it! My first experience with Thai rolled ice cream was.... umm lengthy and cumbersome to say the least!

This experience on the other hand was perfect! It was like reaching the gold at the end of the rainbow! I more than liked it, I loved it.

Everyone here was nice and friendly and helpful! They may have somewhat been in disarray, but they have only been open for a week! And I didn't wait forever at all!

My uni-roll was so good and different. It came with mango and passion fruit flavor, macaron, cotton candy, 2 syrups, and some other good stuff! My hubby and I both said Hell Yeah! More flavor than the first experience. 

I'll be back to try the Dragon Breathe and the other cool extraordinary flavors! 

Come here when you are in Ybor! U will be amazed!

Why, oh why did I eat so much popcorn at the movies last Friday?  I had no room left in my belly to enjoy any of the Yelp Eats specials, despite the drool the menu set off!
