I really like the idea of Sparkman Wharf. It's a good concept but there were some pros and cons. Hence the average 3 star review. 

The cons: 
- They layout is very cramped with how popular it is. 
- Needs more seating.
- The shipping container pop up restaurants are cute but they are so small that they run out of food fast. By the time I got there one was completely closed because they ran out of food and the one I wanted to eat at was out of half the items, including what I wanted. 

The pros: 
- Family friendly and pet friendly being outdoors.
- Right on the water, pretty views. They also have corn hole to play with friends/family. I think this place would be pretty at night since they have lights strung. But we came in the day so I didn't get to see it lit up. 
-Lots of variety as far as food choices (as long as they don't run out of everything). 

Would probably give this place another chance once the hype dies down some.

Really cute restaurant, really good food and standard prices. 4 stars inside of 5 because I ordered the big margarita and it was very weak. And also because service was very slow. But I would still come here again. It was very yummy. And you get free chips and salsa and it was good salsa.

Came on grand opening night and this place did not disappoint. Cute touch having a photo booth bus parked out front! Indoor seating as well as an outdoor section with lots of activities. 

Although we did not hang out inside due to the crowd, my review is based off the food and drinks. Everything was delicious which is rare for a grand opening! We shared a fishbowl drink called the swimming pool ($35). It was a really good deal considering the size of it! Their regular drinks were $10-$11 and much smaller. The fishbowl probably equaled at least 6 drinks. So if you commit to the same flavor it's the way to go. They also had Punch Bowl drinks which were $60, I don't even wanna know how giant those are! 

For food my friend had the Cuban and loved it and I had the lobster Mac n cheese melt and oh my god!! It was heavenly! So so good. Even the skinny French fries were really yummy. Definitely want to come here again!

Loved this place, so much fun! Very cute inside, lots of good photo ops. Drinks were $38 each for the fishbowl drinks but they are huge!! My friend and I split one and didn't finish it but it was good. 

It is very loud inside, it was too loud and we couldn't hear each other speak, but after asking a manager to turn it down he explained its company policy to have it loud because they want it like a party place but he did turn it down a few notches and it was so much better! 

For food my friend and I split the following appetizers: spinach dip, Mac n cheese pops, and meatballs. We enjoyed all of them!! The spinach dip was my fav. The meatballs were my friends fav. The Mac n cheese pops were a little dry but still good cause you can't really go wrong with Mac n cheese. 

If you order a celebratory dessert you get to pick a song for the waiters to sing and dance to when they bring it. Totally worth it! You're paying for the entertainment, dessert and a show! We ordered the banana split  and it was so big! Big enough to feed 6 people and delicious! Definitely worth it!

Came for brunch and loved everything here! First impression walking in, bigger on inside than the outside looks, huge bar with a whiskey wall, and super cute inside. I think the cocktails were my fav part, really really good drinks!! So smooth and go down way too easy. 

For food my friend and I split the chicken n waffles with sausage gravy and the French toast monte cristo. Both were super good and we left very full. Def wanna come back to try more things!

Really hip bar/club. Two separate club rooms, with different music, separated by an open air courtyard. Multiple bars and couches to lounge on. Upscale dress code. Came on a Tuesday and they do have a $10 cover charge but then it was an open bar until 11pm so that totally more than paid for itself. Always have a great time here.

Typical pub food. Nothing extravagant. Good prices. Our waitress was nice. No happy hour on food deals at this location. I was misled since other locations have happy hour appetizers but they only have deals on drinks here. My husband had the meatloaf, my father had the steak (They both enjoyed their meals) and I had the biggest meal of all: the zinger mountain. It's a pile of loaded fries with spicy zingers (chicken tenders) on top. This is enough for 4 people to split lol.

Really good sushi and a really great happy hour! $2 beers, $4 wines and $5-$7 sushi rolls! Cute decor on the inside, had little oriental umbrellas hanging from the ceiling. Kinda small inside. Sweet staff. Would recommend and eat here again.

I've now been here a couple times and I have no complaints food wise and drink wise. They have indoor and outdoor seating, I prefer the outdoor because the seating is more comfortable but there are some couches on the inside too, but it does get loud. Tried their seasonal pumpkin spice latte beer it was ok. The Mac n cheese bites are out of this world! Highly recommended those.

From food to drinks to decor to service, everything was great! I had the flirtini for my drink off of the waiters recommendation and it was delicious! Well I forget what my friends drank but all the drinks were delicious!

For a starter we shared sushi and for my meal I had the scallops with ramen. My friends both had steak. Everything was delicious and I will def be back! 

Even the bathroom was super nice and clean which is a huge deal for me!

Not a Cuban food fan but my husband finally got me to agree to come here. Not gonna judge it on my opinion since I don't like pork or beans or Cuban food lol. Everyone else likes their food. They were out of pork when we came so I had a Cuban with no pork which is pretty much ham and cheese and I added mayo and pickles, it was ok. 

Have to sit outside in the heat, they have a small indoor section but was fully packed. Can come with your fur baby. Seems to be popular, the line never dies down. Free Cuban shot of coffee with yelp check in, the coffee was delicious!

This place was absolutely delicious and worth every penny! Kind  of smaller on the inside so you probably need reservations for busy nights. I had a blackberry tequila cocktail and it was very refreshing. My friend had the vanilla bean cocktail but it primarily tasted of the lemon and honey that's in it. 

Then for my meal I had the shrimp and scallop risotto which was so creamy and everything was cooked perfectly. The scallop cut like butter. There are two portion sizes, I had the smaller size. My friend had the pork shank (comes with risotto) and her also was cooked perfectly and tender. 

For dessert I ordered the passion fruit semifredo. First off, all their desserts are so pretty so you have to get one. Second it tasted just as good! Sweet but not too sweet. Very balanced. Did not have any complaints here.

I already liked Datz so when this new location opened up we had to try it. First downside was the hostess was completely rude. Had obvious attitude. But during our wait for a table we sat at the bar and the bartenders were super friendly and funny. So that helped make up for it. 

Not normally a huge Bloody Mary fan, but these were actually pretty good! And the candied bacon inside was delicious. Ordered the totchos as an app. Huge portion, great for sharing with lots of people (my photo was taken after half was already eaten lol). 

I split with a friend the chicken n waffles Benedict and the creme brûlée French toast. The French toast was the clear winner at the whole table!!! Huge and delicious!! Came with a side of bacon, also delicious. The chicken n waffles Benedict was ok. Chicken was dry but adding syrup helped. Came with a side of "bacon-infused potatoes" which were good but just regular potatoes, no taste of bacon. 

Everyone else at the table enjoyed their food. Only other complaint was in another order of eggs Benedict there was eggshell in the egg. 

Oh and the sweet tea, which is super yummy, is also such an adorable presentation! Comes with a mini pitcher for refills served on a tray with the glass and lemons. So cute!

Loved this place! Such a cute, fun, elegant and modern atmosphere! Indoor and outdoor seating. Both great but we sat outdoor. So pretty with flowers and lights and couches! 

Amazing happy hour deals!! Will def be back here. Split with a friend the charcuterie plate, cheese plate, pickle fries, pork rinds and chargrilled oysters. Along with a couple $4 cocktails. Great deals!

Came through the drive through for milkshakes and they are offering free fries during the whole quarantine so we got milkshakes and free fries! Woo hoo! Love their cheese sauce also, best cheese fries!

Pleasantly happy with all the dishes. Everything is in house made, included the free bread they serve with butter. They also served us a free bruschetta to nibble on. They make their own pasta, dough, sauce etc. 

I ordered the pollo Romano without artichokes and had angle hair pasta on the side in Alfredo. Huge portions, enough for two meals so I took half to go. Chicken was cooked great, crispy outside while the inside wasn't over cooked. The lemon, basil butter on top was delicious when melted into the chicken. My husband had the chicken Parmesan, pretty standard but he ate it all. My brother and his girlfriend both had calzones and they also ate it all. You can tell the calzones were made from scratch. 

For dessert my hubby and I split the raspberry Creme brûlée, which I highly recommend! It was not overly sweet, semi sweet, and super creamy with a thin layer of that crunchy topping. Real raspberries inside, not artificial flavoring. Super yummy. 

They have their own parking lot which is always a plus, especially in an area like this where some places are only valet. Our waitress was great and friendly. I would definitely dine here again.

Really cute little bar/restaurant. Family friendly. Had tvs with sports games in the bar area. Didn't actually have food here but had a couple different drinks. The mojito was not good and tasted like sour mix just a mojito. But the margarita was really good. Good beer selection. Standard prices and the bartender was really sweet. Very cute place overall and would come back for drinks and to try food.

Omg yum yum yum! I came on a recommendation and loved everything I had here! Good wine list. Amazing food. Good service. 

I had the octopus which was very flavorful! And the fig and prosciutto flatbread, also full of flavor! This place knows how to combine flavors for sure! Also those truffle fries, omg amazing! I definitely already want to come back here!

Wow, this place is not for the faint of heart! I never thought too much gravy was a thing until I came here, they are not shy with gravy! Very good, just very heavy. Biscuits were swimming in a pool of gravy.

At first walking in it was not what I expected. I pictured a sit down restaurant with waiters. They have tables you can sit at but you walk In and order your food at a counter like a fast food restaurant. No waiters/ waitresses. Didn't care for that concept because I hate getting up to get my food. Plus I wanted to sit down and look at a menu but was rushed to order. 

The food quality was pretty decent. No added hormones, fresh, etc. good size portions and good value. What I really loved about this place was the individual packaged lemon slices next to the water.

Completely agree with Megan Qs comment under mine. (We came together with a group). Everything sounded amazing on the menu and unfortunately no one was impressed with any of it. "Stuffed cheesecake French toast" was not stuffed at all. It was two slices of French toast with a cheesecake flavored drizzle on top and that was it. No filling in between the layers at all. 

I'm not going to repeat her review and list all the food items we tried but they all went along those lines. When a brand new place opens I expect it to be chaotic and not have all the kinks worked out. Like seated and having our food with no silver ware.  I understand that. So that did not sway my vote. But the food quality is the food quality and I don't see that getting any better over time. 

It's great that this place is 24 hours so I'm sure it's a great place to go after a late night of drinking, when you will eat anything. Other than that I don't foresee us coming back here.

Very impressed with my last experience here. My husband and I love their food but usually just get it to go. Well last time we order wings and cheese fries to go. The wings usually are 10 to an order. I didn't check it before driving away but I got home and one order had 8 the other had 5. So I called the manager and explained to her what happened. She was very nice and offered to remake everything for us and deliver it. We were out of the delivery territory yet they made the exception and drove a whole new order over to us. She went above and beyond so that impressed me since customer service is so rare now a days.

Got some take out from here for lunch. Came in to pick up order and the restaurant itself was super cute. Decorated like Greece on the inside but I really liked the giant outdoor seating section they have, it's a covered porch that has table and outdoors booths! 

A little pricey but good food! I couldn't decide between spanakopita and a gyro so I got both lol. I ate half of the spanakopita and like 1/3 of the gyro, they were both filling. The gyro was huge and stuffed with lots of meat! At least I can get a couple meals out of it. I also had to get a cannoli of course. $6 for one cannoli! A little pricey again for me but pretty good. I would eat here again.

Been here a couple times for brunch. Love the look of this place and love the drinks. The passion fruit mimosa is so good but the pomegranate is not lol. Though the other cocktails are really good. I had the strawberry mint margarita and it was super fresh and did not taste like sour mix! Very good. 

I ordered both the mini tuna tacos and empanadas because I couldn't decide and they were both super good! I ate it all, comes with 3 each of both appetizers. My friend had the brunch tacos and said they were ok. I loved my food and drinks but deducted a star because our waitress was not good. I guess service is a hit or miss. But would still come back here!

It does not matter what day we go, what time we go, if it's busy or slow but somehow the service is always horrible and slow. For that reason I deducted a star. Other than that I love coming here and I love the food. (If you can be patient enough to wait for it.) 

For starters we ordered the mac & cheese bites. These are seriously so good and I could eat them every day. They come with a cheesy dipping sauce that taste kind of like Alfredo. We get these every time we come so don't miss out. 

 For my entrée I ordered the Parmesan crusted chicken salad. It has a balsamic glaze dressing. Very delicious. I was torn between this and my other go to which is (a secret menu item you can order) The Buffalo Chicken Parmesan. It comes with a Gorgonzola cream sauce on the pasta instead of marinara. It's to die for. My hubby ordered a basic entrée of chicken with potatoes. Nothing special. 

To sum up: The facility is always clean and bathrooms are nice. Food is delicious. Drinks and wine are delicious. Service is slow. But I will continue to come back.

I REALLY REALLY want to give this place 5 stars. If I were rating solely on our waitress, our food, drinks and decor this place would have five stars by far! My husband and I have been to multiple locations of Rocco's tacos and we love them all! Sadly I had to deduct a star because I cannot ignore the horrid start to the evening. 

(Skip next paragraph to skip me venting)
Yes, I realize that it was the first week of being open and there is bound to be a wait, that's expected. However we showed up and were told we would have an hour and a half wait, OK well that's fine. 2 hours go by so I go inside to check our status with the hostess, she proceeds to tell me we are next in line and it will be 15 minutes. So as 30 minutes go by and I see others sat I go up to ask the outside hostess (where we were standing) and she tells me there are five parties ahead of us. I say we were just told we were next in line 30 minutes ago and she says "did the inside hostess tell you that because you need to take that up with her I have nothing to do with that." So I go back to the original lady and explain the situation saying she told us we were next in now we are five behind and she just tells me you will be seated shortly in a rude tone and rude expression on her face. We waited over three hours, Double the time we were told from the beginning. Had that whole horrid experience not of happened this would be a five star review.

The decor is like the others I've been too, super fun, bright and eclectic. The drinks are always good. There was a huge selection of tequila at the bar which I was unable to get a photo of due to how crowded it was. My girlfriend ordered the black diamond margarita which has black cherry purée it was absolutely delicious! Hers was way better than mine which was the blood orange margarita. It wasn't bad but it tasted like a normal margarita, not heavy on the blood orange. Nonetheless they still use good tequila. 

For starters we ordered the tableside guacamole AND the Austin queso. (After all we waited three hours to eat dinner, we were starving!) I would skip the Austin queso, it was small for $11 and the consistency was off, it was like a hummus texture, (not liquid cheese). Just go straight to ordering the guacamole! They bring out a cart and make it tableside in a lava rock bowl. You decide how spicy you want it and tell them to make it mild, medium or hot. We like the spicy guacamole! It was so fresh and delicious. Even their tortilla chips are fresh in-house made and you can watch them doing so through a window.

For my entree I ordered the camarones patron. Oh Em Gee! Soooo good!!! I've had many different things from Rocco's tacos but this is going to be my new go to!  It is shrimp sautéed in a tequila, chipotle butter sauce with peppers! Served with flour tortillas to create your own tacos. Amazing! I am all about the sauce and that sauce was so delicious. Definitely worth $15 and every calorie! 

My husband had the carne Molcajetes for one. Which is kind of like a giant fajita lava rock bowl with all the fixings and tortillas on the side and you can order it for one or two people. We usually split this but I opted to try something different. He stuck with the go to because this also has a delicious sauce.

The friends we were with ordered verde enchiladas and al pastor tacos. We were all way too full to finish but everyone loved their food. I really don't think you can order a bad thing here, everything is fresh and delicious. 

One small note to the management: the music was too loud. Not sure if this is the vibe you are going for, a club vibe, but no one was able to talk at the table and hear each other. Don't get me wrong, we loved the music choices, very fun but a tad too loud. If turned down a bit so you could still have conversation it would be great.

Nice hangout spot. Big fishbowl drinks, decently priced. Lots of games to play. Didn't have any of the food but the drinks were good. My fishbowl drink did not taste strong at all but was yummy. It is on the louder side in here but that's cause they get busy and it's pretty big inside!

Didn't get pics of the desserts, we ate them too fast. The desserts were better than the sandwiches. The sandwiches were ok but very filling. I ate mine over two days. Half of it filled me. I had the roast beef with mushrooms and bacon. It has a yummy garlic spread on it but I was disappointed in the white bread not even toasted. My friends had the monte cristo and a grilled cheese with tomato. 

For desserts we got the cheesecake brownie, ordered a piece of coconut cream pie but they gave us a slice of the coconut cake instead, and then a slice of the chocolate peanut butter cake. The chocolate peanut butter cake was the best! So good and the slices were huge!

Love the concept of this place. Very cute inside but got the charcuterie to go. It comes in a cardboard box but we rearranged it onto a platter once we got home. They are DEF not the cheapest for charcuterie around here. But they charge per item and you build your own. We chose three meats three cheeses and a couple accompaniments which are also extra and it was $52. We asked for extra bread and crackers, and when I got home there were literally two crackers and a bunch of extra bread. I would've preferred the crackers so that was a little irritating. But it was pretty decent, I don't know how you can go wrong with a build your own charcuterie. The goat cheese stuffed peppa dews were great!  One side only comes with 3 so we got two sides of that.
New favorite rooftop bar! Really good drinks. Really great view. Really comfortable lounge seating. Cute and modern. I just loved it!

Little tip, if you are wanting to come here for the entertainment than request to be seated downstairs. This is why I wanted to try this restaurant but they sat us upstairs so we missed most of the show. In that regard not too impressed. 

The food was delicious. Although I missed out on the show, the food was really good so I was not too disappointed. I ordered the Gyro platter and substituted the Greek fries for the spinach and feta orzo. It also came with a Greek salad. I enjoyed all of it. $13 for my meal. 

I thought the price point was reasonable since they give you enough for portions. Everyone was full. No appetizers. I also managed to score free glass of wine because if you check in on yelp you get a free wine with happy hour but our waiter honored it anyway. So nice! 

Deducted a star because the floor throughout the whole restaurant was really sticky. Not sure if this has to do with the entertainment since I missed it all but everywhere you walk is sticky. They throw napkins in the air as part of the show so while walking from the bathroom to the table we all had tissue stuck to the bottom of our shoe.

Wow so delicious!! When we sat they gave us free bread and herbed oil and it could definitely be an appetizer I would pay money for! It was sooo good! The waitress was nice enough to let us do half and half on the pizza. Great menu and prices and everything was delicious! Definitely does not taste like a chain or fast food pizza place. Everything was so fresh and lots of toppings! The New Yorker (supreme) was loaded with meat and fresh veggies! I would def come back here again.

Had to get it to go due to covid. I'm sure it's better in person. But still pretty standard, yummy Thai food. I had the Pad Thai which is my fav Thai dish. It was not as spicy as I like, it's milder, but when I got home I added some sriracha and it was delicious! Standard prices. Yummy spring rolls. Would order from here again.

Boozy ice cream, boozy fondue, edible chocolate teacups....what's not to like? This place is so cute! Such a fun little spot. Came with a group of girl friends on a Sunday. We all shared a variety of things. The burrata was really good, the beer cheese fondue was more liquidy then normal but that's because there was a lot of beer in it, you can actually taste the alcohol in all their dishes. The chocolate fondue comes with your choice of whiskey or Irish cream and we opted for the Irish cream. We also shared a Brie, turkey and pesto panini that is not pictured but was delicious. 

I had the key lime pie martini ice cream with the orange liquor pour on top, I liked it better without the added alcohol but the ice cream by itself was good! My friend had the almond joy ice cream in the chocolate teacup on a chocolate saucer with a chocolate spoon and it was so delicious. 

Also not pictured are the mimosas. Their mimosas are champagne with a scoop of flavored fruit sorbet on top. They offer bottomless mimosas as well.

I have been here for both brunch and dinner. The brunch sadly did not wow me, with so many great brunch buffets I expected a little more. However they have indoor and outdoor seating. I love the decor inside and all the colorful fish around the place. 

The dinner I felt was better than their brunch. I came for a big family dinner and ordered the twin lobster tails. The food was great and everything was cooked perfectly. It is a little pricey but it's an upscale restaurant on beach drive so you should expect to pay a pretty penny. And dress nice .

Honestly I've tried this place a few times, and I'd like to say I'm ordering wrong but every time I order I get something new and it's just ok. The rice has no flavor and it's not bad but I honestly think Publix sushi has more flavor. 

They do have a good lunch deal, pick 3 different rolls with a soup or salad for $12.

I read the other reviews of this place and thought "it can't be this good!  are these all plants?"  But then I saw it was real people, including numerous Elite Yelpers, who had reviewed this operation so I was hopeful it would live up to the hype.  

In a word, it did.

Okay, that was two words but I have to say I had one of the most enjoyable experiences I've ever had on any tour when I took the Brew Bus this past weekend for the "Full Pour" tour.

Arriving at the Brew Bus terminal and brewery, you have time to sample some of their own beers.  Check in for the tour was easy and Dom, our guide, was very outgoing and made sure everyone felt welcome.   We were able to load the bus on time and start for our first brewery in Lakeland.

On the bus, we were able to sample some Brew Bus beer and play a little trivia.  In addition to Lakeland Brewery, we stopped at Brew Hub and Two Henry's.  We were at each stop long enough to enjoy the place, taste some beer and get a bite if you wanted to.   The bus driver (Dave) provided great transportation in a safe and professional manner.

Everyone was so nice.  I went by myself but felt like I was hanging out with old friends by the end of the day.  I was even invited to go out after the tour by multiple people!  

I would recommend that you Uber your way there and back so that you can enjoy the beers along the way without worrying about having to drive at the end of the tour.

If you're like me and are reading the reviews asking "Can it really be this good?", I will answer that question for you.  Yes, it can.  I'd do this again in a heartbeat.

I promise, I'll be worth the wait

So I decided to wait awhile and stand in line for Hattie B's hot chicken, and I promise, it was worth the wait.

Had a late breakfast so wasn't really hungry around 12:30 but figured there would be a wait and that we'd be ready to eat by around 1:30 so headed over and got on line.  We were just past the telephone pole at the end of their small parking lot and it took us just over an hour to get inside.  Once we ordered and sat down, we had our food in five minutes.

I had three medium tenders, fries and pimento mac and cheese.  The fries were fine, the pimento mac and cheese was delicious!  I could have had just that and would have been fine.  The tenders were absolutely huge!  My fiance and I seriously could have split one of these meals between us and been fine.  I had the "medium" sauce and when I started eating it, I naively thought "This isn't too bad".  But then after a few minutes, my nose was running and my eyes were watering.  It's a spicy heat that creeps up on you.  It wasn't a painful heat or anything but don't be fooled, it's spicy.

Go early and go hungry.  This is a place you should definitely put on your Nashville food wish list.

I had forgotten that I ate here 2 years ago until my morning run along the Riverwalk and I ran right by the place and said "Oh I ate here!".  I assumed I would have written a review but I couldn't find it. 

I had the crab mac and cheese which was really good, and the roasted beet salad which was also tasty. I was driving so I didn't drink anything except water.  The service as I recall was fine.  

Overall a very nice place.

The food here is great.  It's a shame that the service is awful...  We got there around 7 o'clock and our first round of drinks came quickly.  And then it all went downhill from there.  They have a good beer selection and I went with the Yazoo Pale Ale.  My friends asked the server for recommendations and she clearly had no knowledge of the beers whatsoever which was disappointing.  She also told me their seasonal beer was an IPA which just doesn't make much sense in the middle of summer.  To be fair, she did indicate the she was new.  Management really needs to educate their staff a little more thoroughly.

I requested another Yazoo pale ale around 8 o'clock.  At 8:30 when I still didn't have my beer, I asked again.  At 9:00 I inquired yet again.  At 9:15 after my friend requested to speak to a manager, my beer magically arrived within 30 seconds.  We spoke to another server and he blamed the bar but my glass was dripping with condensation and had clearly been sitting at the service station for a while.

They finally brought out the food around 9:45 (2 hours later) but only for 2 people out of the 9 in our group.  The other 7 of us had to wait another 10 min.  

I ordered the hot chicken and it was very good but could not make up for the awful service.  The manager also got confrontational and rude with us when we told her we thought she should at least take one item off our bill.

Délicieux! 

I think the Art Alliance building finally got it right. Le Cheri is just perfect for this space. The ambience and look of this space is totally perfect for upscale-ish french cuisine. 

Now onto the food...Dare I say that this might be the best steak tartare I've ever had? I dare. It was melt in your mouth tender, with a delicious lightly dressed frisee salad on top with crunchy homemade potato sticks. Heaven! We then had some sort of stew with chicken oysters, sausage and I can not remember the rest but it was bold, homey and delicious! 

For our main courses we had the artic char and the steak frites. The char was the winner for me but not because the steak wasn't also amazing. The char was perfectly cooked and laid on top of a tasty succotash with a creamy sunchote puree. A little bit of everything made for the most perfect bite! The steak frites was also amazing. So tender, rich and the frites were fantastic! I can only describe them is as mashed potatoes, formed into a rectangle and deep fried....um yeah. 

By the time we got through all of that food, we really didn't have any space for dessert. Dessert will have to wait for our next visit and yes, we will be back!

I have been wanting to try this place for a while so I was excited to meet my friend for dinner here the other night. I love this place! 

The atmosphere is understanded, not your stereotypical "Mexican" theme. I think it is beautiful. I especially love the face light sconces and other metal sculptures. 

We were there when happy hour was still going on (4pm until 630pm during the week) so that was amazing! I had looked over the menu before going and was looking at a couple different things, all of which were on the happy hour menu ($5 aps and $2.50 tacos plus $5 house margarita and I believe sangria). I was able to try the Empanadas de Hongos, a Pescado a la Parilla taco and a Pollo Tinga taco all for $10! The empanadas are stuffed with mushrooms and goat cheese and are placed in a fresh green salsa. This was wonderful. The tacos were both very good too. I do happen to like another restaurant's tinga better than Besito's but I wouldn't walk away from theirs either!

I like hot sauce, so much so that my husband says I would put it on ice cream. Any time I go to a restaurant I always ask for hot sauce. Our waiter brought me some regular hot sauce as well as their house made hot sauce which is a habanero based sauce and more like a paste. He did warn me that it was really hot and it was and I loved it! 

Their house margaritas are also really good and I am picky about margaritas. I hate when places use cheap mixer. This is not the case here. Theirs are near perfect. 

Our waiter was great too, he was there when we needed him and left us alone to visit. All in all, it was a great visit and I will come back.

Birthday dinner! Do not forget to ask about dinner specials! Birthday Hubs ordered tonight's special and is getting a bone-in New York York with all the fixings plus 1/4 rack of ribs!!! Not crowded,  but can get really busy ... so get there early! Great atmosphere with a solid menu... oh,  and the food is delicious! They make their au jus and BBQ sauce in house,  keeping it warm on the grill... waiting for dunking (may or may not be a technical term)! Then onto the grill, which when looking at it, makes you want to "beef" up your own backyard setup. But why? Silver Saddle is right here,  waiting to make your BBQ dinner dreams come true!!!
Also, be sure and ask about their daily lunch specials!!!

Stopped here before going out on congress st for my bday. My actual bday was the weekend before but I was in Phoenix, so my Tucson friends took me out the weekend after my birthday. Just one of my friends wanted to eat so the rest of us got drinks and an appetizer. The server was rude from the beginning. Having been a server before I understand the frustration of a table ordering one meal, but it happens. There were only 4 of us btw.

At the end of the meal/drinks my friend asked if they did anything for birthdays. And instead of just saying no. The server decided to bring out a plate with a candle and wrote in dry erase marker "I don't know if it's really your birthday". Are you kidding me? What a passive aggressive prick. Just say no we don't sorry. 

For that I will never come back to this restaurant.

Came to this place for its high ratings but I don't understand why this place has so many high ratings when it's not even worth it.. I don't remember our servers name but she was white with blonde hair, our food didn't come out in order so by the time one person got their food everybody was done eating, every order came out sporadically and looked like the food was CHEAPLY MADE for an EXPENSIVE PRICE!! Nobody at the table enjoyed their food and some plates weren't edible, they weren't even touched and on top of that our server did not deserve that "20% tip charge, $40 tip" she added for herself! She should have gotten $0 for her service. On top of her acting like she could care less and her SARCASM! Our bill came out to almost $300 for some crappy food and we didn't even order any alcohol! My advice is you are better off going to a high end restaurant than going here. This place fits in the same category as McDonald's.

**The owner is also very rude to the way he responds to people you can see it on all of the reviews why give this place business?? I don't think they deserve it at all that's why they deserve less than one star if possible

** Another update I just posted a "private" message I received from the owner, to show proof to everybody what I'm talking about how unprofessional this place is and how you get harassed will keep updating on anything because the attitude checks are much needed

I was here on a couple of occasions during my brief visit to Santa Barbara. Clearly, something's off with the behavior of the staff as already pointed out by the rest of the reviews.

Pros
Huge parking lot
Better hours than most CVS / other convenience stores. [This store's open till 2 am]

Cons
Behavior and services offered. We were desperately trying to look for coffee late in the night. 
We figured out the aisle but couldn't find what we were looking for and happened to ask one of the staff and received some cold/ unpleasant stares and questions which did leave us fairly surprised.

Calling out again that my review is based off a couple of visits only.

I had a fantastic first-time dining experience at Sampan a couple nights ago. When I entered the restaurant and the dark dining area with bright blue lit walls, I was immediately drawn to its trendy, romantic ambiance. This is a great place to bring a date, the dining areas have an intimate feel. You can also sit at the kitchen bar and watch the chefs create their delicious dishes. 

The menu consists of several categories served tapas-style (small portions, meant to be shared). I was dining with a finicky eater who would not eat seafood or veggies. Yeah, tragic... So pardon my review on the limited selection I was able to order.

Korean BBQ Beef - phenomenal. Best dish of the night. Tender, melt-in-your-mouth, impeccably seasoned beef with a little kick from the ginger and kim chee.

General Tso Soup Dumpling - great new concept, but I didn't get much of the "General Tso" taste, just chicken and ginger. Still good.

Pork Bao Buns - pork is crispy and sweet on the outside and tender on the inside. Accompanied by basil, shallots, and chili sauce to create a rockin' party in your mouth. All this wrapped up in cute little bao buns.

Filet Mignon - incredibly tender and juicy, I was cutting it with my fork. Not too much seasoning to overpower the simple awesomeness that is filet mignon. Comes with a mustard hollandaise sauce. Not even necessary, though it is quite tasty. I used it with the fries, which are crunchy and delightful.

Kim Che Fried Rice - only dish I that made me say "ehh." Not too much flavor, nothing special about it.

Prices are pretty reasonable for the area. I'd say about $40-$50 per person. I'll be back for frequent visits. This place rocks!

During my travels in Florida I was in the mood for some really good New York style Pizza. I noticed Angelo's and I decided to try them out. As soon as I walked in I noticed there was a lot of locals having lunch and that was a clear sign that the food at Angelo's was going to be a treat. 

I was greeted by a very nice lady and I quickly noticed the cleanliness of the restaurant. I ordered a typical cheese pizza like I would if I was in NYC and when I took a bite... I felt like I was there! 

Angelo's is truly a NYC pizzeria!

Chicken Nigella. Let me repeat myself. Chicken. Freaking. Nigella.

Ok, real quick, the place is small and personal. Nice. The options are a plenty. great.

But I'm here to tell you about the BEST Chicken dish I've had....ever....that I can recall. I read a review with another yelper stating THEY thought it was the best chicken dish. I was extremely skeptical. And I really don't like chicken much. I almost never order it at a restaurant. I only eat it to be healthy or the opposite when it is fried(shout out to Popeyes). So I was in the healthier mindset so I got the Chicken Nigella. It was lightly "pulled" chicken, with the most perfectly balanced flavoring and spices. It does have a slight kick to it, but in the most perfect way possible. The garlic notes from the light white sauce melded the rice and pieces of chicken into a fantastic and unexpected surprise! Much like the surprise of a boob popping on the screen of a PG or PG-13 80s movie......yes, THAT special.

I'm willing to bet EVERYTHING is good here, because they turned a piece of chicken into a nostalgic 80s movie moment for me. And for that, you are My Chicken Winner!

The idea of this place = awesome. A prohibition era establishment where you have to knock on the door with a password to get let in. Small, intimate atmosphere. Handmade delicious cocktails.

Execution of said idea = not so good. Our drinks were delicious, they had a great selection. I also enjoyed the truffle popcorn, I could not stop eating and I wasn't even hungry. The drinks have NYC Manhattan price tags and take about 10-15 minutes to make. If I am paying that much for just a drink, I expect a certain level of professionalism from the staff. Our server, Katie, was downright rude and ruined the entire experience. She refused to answer any questions and had an offensive disposition and attitude, especially with my husband. It is not difficult to write down an order for drinks and bring them back from a bar with a smile. 

My family and friends rave about this place, but it did not live up to the hype for me. The experience left a horrible taste in my mouth that I am still thinking about a week later. Re-train and/or "refurbish" your staff and maybe I will try again.

So I remember eating here a long long time ago... but came today since I was in the area. 

Parking is iffy. I was lucky to find a spot a block away but you have to be careful of the signs.

So there was a line around the place for cheesesteaks. I found out that that line is for cheesesteaks only. There is a different window/counter for fries and drinks. Thank god I didn't wait long on that one. I just have waited 20-25mins for the cheesesteak.

It's an average cheesesteak. I opted for the original cheesesteak with provolone melted cheese and onions. They also have wiz and American cheese to choose. It costed me 10 bucks. And oh yeah- its cash only. 

Next time I'll try Pats across the street since I hear there is a street rival between the two.

I was put on to this spot by a co-worker who happens to be trini. 

Located in the strip mall at the light across from Grounds for Sculpture in Hamilton 

Parking is easy

A few tables inside to sit if you wanted 

Staff was extremely friendly and attentive.... Indra was super sweet. 

I prefer Dhal Puri roti skin vs the plain/buss up shut roti skin in general ... the powdered chick peas give the roti more flavor...

tried the boneless chicken . You have option for bone or boneless .

You also can opt to have your meat or vegetables wrapped up inside the roti or on the side 
It's a huge portion - you can share it with someone or you are guaranteed to take a doggy bag home

The chicken dhal puri was delicious! It's good with their pepper sauce which is basically trini hot sauce 

They also had dessert/ baked goods like currant roll 

I saw another patrons oxtail dinner and it looked delicious 

I will definitely be back :p

Believe it or not this local brewery has a brunch on Sundays, and it's pretty darn good. $15 added to your brunch food item gets you unlimited mimosas, sangria or bloody Mary. It's from 11 to 2 and if there's nice weather, make sure to sit outside. I ordered the breakfast burrito which had generous amounts of flank steak and eggs in it. Good selection of other items on the brunch menu, but I've also had burgers from here which are always a go-to if you're not sure about something.

Grab a bite to eat and something to drink and take a dip in the hotel pool next door. 

A rare find to be able to have "good" seafood at a reasonable price around a tourist destination. I ordered a margarita and enjoyed the view while also eating a delicious seafood fra Diablo loaded with shrimp, scallops and muscles... But not before a great smoked fish dip appetizer that also includes a salmon dip as well and a company tomatoes, garlic pickles and whole banana peppers. As good as the food was the service compliments in it, will definitely put this in my bookmark for future use.

Let me start by mentioning that this place has soooooo much potential.... But seems to be having a very rocky start... 

Southern comfort food! Reno needs a few of these places, and this place seems to be getting alllllll of the Yelp attention. So we stopped by for lunch during the week. As anyone could assume, a midday lunch during the week means it must be a quick service. Well, this isn't exactly what we got. 

After being seated, one waitress took our drink orders. I was disappointed to see that a southern-style restaurant, with New Orleans decor, didn't have sweet tea prepared. Instead, they bring simple syrup to the table to make your tea sweet. Just isn't the same folks.... I had to go through several of those little simple syrup servings to get it to a desired taste. 

Our drinks were refilled 3x before being served our chow.... With a total wait time of 1 hour and 30 minutes. Of course the waiter ordered us free appetizer after an hour and 15 minutes and was very apologetic. Instead, we received our food shortly thereafter... But we didn't even get the sorry appetizer!! So really, the apology felt like it was rehearsed and convenient and ended up causing us to actually stay to wait for our food instead of leaving angry. It felt like a ploy to me. 

So, we finally got our food. We were starving at this point, and anything that went into our mouths would have been heavenly. However, I did notice that the chicken salad I ordered was pretty tasty. 

When we received our food, the family of 5 next to us had not. They ordered about 10 minutes after we did and ended up walking out of the restaurant still hungry as we were walking out full. 

It seemed like a hot mess of an ownership, little training by the waiter and waitresses, and mediocre food is really hurting the outcome of this business. I hope they get it together. I think they have a lot of potential. But it all comes down to ticket times and a decent meal for customers who come in on the weekday for lunch.

I was really hoping not to have to write this review. It would have been nice to speak with the owner, resolve the matter &  hope for a tad bit of humility & a genuine apology - not sarcasm. But here we go.....
